jobs.description:
**Position:** Warehouse All-Rounder – Tyre Fitter / Delivery Driver

We’re looking for a reliable, hardworking person to join our team as a Warehouse All-Rounder.

This is a hands-on role with plenty of variety. You’ll work across the warehouse, tyre fitting and deliveries, so you’ll need to be someone who is happy to get stuck in and help wherever needed.

Your day-to-day work could include unloading containers and organising stock, picking and preparing orders, fitting tyres to new wheels for our OE department, or loading up the truck and making deliveries around Melbourne and regional Victoria.

We’re a small team, so we’re looking for someone who takes pride in their work, can work without being constantly supervised and can be relied on to get the job done properly.

**What you'll be doing**

**Warehouse & Stock**

* Keeping the warehouse clean, organised and safe.
* Unloading containers and receiving incoming stock.
* Checking incoming and outgoing stock against orders and paperwork.
* Picking, packing and preparing orders for delivery.
* Moving and handling tyres, wheels and other automotive products.
* Helping keep stock organised and assisting with stock control.

**Tyre Fitting – OE Department**

* Fitting tyres to brand-new wheels ready for delivery.
* Preparing wheel and tyre assemblies to a good standard.
* Carrying out general tyre fitting and workshop duties.
* Checking finished wheel and tyre assemblies before they are dispatched.
* Working efficiently while making sure the job is done properly.

**Delivery Driving**

* Delivering tyres and wheels throughout Melbourne metro and regional Victoria.
* Loading and securing goods correctly before departure.
* Completing deliveries professionally and on time.
* Completing delivery paperwork and maintaining accurate records.
* Ensuring company vehicles are kept clean and looked after.

**About You**

You’ll suit this role if you’re dependable, practical and not afraid of hard work.

You’ll need to be comfortable working on your own when required, but also be a good team player. The work can be physical, and there will be days where you’re moving tyres, unloading stock or loading deliveries, so being prepared to get involved is important.

You don’t need to know everything from day one. We’re happy to teach the right person, but you do need to have a good attitude, be willing to learn and take responsibility for your work.

**Requirements:**

**Essential:**

* Full Car Licence.
* Valid Medium Rigid (MR) Licence.
* Valid Forklift Licence.
* Full Australian working rights.

**Desirable:**

* Previous tyre fitting experience.
* Experience fitting passenger vehicle tyres and/or light truck tyres.
* Previous warehouse experience.
* Previous delivery driving experience.
* Experience working with wheels, tyres or automotive products.

**What We Offer:**

* Full-time, permanent posistion
* Be part of a small, hands on supportive and collaborative team environment.

If you're looking for a stable, hands-on role where you can become an important part of a small team, apply now with your resume and a brief cover letter.

Pay: From $30.00 per hour

Licence/Certification:

* Full Driver Licence (Required)
* Forklift Licence (Required)
* MR Licence (Preferred)

Work Authorisation:

* Australia (Required)

Work Location: In person

About Triple Zero Victoria

Triple Zero Victoria (TZV) provides the critical link between the Victorian community and the state’s emergency services agencies. It provides Victoria’s 24-hour emergency call-taking and dispatch services for Police, Fire, Ambulance and VICSES.

This integration of emergency services communications within Triple Zero Victoria is unique in Australia and rare worldwide. The team at Triple Zero Victoria are deeply committed to the community they serve and are among the most dedicated and highly skilled in their field.

About the Role

The Corporate Secretariat Officer is a key role within the Office of the CEO, responsible for delivering high-quality governance, executive and corporate secretariat services that support the Chief Executive Officer, Board and Board Committees.

Reporting to the Senior Advisor, Ministerial and Executive Services, the role works closely with the Office of the CEO, Board members, Executive Leadership Team and internal stakeholders to coordinate governance processes, manage confidential governance information and ensure the timely delivery of Board and Committee services. The position requires exceptional organisational skills, sound judgement, discretion and the ability to build strong stakeholder relationships while supporting effective organisational governance and decision-making.

Day to day responsibilities include:

* Coordinating end-to-end governance and secretariat services for the Chief Executive Officer, Board and Board Committees, including meeting scheduling, agenda preparation, quality assurance of Board papers, document management, action tracking and the timely distribution of governance documentation.
* Preparing accurate, concise and impartial Board and Committee minutes, exercising sound judgement to capture key deliberations, decisions, resolutions and actions while managing highly confidential and sensitive information with discretion and integrity.
* Managing governance records, document control processes and governance systems, ensuring Board records, resolutions and governance documentation are accurate, secure and compliant with legislative, regulatory and organisational requirements.
* Monitoring governance workflows, meeting calendars and action registers, proactively identifying risks, resolving issues and supporting the timely delivery of governance obligations and organisational priorities.
* Building productive relationships with Board members, Executive Leadership Team members and internal stakeholders, providing advice and guidance on governance processes, meeting protocols, documentation standards and governance systems.
* Contributing to governance and executive projects by undertaking research, preparing briefing materials and identifying opportunities to improve governance processes, systems, reporting and business practices.

About You

You will have Secretariat and administration experince in a corportate or similar business enviornment with excellent organisation skills, with hte ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

The successful candidate will have the following experience, skills and attributes:

* Demonstrated experience providing governance, executive or corporate secretariat support within a Board, executive or similarly complex organisational environment, including managing highly confidential and sensitive information with discretion and integrity.
* Exceptional organisational and coordination skills, with the ability to independently manage competing priorities, meet critical governance deadlines and deliver high-quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
* Highly developed written communication skills, including the ability to prepare accurate, concise and professionally presented governance documentation, reports and Board and Committee minutes, exercising sound judgement to distil complex discussions into clear records.
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to build productive relationships, provide advice on governance processes and work collaboratively with senior leaders, Board members and a diverse range of internal and external stakeholders.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify governance risks, recommend process improvements and contribute to the continuous enhancement of governance practices and systems.
* Well-developed digital literacy, with experience using the Microsoft 365 suite and the ability to quickly learn and effectively utilise governance and document management systems. Experience using Board management systems such as Diligent will be highly regarded.

What We Can Offer You

You will be supporting a critical service to the Victorian community and will be rewarded with a competitive salary, flexible working arrangements and employee benefits including:

* Employee assistance program for employees and eligible family members
* Discounted health insurance, banking services and gym membership
* ‘Memberlink’ discount card, accepted by 1,000's of retailers and services providers
* Free staff parking at all our sites
* Salary packaging options after an initial service period

Triple Zero Victoria is committed to the principles of equal opportunity, and diversity and inclusion for all. We value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and contributions that each person brings to our workplace. We encourage and celebrate diversity in all forms - gender, religion, ethnicity, LGBTQIA+, disability and neurodiversity. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander candidates are strongly encouraged to apply for our roles. Our aim is to create a workforce that reflects the Victorian community in which we live.

Click the ‘Apply’ button which will direct you to the Triple Zero Victoria Careers Portal. From here you can submit your application, which should include a current resume and cover letter outlining your interest in the role and linking your experience to the position.

Please note: all applications must be submitted via our Triple Zero Victoria Careers Portal. We kindly ask that you do not send your application by email as we require you to complete a mandatory application form to accompany your application.

At Google, we have a vision of empowerment and equitable opportunity for all Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and commit to building reconciliation through Google’s technology, platforms and people and we welcome Indigenous applicants. Please see our Reconciliation Action Plan for more information.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sydney NSW, Australia; Melbourne VIC, Australia**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms.
* Experience building full-stack solutions that interface with enterprise systems.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 4 years of experience in software development, systems architecture, or a highly technical customer-facing role with proficiency in one of more general-purpose programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go).
* Experience managing the technical pre-sales cycle, from initial scoping and architecture design to the successful delivery of integrated PoVs.
* Deep experience with cloud-native application development.
* Demonstrated experience designing and building AI applications.

**About the job**

When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.

As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go-To-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the deep technical bridge between our customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real-world applications.

You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer robust Proof of Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as-is" systems. By keeping the final production end-state in mind from day one, you will advocate for our AI and cloud-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead deep-dive technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and their current technology landscape. Design comprehensive system architectures and run iterative workshops with stakeholders to lock in project scope, always architecting with the final end-state in mind.
* Move seamlessly from high-level architecture to low-level implementation. Actively code, build, and deploy robust cloud systems, ensuring technical designs translate into functional, integrated realities.
* Architect and engineer enterprise-grade AI solutions—such as agentic workflows, RAG systems, and applied foundation models—backed by highly scalable, cloud-native infrastructure including event-driven microservices, containerized workloads, and serverless compute.
* Engineer functional PoV products that integrate into the customer's as-is systems to demonstrate true business value. Ensure all builds adhere strictly to engineering best practices, security standards, and scalability guidelines to ensure a smooth transition to production.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description:

At Google, we have a vision of empowerment and equitable opportunity for all Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and commit to building reconciliation through Google’s technology, platforms and people and we welcome Indigenous applicants. Please see our Reconciliation Action Plan for more information.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in quota-carrying cloud or software sales, or consultative account management at a business-to-business (B2B) software company.
* Experience engaging with accounts, selling a portfolio of products at C-level.
* Experience in engaging and building relationships with internal teams and customer stakeholders.
* Experience prospecting, or building customer relationships from scratch.
* Experience in managing the full business cycle (e.g., pipeline management, forecasting, reporting) and managing commercial discussions and agreements.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with consultative selling to executives, asking insightful, visionary questions, presenting future-forward proposals, and building multi-year account strategies and plans.
* Experience selling infrastructure software, databases, analytical tools, applications software, or cloud solutions.
* Experience successfully working on large, complex commercial and legal agreements with procurement, legal, and business teams.
* Experience in qualifying leads and presenting the value proposition of cloud, data, and AI technologies against customers’ business opportunities and issues.
* Experience showcasing current technology trends and Cloud differentiators.
* Experience working with and managing partners in complex implementation projects including global system integrators and packaged software vendors.

**About the job**

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Field Sales Representative, you will act as a trusted business partner to the assigned large-scale enterprise accounts to understand company issues and goals. You will drive long-term business growth by gaining an understanding of customers' critical issues and aligning them with Google Cloud's portfolio of solutions.You will advocate the innovative power of our products to make organizations more productive, collaborative, and mobile. You will help spread the magic of Google to organizations around the world.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement business strategies to surpass business goals and build trusted, consultative relationships with customers, while leveraging emerging technology trends, market analysis, and knowledge of cloud solutions to showcase how Google Cloud can transform customers' business.
* Manage and track the business pipeline, from lead to close, ensure health and accurate forecasting for clear visibility into expected outcomes.
* Lead account strategy in generating and developing business growth opportunities, working collaboratively with Customer Engineers, and Google Partners, creating new opportunities.
* Run and manage complex global account(s) with multiple opportunities across different functions, serve as the primary customer contact for all adoption-related activities.
* Manage complex, multi-year agreements and formulate proposals that illustrate clear return on investment through customer business cases and comprehensive deployment plans.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Hybrid
jobs.description:
Link to process walkthrough: https://www.loom.com/share/3cc1e3ed90564eb6bfc5e8fa8180d9a0

Thanks for stopping by and learning more about this role at Sitemate!

We'd love to hear from you

**Overview**

**Build What Matters**

The Full Stack Engineer is an ownership role responsible for product outcomes end-to-end: from shaping technical approaches and building features through to release, reliability, and production performance.

At Sitemate, engineers combine strong technical craft with product thinking and delivery ownership. You'll work in small, high-trust teams alongside Product Design Managers to define problems, shape solutions, implement clean and scalable systems, and take responsibility for what ships — including how it behaves once live.

Engineering, product, and delivery are not separate handoffs here; they operate as one integrated team. We believe the future of product development in an AI-accelerated world belongs to engineers who can think beyond tickets - they own outcomes and deliver at speed with AI.

**Employment:**

* Full-time
* Based: Sydney, Australia or Melbourne, Australia
* Remuneration (Including Super): AUD $160,000 - $200,000 pending your experience

**About Sitemate**

Sitemate builds modern software for construction, infrastructure, and industrial companies - helping teams move faster, work smarter, and deliver with confidence.

Our flagship platform, Dashpivot, transforms manual, paper-based processes into simple, mobile-first digital workflows. Teams use Sitemate every day to capture data in the field, automate reporting, and make better decisions in real time.

Since launching in 2018, we’ve grown from 5 to 150+ people across 18+ countries. We’re backed by Blackbird, Australia and New Zealand’s #1 venture capital firm, and graduated from the Startmate Accelerator. Thousands of companies use Sitemate tools today - with thousands more discovering us each month through strong word-of-mouth and organic growth.

**Why Join Sitemate**

At Sitemate, you’ll join a global team that values transparency, high velocity, hustle, diversity, and innovation.

We’re open about our metrics, honest about challenges, and obsessed with improving how the world’s most important industries operate. Our environment is flexible, fast-moving, and outcome-driven - designed to help you do the best work of your career.

You’ll be surrounded by people who take pride in their work, care deeply about results, and believe that great culture is built on trust, respect, and continuous learning.

**How We Work**

* **Transparency at every level:** Monthly Allhands meetings share key company metrics, updates, and customer stories. We also spotlight a team member’s “Life Story” each month - it’s one of the ways we stay connected as a global team.
* **High velocity, low friction:** Our systems are modern and fully integrated, so you’ll spend your time solving problems - not fighting tools.
* **Performance-driven growth:** Seven of our last ten pay increases were made proactively, based on impact and results.
* **True flexibility:** We focus on outcomes, not hours. You’ll have autonomy to manage your time and work where you perform best - with no time monitoring or unnecessary meetings.
* **Collaboration:** You’ll work closely with other teams - engineering, product, design, marketing, and customer success - to move fast and deliver meaningful results.
* **Sydney HQ perks** - rooftop garden, wellness centre, showers, and cycle storage in Haymarket
* **Melbourne office perks** - micro-roasted coffee bar, on-site parking & bike storage, wellness & mothers rooms, opposite Southern Cross station

**What We Offer**

* **Competitive, performance-based remuneration**
* **Equity options** - own a piece of what you’re helping to build
* **20 days of paid annual leave**, plus sick, carer’s, and compassionate leave
* **Paid parental leave** - 16 weeks for primary carers, 6 weeks for secondary carers (including adoption and stillbirth support)
* **Professional growth budget** and a transparent career development framework
* **Laptop and home-office setup budget**
* **Flexible work** - remote or hybrid, plus the ability to work from anywhere for a few weeks each year
* **Community & connection** - weekly team lunches, global offsites, and our signature “Life Story” sessions

**Diversity & Inclusion**

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Sitemate welcomes people of all genders, ethnicities, ages, sexualities, and abilities.

55% of our team identify as coming from underrepresented ethnic backgrounds, 43% identify as female, and our team spans ages 22–51. We believe our diversity makes us stronger - and we’re committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work.

**Learn More About Sitemate**

**Podcasts:**

* 2024: CEO Hartley Pike on scaling Sitemate, diversity, and culture
* 2023: CMO Lance Hodgson on accelerating your career
* 2022: CTO Tim Bray on building quality features that solve real customer problems

**Want to know what it’s like to work at Sitemate? Hear it straight from the team**: People of Sitemate
**Read what our customers say:** G2 Crowd, Trust Radius
**Team Offsites:** 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025

**What this role looks like at the senior level**

You'll lead technical decisions within a team attached to a product. You'll help shape architecture, mentor engineers, and have direct input into how our products evolve to support our users.

You'll work across frontend, backend, and mobile: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Angular, MongoDB, and AWS. You don't need to be an expert in all of these, but you're skilled enough across part of the stack to lead with confidence.

**Two shifts are defining what senior engineering looks like here:**

* You'll operate as a product-minded engineer. This goes beyond having opinions about UX. You'll join customer calls, interpret usage data, and make strategic decisions about what to ship and what to defer. The best engineers here understand the customer problem as deeply as they understand the code.
* You'll lead the shift to agentic engineering. We're moving toward a model where senior engineers define and orchestrate AI agents to build features, rather than writing every line. You'll help establish how this works in practice — the patterns, the guardrails, and the quality bar — and help move other engineers towards this workflow.

**Day-to-Day**

* Contribute to architecture decisions and long-term technical vision across the platform.
* Build and ship impactful features, from architecting new capabilities to improving performance and code quality.
* Shape experiences around AI-powered developer tools and agentic engineering practices.
* Mentor engineers through code reviews, pairing sessions, and informal guidance.
* Contribute improvements to developer experience (tooling, CI/CD, monitoring).
* Collaborate directly with product, design, and leadership on what to build and why.

**Challenges**

* High technical complexity beneath simple UIs — shared components across multiple products, backend services powering web and mobile clients.
* Pace: Fast-Tracked is a real operating value. You'll need to balance speed with quality and sustainable delivery.
* Organisational maturity: engineering leadership, frameworks, and career ladders are being established. You'll be building the plane while flying it.

**Who This Role is For**

* You've built and shipped at scale and want to own technical direction, not just execute.
* You're excited about agentic engineering and want to lead a team through that transition.
* You care about mentoring — helping others grow is as important to you as your own contributions.
* You're drawn to real-world impact — our users build wind farms, highways, and mines in 100+ countries.
* You want to shape how an engineering org works through our next phase of growth, not inherit someone else's playbook.

**Who This Role is** ***Not*** **For**

* You want a mature engineering org with a VP of Engineering, established technical ladders, and 50-person platform teams already in place. We're building that — which is the opportunity if you want to shape it, and a mismatch if you need it to already exist.
* You want to specialise in just design or just product management — senior engineers here own the full delivery cycle and operate as product-minded technologists.
* You see AI tooling as a nice-to-have. Agentic engineering is our direction and senior engineers are expected to lead the shift.

**Skills & Tools**

**Must Have:**

* Proven experience building and shipping production software at scale
* Ability to lead architecture decisions and technical direction
* Experience mentoring and uplifting other engineers
* Strong product mindset — thinks about customer outcomes, not just implementation
* Strong enthusiasm for agentic engineering and AI-first workflows

**Nice to Have:**

* Deep expertise in TypeScript, React, Node.js, Angular, MongoDB, or AWS
* Mobile development experience
* Experience in a scale-up or high-growth product environment

**Essential Tools:**

* TypeScript / JavaScript
* React or Angular
* Node.js

**Bonus Tools:**

* MongoDB
* AWS
* React Native / mobile

**PLEASE Note:**

* **We do not use recruitment partners or services, so please save your time and don't reach out**

Compensation Range: A$160K - A$200K

Thanks for stopping by and learning more about this role at Sitemate!

We'd love to hear from you

**Overview**

**Build What Matters**

The Engineering Manager leads the engineering side of a product team, reporting to and supporting their Product General Manager (PGM). They are responsible for the engineers in their team, including their performance, growth, and day-to-day execution, and for making sure work moves from "ready to build" through to "shipped and stable" with high quality and a predictable cadence.

Delivery is shared with the Product Design Manager (PDM). The PDM owns the *what*: product scope, design, acceptance criteria, and production monitoring. The Manager owns the *how*: engineering capacity, sprint planning, unblocking engineers, and the quality of the engineering process. Both are jointly accountable for timelines and outcomes. When something slips or ships with issues, neither role can point at the other.

The Manager also works closely with the Tech Lead, who owns technical quality and architectural direction. The Manager focuses on execution and people. The Tech Lead focuses on technical standards and code quality. In practice these overlap and require close collaboration.

This is a Sitemate-specific role and it is deliberately narrower than a typical Engineering Manager. Think Delivery Manager and Engineering Lead combined, with delivery shared with the PDM and technical direction carved out to the Tech Lead. Set this framing with candidates early, because it is the single most common source of mismatch.

**Employment:**

* Full-time
* Based: Sydney, Australia or Melbourne, Australia
* Remuneration (Including Super): AUD $140,000 - $170,000 pending your experience

**About Sitemate**

Sitemate builds modern software for construction, infrastructure, and industrial companies - helping teams move faster, work smarter, and deliver with confidence.

Our flagship platform, Dashpivot, transforms manual, paper-based processes into simple, mobile-first digital workflows. Teams use Sitemate every day to capture data in the field, automate reporting, and make better decisions in real time.

Since launching in 2018, we’ve grown from 5 to 150+ people across 18+ countries. We’re backed by Blackbird, Australia and New Zealand’s #1 venture capital firm, and graduated from the Startmate Accelerator. Thousands of companies use Sitemate tools today - with thousands more discovering us each month through strong word-of-mouth and organic growth.

**Why Join Sitemate**

At Sitemate, you’ll join a global team that values transparency, high velocity, hustle, diversity, and innovation.

We’re open about our metrics, honest about challenges, and obsessed with improving how the world’s most important industries operate. Our environment is flexible, fast-moving, and outcome-driven - designed to help you do the best work of your career.

You’ll be surrounded by people who take pride in their work, care deeply about results, and believe that great culture is built on trust, respect, and continuous learning.

**How We Work**

* **Transparency at every level:** Monthly Allhands meetings share key company metrics, updates, and customer stories. We also spotlight a team member’s “Life Story” each month - it’s one of the ways we stay connected as a global team.
* **High velocity, low friction:** Our systems are modern and fully integrated, so you’ll spend your time solving problems - not fighting tools.
* **Performance-driven growth:** Seven of our last ten pay increases were made proactively, based on impact and results.
* **True flexibility:** We focus on outcomes, not hours. You’ll have autonomy to manage your time and work where you perform best - with no time monitoring or unnecessary meetings.
* **Collaboration:** You’ll work closely with other teams - engineering, product, design, marketing, and customer success - to move fast and deliver meaningful results.
* **Sydney HQ perks** - rooftop garden, wellness centre, showers, and cycle storage in Haymarket
* **Melbourne office perks** - micro-roasted coffee bar, on-site parking & bike storage, wellness & mothers rooms, opposite Southern Cross station

**What We Offer**

* **Competitive, performance-based remuneration**
* **Equity options** - own a piece of what you’re helping to build
* **20 days of paid annual leave**, plus sick, carer’s, and compassionate leave
* **Paid parental leave** - 16 weeks for primary carers, 6 weeks for secondary carers (including adoption and stillbirth support)
* **Professional growth budget** and a transparent career development framework
* **Laptop and home-office setup budget**
* **Flexible work** - remote or hybrid, plus the ability to work from anywhere for a few weeks each year
* **Community & connection** - weekly team lunches, global offsites, and our signature “Life Story” sessions

**Diversity & Inclusion**

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Sitemate welcomes people of all genders, ethnicities, ages, sexualities, and abilities.

55% of our team identify as coming from underrepresented ethnic backgrounds, 43% identify as female, and our team spans ages 22–51. We believe our diversity makes us stronger - and we’re committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work.

**Learn More About Sitemate**

**Podcasts:**

* 2024: CEO Hartley Pike on scaling Sitemate, diversity, and culture
* 2023: CMO Lance Hodgson on accelerating your career
* 2022: CTO Tim Bray on building quality features that solve real customer problems

**Want to know what it’s like to work at Sitemate? Hear it straight from the team**: People of Sitemate
**Read what our customers say:** G2 Crowd, Trust Radius
**Team Offsites:** 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025

**What this role looks like at Sitemate**

You'll have direct reports. You'll run 1:1s, progress Sitemate Development Plans and competency matrix levels, set goals, give feedback, and handle performance issues directly. You'll also plan sprint capacity, make sure work is broken into milestones with estimates, track progress, and surface risk before it becomes a problem.

You need to be technical enough to be credible. You should be able to follow a design discussion, sense when an estimate is off, and know when "it's nearly done" isn't. You are not expected to own architecture, but you are expected to know when to pull the Tech Lead in.

**Two shifts are defining what engineering management looks like here:**

* Forward Deployed Engineering. Teams work closer to customers and ship in tighter loops. Your job is to make sure engineers have real customer signal in front of them, and that the process supports fast iteration rather than adding ceremony to it.
* Agentic Engineering. AI is changing what a team of a given size can deliver, which changes how you plan, estimate, and sequence work. You'll need to hold the process standards that keep quality high as throughput goes up, in partnership with the Tech Lead who sets the technical bar.

**Day-to-Day**

* Plan and manage sprint or cycle capacity, making sure engineers have clear, well-sequenced work broken into milestones with estimates.
* Track delivery progress and surface risk or slippage early, rather than waiting for things to go wrong.
* Act as the primary escalation path when engineers are stuck, and remove blockers before they stall delivery.
* Run regular 1:1s, progress SDPs and competency matrix levels, set goals, and give consistent feedback.
* Manage performance issues directly and constructively.
* Hold the line on engineering process standards such as test coverage, PR quality, and deployment practices, in partnership with the Tech Lead.
* Communicate delivery status to stakeholders proactively, and act as the focal point for communication into the engineering team.
* Stay aligned with the PDM on priorities, sequencing, and any scope or delivery trade-offs.
* Escalate to the PGM when decisions or resources sit beyond the team's control.

**Challenges**

* Shared accountability. Delivery is shared with the PDM and technical direction sits with the Tech Lead. You'll get results through influence and close collaboration far more than through direct control.
* People and delivery pull in opposite directions. Some weeks the sprint wins, some weeks the person does. Judging which is a large part of the job.
* Pace. Fast-Tracked is a real operating value, so you'll need to balance speed with quality and sustainable delivery for your team.
* Distributed teams across Australia, UK, Southeast Asia, Brazil, Canada. Time zones and async communication are part of the role, not an edge case.
* Organisational maturity. Engineering leadership, frameworks, and career ladders are still being established, so you'll be building the plane while flying it.

**Who This Role is For**

* You've managed engineers before, or you've been a Tech Lead or Senior engineer already doing the job unofficially and want to make it official.
* You get more satisfaction from a team shipping well than from being the one who shipped it.
* You have difficult conversations early rather than letting things drift.
* You're technical enough to be credible with engineers and to smell a bad estimate.
* You're comfortable owning an outcome jointly with someone else and not needing the final say on everything.
* You're drawn to real-world impact. Our users build wind farms, highways, and mines in 100+ countries.
* You want to shape how an engineering org works through our next phase of growth, not inherit someone else's playbook.

**Who This Role is** ***Not*** **For**

* You want to own architecture and technical direction. That sits with the Tech Lead here. If that's what you're after, the Engineering Tech Lead role is the better fit.
* You want coding to remain the main part of your job. Managers can stay hands-on at the edges, but this is not an IC role.
* You want full Engineering Manager scope with unilateral control over people, process, delivery, and technology. Ours is deliberately narrower.
* You manage from a dashboard. This role needs someone in the detail with their team.
* You avoid performance conversations or route them straight to HR.
* You want a mature engineering org with a VP of Engineering, established ladders, and defined management frameworks already in place. We're building that, which is the opportunity if you want to shape it and a mismatch if you need it to already exist.

**Skills & Tools**

**Must Have:**

* Experience managing or leading a team of engineers, with direct reports or clear equivalent responsibility
* Strong delivery management across capacity planning, work breakdown, estimation, tracking, and early risk escalation
* A software engineering background, with enough technical depth to be credible and to challenge estimates
* Track record of growing engineers through feedback, goal setting, and career development
* Willingness to handle underperformance directly and constructively
* Comfort operating in shared accountability with product counterparts

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience in a scale-up or high-growth product environment
* Experience managing distributed or multi-timezone teams
* Hands-on background in TypeScript, Node.js, Angular or React, MongoDB, or AWS
* Experience improving engineering process such as sprint cadence, release process, or on-call
* Practical experience with AI-assisted development workflows

**Essential Tools:**

* Jira or an equivalent planning and tracking tool
* Confluence or equivalent documentation practice

**Bonus Tools:**

* TypeScript / JavaScript....

**Want to know what it’s like to work at Sitemate? Hear it straight from the team**: People of Sitemate
**Read what our customers say:** G2 Crowd, Trust Radius
**Team Offsites:** 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025

**What this role looks like at Tech Lead**

You'll set the technical direction for a team attached to a product. You'll drive RFCs and Decision Logs, make the architectural calls, and be the escalation path when engineers hit something they can't solve.

You'll work across frontend, backend, and mobile: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Angular, MongoDB, and AWS. You don't need to be an expert in all of these, but you're deep enough across the stack to make calls with confidence and defend them.

**Two shifts are defining what technical leadership looks like here:**

* Forward Deployed Engineering. You'll ground the team's technical decisions in customer impact and real signals, connecting architectural choices to product outcomes rather than technical elegance. Your job is to provide the guardrails that let the team ship quality features at velocity, not to slow things down in the name of correctness.
* Agentic Engineering. You'll set the technical standards for AI-assisted development in your team: the guardrails, the review patterns, and the quality bar that ensure AI-generated code meets the same production-readiness standard as anything hand-written. Strong foundations matter more in the AI era, because AI amplifies both good and bad codebases and unresolved tech debt now compounds faster than ever.

**Day-to-Day**

* Drive Decision Logs and RFCs, and make architectural decisions that balance quality, velocity, and simplicity.
* Hold the line on engineering standards: test coverage, PR quality, deployment practices. Raise the bar on code review both as a reviewer and by coaching others to review well.
* Run technical initiatives end-to-end. Lead the direction, break down and distribute the work, and drive it to completion rather than letting it linger in the background.
* Lead diagnosis of complex, cross-service production issues, and drive improvements to observability, error handling, and logging.
* Act as the technical focal point inside and outside the team, and the escalation path when engineers are stuck.
* Mentor engineers through code review, pairing, and informal guidance, building redundancy so there are no single points of failure in knowledge.
* Identify and call out technical risk: debt, scalability, security. Escalate when a risk needs decisions or resources beyond the team.
* Write code and ship features. This is still a hands-on role.

**Challenges**

* High technical complexity beneath simple UIs. Shared components run across multiple products, and backend services power both web and mobile clients.
* Split attention. Roughly 50% goes to technical initiatives, with the rest across product delivery, reviews, and mentoring. Deciding what gets your time is a constant judgement call.
* Influence over authority. You set the standards for engineers you don't manage, since people management sits with the Engineering Manager. You get there through credibility and coaching.
* Pace. Fast-Tracked is a real operating value, so you'll need to balance speed with quality and sustainable delivery.
* Organisational maturity. Engineering leadership, frameworks, and career ladders are still being established, so you'll be building the plane while flying it.

**Who This Role is For**

* You've built and shipped at scale and want to own technical direction, not just execute against it.
* You want to stay hands-on. This is not a step out of the code.
* You're excited about agentic engineering and want to define the standards for it, not just use the tools.
* You care about mentoring. Helping others grow is as important to you as your own output.
* You're comfortable being the person who says "not like that", and then shows a better way.
* You're drawn to real-world impact. Our users build wind farms, highways, and mines in 100+ countries.

**Who This Role is** ***Not*** **For**

* You want to move into people management. Tech Leads don't have direct reports here, that's the Engineering Manager role. If your goal is 1:1s, performance, and headcount, this is the wrong seat.
* You want to step back from writing code and live in architecture diagrams and reviews. Tech Leads lead from inside the work.
* You optimise for technical elegance over customer outcomes. Architecture here has to earn its keep.
* You see AI tooling as a nice-to-have. Agentic engineering is our direction and Tech Leads are expected to set the bar for it.

**Skills & Tools**

**Must Have:**

* Proven experience building and shipping production software at scale, typically at Senior (L3) level or above
* Track record of owning architectural decisions and technical direction for a team
* Experience setting and enforcing engineering standards across code review, testing, and deployment practice
* Strong debugging ability across services, not just within a single codebase
* Experience mentoring and uplifting other engineers
* Strong product mindset. Thinks about customer outcomes, not just implementation
* Enthusiasm for agentic engineering and AI-first workflows

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience running technical initiatives or platform work end-to-end
* Experience writing RFCs or decision records that others actually used
* Deep expertise in TypeScript, React, Node.js, Angular, MongoDB, or AWS
* Mobile development experience
* Experience in a scale-up or high-growth product environment

**Essential Tools:**

* TypeScript / JavaScript
* React or Angular
* Node.js
* AWS or a comparable cloud platform

**Bonus Tools:**

* MongoDB
* React Native / mobile
* Observability tooling (HyperDX, Datadog, Bugsnag, Sentry)
* Infrastructure as code (CDK, Terraform)

**PLEASE Note:**

* **We do not use recruitment partners or services, so please save your time and don't reach out**

Compensation Range: A$160K - A$200K

**About the role**:

Join Saab Australia as a **Senior Support Systems Engineer – Land Capability.**

Lead Engineering Outcomes for a Major Land Capability Program.

We are seeking an experienced **Support Engineering Lead** to provide technical leadership across engineering support, systems integration, verification and configuration management for a complex Defence Land Capability program.

This is a senior engineering role with a strong focus on establishing and managing engineering baselines and leading the engineering activities required to establish and operate a Systems Integration Laboratory (SIL). You will work closely with Project Engineering leadership, engineering functional leads, customers and subcontractors to deliver integrated, testable and supportable engineering outcomes**.**

We work in a fast-paced, demanding, challenging as well as time sensitive environment; we’re diverse, global, resilient, adaptable and agile, therefore the ability to solve problems is critical.

Along with satisfaction & rewards that comes with working for a global defence company, you can expect a generous salary, a range of outstanding benefits & an inclusive working environment.

**This role is available in Melbourne, Adelaide, Canberra or Brisbane and can be performed from any of these locations.**

**The Role**

You will play a key role during program phase-in and throughout delivery, establishing the engineering framework and providing technical leadership across the program lifecycle.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Establish and maintain the Land Capability Program engineering baselines, including functional, allocated, product and configuration baselines.
* Lead engineering activities for the establishment of the Systems Integration Laboratory, covering system design, integration planning, infrastructure readiness and operational acceptance.
* Develop and manage systems engineering, requirements, architecture, design documentation and traceability.
* Lead the elicitation, analysis and management of internal and external stakeholder requirements.
* Provide technical leadership across hardware and software integration, system verification, validation and acceptance activities.
* Ensure the SIL design supports effective verification and validation of the system under test.
* Support technical reviews including SRR, PDR and CDR, working groups and technical demonstrations.
* Manage configuration and engineering change activities for assigned systems, products and capabilities.
* Lead technical analysis of test results, identify integration issues and drive corrective actions through to resolution.
* Coordinate engineering activities across internal teams, customers and subcontractors.
* Provide technical leadership during system installation, configuration, commissioning and maintenance.
* Support the development of training materials, user documentation and technical knowledge transfer.
* Provide technical input to scope, planning, estimating, risks and engineering work packages.
* Undertake Control Account Manager / Work Package Manager responsibilities for assigned engineering activities.
* Mentor engineers and foster a high-performance culture focused on technical quality, collaboration and continuous improvement

**About you**

You will be an experienced Systems Engineering professional with 8+ years’ experience, including significant exposure to complex, military and software-intensive systems. You will bring strong technical leadership capability and the confidence to engage with senior stakeholders across Defence, industry and engineering teams.

**You will bring:**

* Extensive knowledge of systems engineering principles, practices and lifecycle management.
* Strong experience delivering systems engineering within an ASDEFCON environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and technical workstreams.
* Proven capability across requirements management, architecture, design, integration, verification and validation.
* Experience establishing and managing engineering and configuration baselines.
* Strong systems integration, testing, troubleshooting and technical problem-solving capability.
* Experience with tools such as DOORS, Cameo Systems Modeler, Cradle or equivalent.
* Understanding of networking and network security considerations within complex systems.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical matters for customers, engineers and senior leaders.
* Experience mentoring engineers and building collaborative, accountable and high-performing teams.
* Strong planning, prioritisation and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing technical priorities and deadlines.

**Security & ITAR**

* **Australian Defence Security Clearance – NV1** is required. Information including past and present nationality and citizenship may be requested to check eligibility for access to materials controlled under various export control regimes, including ITAR.
* Ability to access and work with **ITAR-controlled information**

This is an opportunity to take a leading engineering role within a significant Land Capability program, shaping the engineering baseline, integration environment and technical outcomes that underpin the delivery of operational Defence capability.

If you are an experienced systems engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership and stakeholder capability, this role offers the opportunity to make a direct impact on a complex and strategically important Defence program.

### **About us**

Saab Australia is a defence, security and cyber solutions provider, specialising in the development and integration of major defence and security systems. For over 30 years in Australia, we have built a reputation for delivering complex systems integration projects that provide proven and advanced capabilities to keep us ahead of today’s challenges.

From combat, communications, security and underwater systems to mixed reality, cyber security and deployable health solutions, our extensive portfolio of products and services provide high-technology solutions for defence forces and civil industries across the globe.

Apply today to join our crew and deliver solutions with purpose.

### **Culture and benefits**

We employ over 1000 Australians and are committed to fostering a culture of excellence and enriching the employee experience.

By joining Saab, you’ll be a part of a collaborative and supportive organisation, where your professional growth and work-life balance are emphasised. You’ll work within an innovative and vibrant workplace, while having the opportunity to develop a long-term, fulfilling career.

As a valued team member of Saab Australia, you’ll access a variety of perks and benefits to support you and your family including:

For further information about a career at Saab, visit the page adjacent:

https://www.saab.com/markets/australia/careers/saab-life

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.

* Experience building full-stack solutions that interface with enterprise systems.

As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go-To-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the deep technical bridge between our customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Entity:** CSL Behring

**Job Category:** Engineering

**Job Family:** Automation

**Job Type:** Full Time

**Location****:** Broadmeadows, Victoria, Australia

**Employer Reference:** R-287459

**Job Description**

**The Opportunity**

The Senior Automation Engineer is responsible for the ownership, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of PCS/MES, DCS, and PLC process recipes and configurations within a specific manufacturing value stream. The position ensures alignment with global execution system strategies and standards, acts as the technical subject matter expert for execution systems across CAPEX and OPEX projects, and oversees system design, integration, commissioning, validation, and contractor deliverables. The role provides ongoing operational support, including incident management and 24/7/on-call manufacturing support to maximize facility uptime, while coordinating hardware, software, and system interfaces with key platforms such as data historians, building management systems, alarm management systems, manufacturing networks, and enterprise applications. Additionally, the position drives process improvements, system modifications, and compliance with GAMP 5 requirements to support reliable and efficient manufacturing operations.

**The Role**

* Lead and coordinate execution system recipe delivery across multiple work packages, ensuring technical priorities are aligned and project milestones are achieved on schedule in partnership with Project Managers.
* Own the recipe design and implementation strategy, ensuring manufacturing and engineering requirements are met while adhering to established standards, libraries, and ISA-S88/S95 methodologies.
* Manage the full execution system lifecycle, including requirements definition, detailed design, software configuration, system integration, commissioning, qualification, validation, start-up, and operational support.
* Maintain deep understanding of manufacturing processes within the assigned value stream, collaborating with global and site stakeholders to ensure solutions meet operational needs.
* Develop, review, and maintain technical documentation, software configurations, validation protocols, test cases, and qualification activities, including troubleshooting and issue resolution.
* Drive quality, compliance, and validation activities, including execution system validation strategy, audit readiness, investigations, CAPAs, change management, and adherence to QMS and global engineering standards.
* Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams and customer groups, including Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Facilities, EHS&S, and CSV, to ensure coordinated delivery, stakeholder alignment, and effective expectation management.
* Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities within execution systems, optimizing design, programming, testing, and project delivery while supporting workload balancing and, when required, performing interim Project Manager responsibilities.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related scientific discipline; Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum 5 years' experience within the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry, including expertise in Manufacturing, Engineering, Automation, or Execution Systems, with proven experience supporting and delivering automation solutions.
* Strong knowledge of process automation, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and batch manufacturing standards, including ISA-88 and ISA-95 frameworks.
* Hands-on experience in recipe and workflow authoring, along with MES master data, equipment configuration, and manufacturing process implementation across areas such as fractionation, manufacturing, and packaging.
* Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, validating, and supporting automation and execution systems within large-scale, regulated manufacturing environments.
* Experience supporting global shop-floor execution systems is highly desirable, with exposure to Process Excellence or continuous improvement methodologies viewed as an advantage.

**About CSL Behring**

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients' needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world's largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/.

**Our Benefits**

For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL.

**You Belong at CSL**

At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.

To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

CSL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please visit https://www.csl.com/accessibility-statement.

But more than that, we’re here to power communities, support local businesses and keep critical services running smoothly, we’re essential to them all – and none of this happens without our people.

We believe in an inclusive, welcoming workplace where everyone feels safe, valued and respected. From offering great benefits to creating real opportunities for growth, we’re committed to supporting you, your career and wellbeing. It’s why our people stick around, whether you live in the city or across regional and rural Victoria, we’re doing the work where it matters most - right in your own community. As Victorians electrify everything from homes to transport, we’re focused on ensuring our networks are ready to meet that demand.

If you want to be part of something essential, be essential with us.

**About the Role**:

We currently have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Environmental and Sustainability Program Specialist to join our Health, Safety and Sustainability team in a full time and permanent role based at our Melbourne CBD head office.

This role will provide expert advice and lead environmental, sustainability, compliance, and climate-related programs across the organisation. Partnering with operational teams, project managers, regulators, and external specialists, you will drive initiatives that reduce risk, support compliance, and deliver sustainable business outcomes.

In addition, you will lead key environmental programs, support climate reporting and emissions reduction initiatives, and provide practical guidance on environmental risk and compliance. You will play a critical role in ensuring environmental obligations are met while driving continuous improvement and sustainability performance across the business.

This role requires occasional travel to various sites across our network.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the delivery and continuous improvement of environmental and sustainability programs across the organisation.
* Provide specialist environmental expertise across areas including land contamination, asbestos management, PCB management, environmental risk, and climate-related initiatives.
* Develop, implement, and maintain environmental standards, procedures, assurance frameworks, and compliance programs.
* Coordinate environmental risk management activities, including risk registers, assurance audits, performance monitoring, and corrective action management.
* Lead environmental compliance and risk reduction initiatives, including environmental capital programs and land contamination management activities.
* Support climate-related reporting, greenhouse gas emissions management, climate risk assessment, and emissions reduction initiatives.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with business stakeholders, regulators, consultants, and service providers to support environmental outcomes.
* Deliver practical environmental advice, training, and guidance while contributing to governance forums and continuous improvement initiatives.

For more information on the role’s responsibilities, please click here to download the position description.

**To succeed in this role you will have:**

* A degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Management, Sustainability, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Significant experience in environmental and/or sustainability roles within utilities, infrastructure, construction, resources, or similar industries.
* Strong knowledge of environmental legislation, compliance obligations, environmental management systems, and risk management frameworks.
* Demonstrated experience managing environmental programs, including land contamination, asbestos management, environmental assurance, and environmental risk initiatives.
* Knowledge and practical experience in climate-related reporting, greenhouse gas accounting, emissions management, and sustainability reporting requirements.
* Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical matters into practical business advice.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with a focus on identifying risks, driving compliance, and delivering continuous improvement outcomes.
* Proven experience working with regulators, consultants, and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve environmental and sustainability objectives.

**Key Benefits:**

We’re proud to offer an inclusive, supportive workplace where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to grow. Some of our benefits include hybrid work options, purchased leave, 15 weeks of gender neutral primary parental leave, health and wellbeing subsidiary, career development and planning opportunities, and exclusive discounts. Visit our company website to learn more.

**Diversity, Equity & Inclusion to support a fair workplace for all**

We are committed to building a safe, inclusive, and supportive workplace where people of all genders, ethnicities, sexual orientations, abilities and ages are valued for who they are and empowered to do their best. Through our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Strategy (DEI), Reconciliation Action Plans and initiatives like Women in Power and Sparkle, our LGBTQIA+ allies network, we’re working to create equal opportunities for all. We are proud to be a WORK180 Endorsed Employer for Women. Explore our benefits.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences, and strongly encourage First Peoples, women, people from the LGBTIQA community, culturally and racially marginalised people and people with disabilities to apply. We recognise how people from marginalised groups can face extra barriers and self-select out of recruitment processes. With this in mind, we’re committed to making reasonable adjustments to ensure a positive, barrier-free recruitment process.

**What’s next?**

Please submit your application via our careers website by 9 September 2026. For the full Position Description, please visit our website or for any other questions reach out to Tom from the Talent team at careers@powercor.com.au

We encourage applications from all communities; people of all ages, genders, nationalities, abilities and cultures, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, the LGBTQIA+ community and people living with disability.

If you require adjustments as part of the recruitment process to accommodate your needs, please don’t hesitate to discuss these with us.

jobs.description:
**BICYCLE BUILDER - CASUAL RATES + BONUSES**

You don’t have to be a bike expert – we will train you!

**About 99 Bikes**

Launched in 2007 from a tiny Brisbane shop that could only fit 99 bikes, we’ve exploded into Australia’s largest bicycle retailer, now spanning across Australia, New Zealand, and the UK as part of the Pedal Group. With over 2 million loyal club 99 members, the 99 Bikes mission is simple: to be The World’s Most Approachable Bike Shops. In addition to our retail stores, Pedal Group also owns Advance Traders, a bicycle distributor selling popular brands to independent bike shops such as Merida, Cube and Pedal, plus many more. Together we form the Pedal Group and this integration has underpinned our growth and given our people much greater career opportunities across the group. We have always been about living our purpose of enriching mind, body, earth or soul with the freedom of riding and focused on balancing purpose with profit.

Why We’re Different:

* We Build Business Around People: We promote from within relentlessly. Whether it's moving a star performer to a new city or helping a bike builder rise to GM of our UK operations, your growth is our priority.
* Profit Meets Purpose: As a proud Certified B Corp, we balance business with doing good. We've donated over $3.2M to employee-chosen charities, power 70% of our shops with solar, and even pay our team to ride to work.

**Why Work At 99 Bikes**

* **Hourly Wage + Target Bonuses -**Earn an immediate casual hourly rate that aligns with the General Retail Award (no low apprentice wages!), plus the opportunity to earn a monthly bonus for hitting safe build targets.
* **Ultimate Perks -**Get paid to ride to work, plus score cost-price prices on amazing gear
* **Gain Global Qualifications -**We provide access to our internal Bicycle Academy, where you can earn a Certificate in Bicycle Workshop Operations and internationally recognised Cytech mechanic credentials.
* **Unmatched Career Growth -** Our store teams have progressed from casual Bike Builders to permanent Mechanics, Workshop Leaders, State Workshop Specialists, and General Managers.
* **Flexibility & Balance** **-** We aim to accommodate your personal needs with flexible rostering. Enjoy plenty of high-traffic weekend work with time off during the week to match your lifestyle.

**About The Role:**

We’re looking for hard-working, high achievers with can-do attitudes to join our team as a Bike Builder for our busy summer season.

* **Hands On Bike Building** **-** Take a hands-on role focusing on completing highly efficient, quality, and safe bike builds to get riders out on the road.
* **No Bike Expertise Required!**A solid mechanical aptitude is a great foundation. We provide complete, hands-on on-the-job training and support to help you succeed.
* **Immediate Award Wage -** on offer right from day one, meaning absolutely no low apprenticeship wages.
* **Learn & Grow** **-** This role is perfect for Bike Builders who want to progress their careers and learn to become permanent skilled mechanics
* **High-Performing Culture** **-** Thrive in a tight-knit, driven team running a successful business. You will experience structured team communication, including regular meeting rhythms and individual 1-on-1 development coaching with your Team Leader.
* **Join the Industry Leaders** **-** Perfect for high performers looking to get their foot in the door, learn a practical trade, and build a genuine career path with an industry leader.

**About You:**

* Solid proven achievements. These can be demonstrated in personal goals, sporting or through study and work. We value a successful track record and drive
* A past history demonstrating commitment, reliability, continual improvement and learning.
* Good communication skills and demonstrated success in developing and maintaining good relationships.
* Mechanical aptitude - we will provide on the job training
* Some mechanical experience in a related field is desirable and experienced Bicycle Mechanics are highly valued.

**How to Apply**

Hit the “Apply” button or apply directly through our website

jobs.title: Support Analyst
jobs.description:
**About the Department**

The department provides a wide range of learning and development support and services.

The department provides policy leadership, plans for the future of education in Victoria and leads key cross-sector collaboration. The department plays an important system steward role by providing support, guidance, oversight and assurance across early childhood and school education systems, as well as directly providing school education and 50 new early learning centres.

**About the Division**

The Information Management and Technology Division (IMTD) guides the Departments' digital capability and is leading digital transformation for the Department including Victorian government schools. The division architects manage and support the largest technology network in Victoria, which has a user base of approximately 750,000 staff and students.

IMTD provides innovation and leadership in the transformation and management of the Department's digital capability through the implementation of solutions on the department's cloud environment (IaaS), enterprise cloud platforms (PaaS) and software (SaaS), using agile practices with a focus on user experience, security, and integration.

As a valued member of the diverse IMTD team, you will have the opportunity to be part of influencing the new way of working for the department through your strong technical skills and customer-centric approach.

This position sits in the Early Childhood Education Digital Services Branch. A minimum requirement of 3 days a week in the DE office is required, plus a valid Working with Children Check (E).

**About the Role**

Reporting to the ECE Senior Specialist System Operations, the Support Analyst will join the ECE System Operations team within Early Childhood Digital Services. This role plays a crucial part in supporting applications and systems within the Early Childhood Education sector.

Joining a broader team, this role will be responsible for dealing with user queries and investigations, administering user access, and providing day-to-day support across ECE applications and systems.

The role will provide support to users and stakeholders both internal and external to the Department of Education.

24 month Fixed Term contract

Key activities will include.

* Technical support - record all user support requests, whether received by phone, email, or other methods, ensuring complete information is captured in the ITSM system.
* Providing phone-based support to users of supported systems, addressing inquiries received via dedicated queues active between 9 AM and 5 PM.
* Providing consultation, trouble shooting and advisory service to system

**Senior Policy Officer, Aboriginal Programs**

* *Salary: $116,413 - $140,849 (Plus Superannuation)*

* *Usual work location: Level 31, 121 Exhibition Street, Melbourne Vic 3000 (flexibility may be available)*

**ONLY ABORIGINAL AND TORRES STRAIT ISLANDER PEOPLE ARE ELIGIBLE TO APPLY AS THIS POSITION IS EXEMPT UNDER THE SPECIAL MEASURES PROVISION OF S12(1) OF THE EQUAL OPPORTUNITY ACT (VIC).**

**The Role**

The Senior Policy Officer, Aboriginal Programs will lead a small team to develop a range of initiatives to support First Peoples to participate in sport and active recreation opportunities. The team works with key government agencies, First Peoples community organisations, community members, state sport and recreation organisations, regional sports assemblies, and other key stakeholders to implement the Victorian Aboriginal Sporting Partnership Strategy aimed at improving access and participation outcomes in sport and recreation activities for First Peoples communities across Victoria.

The role requires strong leadership and policy skills, highly developed conceptual and analytical skills, demonstrated government experience and a delivery focus, excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, and a flair for innovation.

**Main accountabilities:**

* Utilise self-determination principles to provide timely analysis and detailed policy advice to SEE senior leaders and other key stakeholders on actions to improve access and participation outcomes for First Peoples communities, including analysis, development and implementation of the Victorian Aboriginal Sporting Partnership.
* Support the provision of high-level policy advice to internal and external stakeholders and prepare and present detailed date and evidence informed reports, ministerial briefs, cabinet and agency submissions on complex matters.
* Initiate, build and maintain positive relationships with key stakeholders to facilitate partnerships and co-investment with the First Peoples community and private sectors, government and representatives of the Victorian community sport and recreation sector to enable the delivery of agreed programs and projects.
* Lead, manage and support a small team to deliver a range of complex policy initiatives, programs and projects and ensure professional, timely and effective delivery.

**The Team**

The position of Project Officer forms a part of the Community Sport and Recreation branch within the Sport and Experience Economy group.

Sport and Experience Economy (SEE) Group delivers programs and initiatives to support positive experiences and a sense of belonging through sport, tourism, events and outdoor recreation - sectors that make Victoria a recognised leader from the grassroots level to the international stage and deliver significant economic, social and health benefits for the state.

This is achieved by supporting the Minister for Tourism, the Minister for Sport, the Minister for Major Events and the Minister for Community Sport in the delivery of sport and tourism infrastructure, and through programs and policies that strengthen the capacity of sport and experience economy organisations, reduce barriers to participation and engagement, support world-class events, and reinforce the role that vibrant sport and experience economy sectors play in growing the Victorian economy, supporting jobs and building stronger communities. We also oversee regulation of the State's hunting, fishing, boating sectors, and support the Professional Boxing and Combat Sports Board in the regulation of professional boxing and combat sports.

**About You**

To be successful in this role, you will have the following main skills and experience:

* **Partnership Negotiation**: Demonstrated experience working with Aboriginal Community Controlled Organisations and planning and facilitating culturally safe engagement processes with Victorian First Peoples; negotiates collaborations across government, community, and private sectors to gain agreement on approaches and formalise delivery partnershipships.
* **Policy and Project Skills**: Formulates and clearly communicates public policy options and recommendations for delivering First Peoples outcomes; manages and leads complex projects, keeps up to date with a broad range of contemporary research and issues relating to First Peoples inclusion, scans for links and potential implications of proposed policy options, provides leadership in the application of concepts to policy development and liaises with stakeholders. Ability to collect, analyse and understand data and information collected from initiatives and apply strategic insights to interpret information, which includes consideration of the broader strategic direction of the organisation.
* **Budget Management and Financial Literacy**: Develops and manages program budgets; considers resources; monitors expenditure against budget projections; plans for and manages risks; ensures the use of honest, transparent and appropriate purchasing processes.
* **Written and Oral Communication**: Prepares briefs, presentations, letters, emails and reports using clear, concise and grammatically correct language; edits written communications to ensure they contain the information necessary to achieve their purpose and meet audience needs; senior experience in facilitating and verbally communiating in government, community and cross sector forums.
* **Leadership and Stakeholder Relations**: Manages a small team and builds relationships with First Peoples community, represents and promotes government priorities, builds a team commitment through professional communication, clear direction, effectively manages team resources to meet deadlines and prioritise work demands, motivates others, creates positive team culture, and manages performance expectations.

**Further Information**

For a confidential discussion, please contact Tess Dryza, Group Manager, Equity, Policy and Engagement on 0408 668 122 or tess.dryza@ecodev.vic.gov.au
