jobs.title: Platform & Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
**About The Commons**

The Commons is an ecosystem of entrepreneurs, businesses, and curious minds working, connecting, and growing under a common roof. Driven by the sincere desire to see people flourish, we support curiosity and believe in the collective power of people to instigate change. Our focus is on building and strengthening community, and we challenge the status quo in an effort to innovate.

As a fast-growing team, we offer endless opportunities for professional development, career progression, and collaboration with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We thrive on creativity, innovation, and a strong team culture that champions fresh ideas and ambitious thinking. If you're looking for a dynamic workplace where no two days are the same, where your contributions truly make an impact, and where you’ll be surrounded by passionate, like-minded individuals - The Commons is the place to be.

**About the role**

We’re looking for a Platform & Integration Engineer to build the technology foundation that connects our business.

We have a growing ecosystem of systems across workspace, health club, hospitality and future businesses. Your job will be to make those systems work together. Reliably, intelligently and in a way that gives us one accurate view of our members and our business.

You’ll design and build the integrations, APIs, data pipelines and internal tools that sit between our systems. You’ll also help establish the foundations we can build on as the business grows: a canonical member identity, a normalised API layer that abstracts away our underlying vendors, and a data warehouse that The Commons genuinely owns.

This is a role with real ownership. You’ll be the person who understands how our systems fit together, makes sure they continue to work, and builds the connections we need as we introduce new technology, new businesses and, increasingly, AI into the way we operate.

**What you’ll be doing**

**Systems & integrations**

* Own the architecture and delivery of integrations across our core business systems.
* Build APIs, data pipelines and automations that move information accurately between systems.
* Be the go-to person when two systems need to talk to each other.
* Monitor, troubleshoot and continuously improve existing integrations.
* Work with third-party vendors to understand their systems, APIs and limitations.

**Data foundations**

* Help build and maintain a data warehouse that gives The Commons a reliable, independent source of truth.
* Develop a shared member identity across systems that don’t naturally share a common key.
* Design sensible approaches to ingesting, storing and modelling data — including raw source data and the messy edge cases that come with real-world systems.
* Use tools such as dbt to build tested, documented and maintainable data transformations.
* Help unlock our data through business intelligence and reporting tools.
* Make sure our data is structured, documented and trustworthy.

**Platform & future projects**

* Lead the technical delivery of platform projects, working closely with leadership and teams across the business.
* Translate business and member needs into practical technical solutions.
* Help evaluate and introduce new tools and technologies as the business evolves.
* Build the foundations for AI-assisted tools and services as they become part of how we work.
* Take ownership from architecture through to delivery, rather than simply handing requirements to someone else.

**About you**

You’re an engineer who enjoys solving problems where there isn’t a neat answer.

You’ve worked with multiple disparate systems and third-party vendors, and you know how to bring them together even when they weren’t designed to work together. You’ve built integrations, data pipelines and APIs, and you’re comfortable owning the architecture as well as getting into the detail of implementation.

You have experience setting up data warehouses or data lakes, including ingesting and retaining raw source data before modelling it. You’re comfortable with tools such as dbt, and understand the importance of testing, documentation and controlled transformations.

You’ve also dealt with identity resolution across systems that don’t share a common identifier, and understand what it takes to create a reliable single view of a customer or member.

Just as importantly, you’re comfortable operating in a business where things aren’t always perfectly defined. You enjoy untangling messy, real-world data just as much as designing clean architecture. You can talk APIs and data models with engineers, then turn around and explain a technical problem clearly to a room full of non-technical stakeholders.

You’re proactive, pragmatic and curious. You spot problems before they become urgent, enjoy variety, and would rather ship something useful in stages than wait for the perfect plan.

**What we're looking for**

* Proven experience integrating complex, disparate systems and third-party platforms.
* Strong experience building APIs, integrations and data pipelines.
* Experience designing or maintaining a data warehouse or data lake.
* Practical experience with data transformation and modelling tools such as dbt.
* Experience with identity resolution or building a shared customer/member identity across systems.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, APIs and system integration patterns.
* A pragmatic approach to engineering — you know when to build, when to simplify and when to improve.
* Excellent communication skills and the confidence to work with stakeholders across the business.
* A genuine interest in emerging technology and the potential of AI to improve how businesses operate.

**Why You’ll Love Working with Us**

At The Commons, you’ll be part of a team that values creativity, collaboration, and growth all within a culture built on community.

We offer:

* Central HQ location
* Hybrid work set up with 1 WFH day per week
* On-site Chef with nutritious lunch provided daily
* Discount on all Commons Cafe and Bar locations
* Free counselling sessions
* Birthday leave
* Ability to work across different locations
* Weekly events program e.g. breakfast club, yoga & drinks
* Additional paid maternity leave
* Further education program to support personal and professional development

**Our Values**

At The Commons, our values guide how we work, collaborate and show up for one another every day. We're looking for people who genuinely embody these values in the way they think, act and contribute.

* Putting Our Members First
* Fostering Community
* Working Together as a Team
* Constantly Learning & Growing

Apply now and help us build something remarkable – together!

#LI-DNI

jobs.title: Application Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Remtron Automation**

Remtron Automation is Schneider Electric's sole certified Industrial Automation Distributor (IAD) in Australia. We design, deliver and commission complete electrical automation and control solutions across a broad, multi-vendor portfolio. Our customers operate complex plant and machinery, and this role turns their process requirements into working, tested and documented automation solutions.

**Location**

Braeside, VIC (Melbourne metropolitan area) - on-site, with travel to customer sites across Victoria and regional NSW

**The opportunity**

This hands-on, customer-facing engineering role covers the full project lifecycle: requirements capture, product selection, control-system design, PLC and HMI software development, drives and motion configuration, industrial-network integration, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), commissioning and ongoing technical support. You will integrate equipment from multiple manufacturers into cohesive and robust solutions and manage projects from concept through prototype and deployment.

**Key responsibilities**

* Develop, configure and validate PLC application software across platforms including Schneider EcoStruxure Machine Expert and Control Expert, B&R Automation Studio, CODESYS for Festo, Allen-Bradley Studio 5000 and CCW, and Siemens TIA Portal/STEP 7.
* Design and build operator HMIs using platforms such as Schneider EOTE and Vijeo Designer, B&R mapp View and Pro-face BLUE.
* Integrate and configure variable speed drives and servo/motion systems, including Schneider Altivar, Festo CMMT-AS/CMMT-ST and B&R ACOPOS.
* Integrate multi-vendor PLCs, HMIs, VSDs, motor-management systems and field devices from suppliers including Phoenix Contact, SICK, Festo and B&R.
* Design and configure industrial networks including EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, B&R POWERLINK, PROFINET, Modbus TCP, Modbus RTU (RS-232/RS-485), OPC UA, IO-Link and MQTT.
* Configure remote I/O, telemetry and secure remote-access gateways, including Phoenix Contact Radioline and Secomea.
* Support functional-safety controller programming and develop complete bills of materials for control systems.
* Plan and execute FAT, document procedures and results, and commission systems on-site and remotely alongside senior engineers.
* Capture customer requirements; prepare turnkey concepts, technical proposals, functional design specifications, test records and reusable templates.
* Provide pre-sales and post-sales support, product demonstrations, customer training, fault diagnosis and application advice.
* Manage projects from concept to prototype, maintain CRM activity and market intelligence, and represent Remtron at supplier and industry events.
* Comply with company procedures and all applicable work health and safety requirements.

**Essential qualifications and experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Robotics or Mechatronics Engineering.
* Demonstrated hands-on PLC programming experience across multiple vendor platforms, including both Schneider EcoStruxure Machine Expert and B&R Automation Studio.
* Demonstrated HMI development experience using relevant industrial HMI platforms.
* Experience integrating and configuring VSDs and servo drives into sequenced-motion and multi-motor control applications.
* Hands-on experience configuring industrial communications across multi-vendor devices, including cross-ecosystem I/O mapping.
* Proven experience integrating PLCs, HMIs, VSDs and field devices into deployed control solutions.
* Experience with remote-access or telemetry hardware and with FAT and on-site/remote commissioning.
* Experience specifying bills of materials, including redundant PLC architectures such as B&R X20.
* Strong technical documentation, organisation, communication and customer-facing skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage projects and travel to customer sites across Victoria and regional NSW.
* Membership of Engineers Australia.

**Highly regarded**

* Festo and Allen-Bradley/Rockwell automation experience.
* Schneider EcoStruxure Machine certification (Machine Control), or willingness to obtain it.
* Robotics or collaborative-robot integration experience, such as Universal Robots or Codian Robotics.
* Python or C# programming, OpenCV machine vision, and SolidWorks/CAD capability.
* Experience in food processing, agriculture, irrigation, materials handling, robotics, advanced manufacturing or building-management systems.

**How to apply**

Please submit your resume and a concise cover letter explaining how your experience meets the essential criteria. Applications should be lodged through this advertisement's application function.

*Remtron Automation is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates.*

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $82,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Events Administrator
jobs.description:
**About Eventiv**

Eventiv is a Melbourne-based event site, safety and operations management consultancy. We deliver site management, risk and safety consultation, and permit administration for festivals, councils and live performance clients across Victoria, including Beyond The Valley, Knox City Council, Maribyrnong City Council and Ultra Music Festival.

**About the Role**

This role provides dedicated administrative and on-site operational support to the Director across the summer season, ranging from venue-based risk & safety systems through to full site and operations management of major music festivals and events.

Workload builds through the season: a light administrative footprint over spring while permit and consultation work ramps up, growing to full-time from November as the peak summer festival period begins. The role is well suited to someone who wants a genuine season-long commitment with excellent exposure to a range of festivals and events, working alongside a diverse crew. The role could be worked around other contracts or studies if desired.

**Key duties and responsibilities**

Enquiries & correspondence

* Respond to email and phone enquiries from clients, contractors and the public on behalf of Eventiv, escalating to the Director where needed
* Track stakeholder correspondence and proactively follow up outstanding items so nothing stalls waiting on a reply
* Maintain contact lists and stakeholder databases across all active projects

Meetings & stakeholder coordination

* Coordinate meeting logistics, prepare agendas and circulate pre-reads for client and contractor meetings
* Attend meetings and take accurate minutes, distributing action items and tracking them through to completion
* Liaise with council officers, venue operators and client representatives to keep projects moving to schedule

Document control & permits

* Manage version control, copy editing and formatting of proposals, schedules, site plans and other client-facing documents to a consistent professional standard
* Administer permit applications and track submissions through to approval and sign-off
* Coordinate dangerous-goods and other regulatory compliance submissions where required

Contractor onboarding & compliance tracking

* Collect, check and file contractor insurance certificates, SWMS and other compliance documentation
* Track induction completion and site access records for crew and contractors ahead of bump-in
* Flag expired or missing documentation early enough to resolve before it becomes a site issue

Financial administration

* Maintain and update event budgets, tracking commitments and actuals against them
* Raise purchase orders and process and reconcile invoices, keeping a clean paper trail for each event
* Support end-of-event financial reconciliation and reporting to the Director

Scheduling & bump-in/bump-out support

* Build and maintain run sheets, production schedules and crew rosters
* Support bump-in and bump-out logistics coordination, including deliveries and site access scheduling
* Track schedule changes and communicate updates promptly to affected stakeholders

On-site operations

* Set up and staff the site office as the administrative and communications hub during build, show and break
* Operate radio communications and act as first point of contact for crew and contractor queries
* Provide production runner support and hold the ops desk across show days
* Maintain incident, near-miss and daily diary logs, keeping compliance records current on-site
* Undertake first-line problem-solving so issues reach the Director already triaged, not raw

**Selection criteria**

Essential

* Confident working across Google Docs, Sheets and the wider Google Workspace platform and/or Microsoft Office
* Experience with Asana or Monday.com, or a comparable project/task management tool
* Good literacy and numeracy skills, with high attention to detail in written correspondence and financial records
* Excellent interpersonal skills — comfortable liaising with clients, councils, contractors and crew
* Ability to work autonomously with minimal supervision, prioritising a variable workload across multiple concurrent projects
* Willingness and availability to work on-site during bump-in, show and bump-out, including some evenings, weekends and public holidays during peak season (Nov–Apr)
* Current driver's licence and own transport (regional travel required for some events)

Desirable

* Prior experience in events, festivals, live performance or venue operations administration
* Familiarity with WHS documentation — SWMS, inductions, permits — in an events or construction-adjacent context
* Experience with budget tracking, purchase orders or basic bookkeeping
* Current Working with Children Check, or willingness to obtain one

**Working conditions**

* This is a variable-hours role: weekly days move from 3 to 5 across the contract, tracking Eventiv's event calendar (see Hours & Schedule). Hours are agreed and rostered monthly in advance wherever possible.
* December through March is the peak delivery period across multiple concurrent events; overtime is likely during this window. Overtime will be paid in accordance with the Award, or banked as time off in lieu (TOIL) under a written agreement, with TOIL typically taken down in April–May.
* On-site work requires standing for extended periods, some physical handling of event materials, and working outdoors in variable weather.
* The role holder is expected to maintain professional, calm communication during live show conditions.
* The employer is an equal opportunity employer, and would happily discuss working with an applicant to overcome any barriers to entry and work through specifics.

**Equipment & tools provided**

* Eventiv will provide a two-way radio and any event-specific PPE required for on-site work
* Travel to venues outside the Melbourne metro area (e.g. Pitch in Ararat) will be reimbursed at the ATO cents-per-kilometre rate
* Accommodation would be provided for events outside of Melbourne as per the award
* The role holder will need their own laptop, phone and reliable transport

**Probation & review**

This role includes a 6-week probation period from the contract start date, with a formal check-in at 6 weeks and again at 3 months. Performance will be reviewed informally throughout the season, with a structured end-of-season review ahead of any decision to renew for 2027–28.

jobs.title: Senior Autonomy Engineer
jobs.description:
The Bigger Picture

At Andromeda, we're building the social intelligence layer for humanoid robots - technology that allows robots to understand people, build relationships and become a meaningful part of everyday life.

Our first robot, Abi, is already doing this in aged care and healthcare, where she brings conversation, companionship and engagement to people every day.

Now we're scaling from early deployments into a platform that can operate across thousands of real-world environments. We're looking for individuals who want to tackle hard problems across robotics and AI, and help define what it means for robots to live and interact alongside people.

Our Values

* Empathy – Kindness and compassion are at the heart of everything we do.
* Play – Play sharpens focus. It keeps us curious, fast and obsessed with the craft.
* Never Settle – A relentless ambition, bias toward action, and uncomfortable levels of curiosity.
* Tenacity – Tenacious under pressure, we assume chaos and stay in motion to adapt and progress.
* Unity – Different minds. Shared mission. No passengers.

The Role: The Autonomy team’s Mission: Give Abi the Freedom to Move

We are looking for a first-principles Autonomy Engineer to solve one of the hardest challenges in robotics: enabling our robot, Abi, to navigate safely and gracefully alongside people. This role goes beyond simple A-to-B navigation, and the work will directly shape the future of Andromeda autonomy stack. You will be responsible for improving the capabilities of the autonomy stack from a safety, reliability, and usability standpoint. This is a hands-on senior role centre on safety-critical systems, fault tolerance, and resilient autonomy in demanding human-centric environments. As such engineering excellence, safety, and reliability sit at the heart of everything you do.

This is a chance to build a production-grade autonomy stack from the ground up and ship a product that has a meaningful impact on people's lives.

What You'll Do

* Build and Maintain Foundational Autonomy: You will design, implement, and maintain the foundational autonomy stack of Abi. This will involve working on path planning, SLAM, collision avoidance, and incorporating classification signals from the perception stack to help make foundational autonomy decisions.
* Production Deployed Foundational Autonomy: You will help harden the deployed autonomy stack. Build, develop and execute tests on software, hardware and integrated systems.
* Maintaining a Fleet of Autonomous Systems: You will help with maintaining a large fleet of Abis in a customer environment. You will help with improving the operational process of deploying Abi to different production environments. You will have to perform customer site visits to test and validate developed features.
* Hardware Integration: You will regularly have to be hands-on with Abi - debugging the sensors and effectors for root cause analysis, as well working with hardware to make specific sensor recommendations and debug issues down to the hardware layer.
* Improving User Experience: You will work on improving the overall user experience of using the autonomy systems. This will range from interfacing the autonomy stack with cloud infrastructure to interfacing the autonomy stack with the robot front end.
* Systems Engineering: You will be working on a robotics platform which has multiple internal and external consumers, bringing rise to requirements gathering. This will involve you having to follow the full product development lifecycle.
* Simulation & Validation: You will build and maintain high-fidelity simulation scenarios in IssacSim to test foundational autonomy end to end, ensuring our software is validated in simulation before it is deployed to hardware.
* Effective Technical Communication and Leadership: You will have to communicate complex technical ideas, lead cross-functional discussions, and work on projects between multidisciplinary teams.

**Requirements**

**What Success Looks Like**

In the first 90 days, you will understand Abi’s autonomy stack, how Abi behaves in the field, and where the reliability and safety risks sit - and you will be shipping improvements to the edge software with confidence. You will also gain an understanding of areas of Abi’s usability that can be improved with the autonomy stack.

Over the first 12 months, success means the edge software is more reliable, safer, and easier to debug in the field: safety mechanisms you can trust, incorporation of perception signals for core decision making in human-centric environments, and improved test and observability frameworks. Success also entails significantly enhanced usability of autonomy-enabled Abi’s in the customer sites, alongside a more robust and streamlined production deployment pipeline.

What You'll Bring

* Deep Expertise in Robotics: You have 5+ years of experience working on the motion planning, prediction, or behaviours stack for autonomous vehicles, mobile robots, or a similar domain. You have experience deploying ML based autonomy solutions in a production environment.
* Strong Algorithmic Foundation: You have deployed and tuned modern robotics algorithms in a production environment. You have a deep understanding of classical control as well as modern ML based algorithms.
* Production Software Engineering: You have a proven ability to ship robust, high-quality code in modern C++ and are proficient with Python for tooling and data analysis. Experience with large-scale, performance-critical, distributed software systems is essential.
* First-Principles Thinking: You are skilled at breaking down complex, ambiguous problems into clear, solvable components. You are comfortable building systems from scratch and can reason about them from a fundamental physics and mathematics perspective.
* Full-Stack Robotics Exposure: You understand how your components interact with the entire robotics system, everything from perception through policy to actuation.
* Startup Experience: You have previously worked in a startup and are able to wear multiple hats. You are a self starter and are able to problem solve with ambiguous requirements.

Bonus Points

* Experience working with Nix based systems
* Experience with ROS/ROS2
* Experience with developing and deploying AI based features for autonomous systems
* Experience with optimising software for edge compute
* Experience with working on Jetson based systems
* A background in formal verification or safety-critical systems engineering.
* Experience building and scaling data infrastructure (e.g., fleet logging, event-triggered data collection, and automated evaluation).
* You have worked with deployed ground autonomous vehicles before
* You have developed and utilised a simulation framework before
* You have experience with computer vision based navigation systems

**Benefits**

The salary for this position may vary depending on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package may also include additional benefits or components based on the specific role. Details will be provided if an employment offer is made.

If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, that’s okay … we encourage you to apply. At Andromeda Robotics, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Let’s build the future together.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

**Please note: At this time, we are generally not offering visa sponsorship for this role.**

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Designer / Drafter
jobs.description:
**Sequana Group is one of the fastest-growing & independent water, energy, and environment-focused infrastructure advisory firms in Australia, with a growing International presence.** Home to 250+ experts, with offices in Melbourne, Sydney, Port Macquarie, Brisbane, and Perth, we work with both the private sector and government organisations to **break the mould and redefine the future of Australia’s major water, environment and energy projects.** We are committed to delivering exceptional results for our clients throughout all stages of a project and beyond.

This particular role sits with Atlas (a Sequana Group Company), our brownfield water and wastewater specialist. Atlas focuses on improving delivery success across the full lifecycle, from condition assessment and optimisation through to renewal and upgrade delivery. Since 2011, their teams have delivered programs **95% on time, 98% on budget**, with over **$100m in TOTEX savings**, by bringing together senior, cross-functional expertise across design, construction, maintenance and delivery management.

Atlas are currently hiring for a Senior Mechanical Designer / Drafter position.

**WHAT YOU DO**

Atlas finds smarter and better ways for our clients to deliver, operate and maintain infrastructure, and in doing so positively impact the world around us. That is how our people build long-lasting relationships and deliver great business outcomes for our clients and partners.

Working as a Senior Mechanical Designer / Drafter position, you will own your discipline's design deliverables on a project. You are the person the engineering team and the project manager rely on for drawing quality, BIM compliance and information integrity across the full design phase. You will actively contribute to that value through the quality of your outputs, the efficiency of your workflows and the way you coordinate with the broader team.

* Owning the full drawing deliverable scope on water and wastewater projects; managing drawing registers, revision control, QA processes and client submission packages.
* Coordinating and managing the production of the 3D model and 2D drawing packages; directing drafting staff and sub-contractors to complete documentation to the required standard.
* Preparing and maintaining project-specific Digital Engineering Execution Plans (DEXP) and Master Information Delivery Plans (MIDP) and keeping them current at every delivery milestone.
* Attending site to understand site conditions, resolve drawing queries and capture as-built information accurately.
* Performing ACC project audits at each delivery milestone including checking digital data housekeeping, drawing standards compliance and information completeness.
* Using Recap, LiDAR and point cloud data to accurately represent existing asset conditions in design models.
* Reviewing and signing off the work of Designers and Trainee Designers by providing direct, useful feedback and maintaining Atlas quality standards.
* Working with engineers to interpret design intent and translate it accurately into drawing and model deliverables that serve construction teams and asset owners.
* Exporting intelligent data from BIM models to support engineers with quantities, specifications and procurement inputs.
* Producing detailed 2D CAD drawings and 3D models for water and wastewater projects, working to client drawing office procedures, AS1100 and Atlas BIM standards.
* Creating 2D drawings from 3D models and modifying designs to solve problems, working within the constraints of live assets.

**WHO YOU ARE**

Candidates should possess:

**Minimum Qualifications and Experience:**

jobs.title: Senior Security Platform Engineer - DevSecOps
jobs.description:
**Date:** 24 Aug 2026

**Location:** Melbourne, Australia

**#job-location.job-location-inline { display:** inline; }

**Company:** Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

We are seeking a Senior Security Platform Engineer – DevSecOps to lead application security engineering and DevSecOps uplift across Optus. You’ll work closely with development, platform, architecture and security teams to embed secure-by-default practices across the software development lifecycle, automate security controls and improve the way teams deliver secure software.

If you thrive in a hands-on senior role where you can shape AppSec strategy, provide technical leadership, mentor engineers and turn security requirements into practical, reusable controls, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Lead and enhance DevSecOps and secure software development lifecycle practices.

Embed security testing into development workflows.

Automate security, compliance, and software supply chain controls using policy-as-code.

Provide security expertise through code reviews, architecture reviews, and developer support.

Build and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines with automated controls, quality gates, and assurance.

Drive security automation, platform management, governance, and continuous improvement across cloud and application environments.

WHAT MAKES YOU PERFECT FOR THE ROLE?

Relevant qualification in IT, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent industry experience.

5+ years' experience in DevOps, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD pipeline development.

Strong scripting and automation expertise using Python, Bash, PowerShell, APIs, and GitOps practices.

Hands-on experience with application security, vulnerability management, and shift-left security.

Proficiency in CI/CD governance, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), Policy-as-Code, repository management, and security compliance automation.

Strong leadership, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills with a focus on automation, continuous improvement, and developer enablement.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.

Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.

Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.

We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.

Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).

Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. jobs.title: Senior Scientist, Mass Spectrometry (MS)
jobs.description:
**Entity:** CSL Behring

**Job Category:** Research Development & Sciences

**Job Family:** Discovery & Product Development

**Job Type:** Full Time

**Location****:** Melbourne, Victoria, Australia

**Employer Reference:** R-287926

**Job Description**

CSL is looking for a Senior Scientist – Mass Spectrometry (MS) to join the Molecular Characterisation and Method development cross- IPT at CSL’s global headquarters in the heart of Melbourne’s biomedical precinct.

Reporting to the Associate Director – Molecular Characterisation, you will provide leadership and contribute the development, implementation and maintenance of key mass spectrometry-based robust and scalable analytical methods in support of product development activities within the TechOps function. You will plan and conduct mass spectrometry-based studies supporting characterisation of biomolecules including identification and quantification of product and process-related variants, impurities, and/or cell culture media profiling.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and refine industry-standard product characterisation workflows to support recombinant and plasma derived biotherapeutic characterisation, integrating MS data analytics pipelines with regulatory guidelines to support product development activities
* Employ a combination of MS-based and non-MS based protein analytical techniques to identify, characterise and correlate post-translational modifications and their associated heterogeneities in recombinant proteins with particular emphasis on those affecting product efficacy and safety including product comparability assessment
* Perform housekeeping and maintenance of state-of-art instruments available in the mass spectrometry core lab as required, supporting general and functional characterisation of recombinant proteins
* Contribute to the planning, performance, evaluation and reporting of scientific experiments at the highest levels of scientific integrity
* Present results from both independent and collaborative laboratory work to internal and external stakeholders as needed. This includes explaining highly complex or technical information to facilitate the smooth progress of CSL projects
* Develop and maintain effective working relationships across other IPTs within the TechOps, global research, and other stakeholders
* Provide leadership, training and technical MS expertise to team members
* Ensure the highest level of data integrity by complying with relevant scientific and data standards (e.g. ELN, Veeva, structured data capture, etc.).

**Qualifications, Skills and Experience**

* Postgraduate degree (preferably PhD, M.Sc. or equivalent degree) and/or experience in a relevant discipline
* 8+ years relevant industry or equivalent experience with B.Sc. 6+ years relevant industry or equivalent experience with M.Sc. or 2+ years with a PhD in the field of mass spectrometry-based protein characterisation
* Demonstrated experience in analytical chemistry with a strong background in protein characterisation using various separation techniques with hyphenated mass spectrometry-based techniques and classical approaches such as SDS- PAGE, western blotting, and electrophoresis
* Extensive experience in operating and maintaining mass spectrometry instrumentation, particularly as applied to protein, peptide, and glycan analysis (e.g. ESI-MS/MS, MALDI-MS/MS, good knowledge of qTOF’s, QqQ, and Orbitrap instruments). Prior experience of cell culture media and metabolite profiling would be a plus
* Proficient in mass spectrometry data analysis tools, specifically in-depth protein characterisation, cell culture nutrient and metabolite profiling, product attribute validation and monitoring. Ability to perform additional data analytics and visualisation using R or Python would be advantageous
* Ability to establish and adhere to project timelines
* Effective time management skills and ability to work/lead in a cross-functional, multi-disciplinary team environment
* Attention to detail with excellent written (technical/scientific) and oral communication skills, including the ability to convey new concepts to other staff members

Closing date for applications Monday 7th September 2026

**About CSL Behring**

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients' needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world's largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/.

**You Belong at CSL**

At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.

* **Salary range: $113,668 - $131,153 plus super**

**About the role**

The Data Engineer is responsible for ensuring the integrity, reliability, and accessibility of Victoria Legal Aid's (VLA) advanced data infrastructure. This role involves identifying and resolving data quality issues, collaborating across teams to diagnose problems and help implement solutions. The Data Engineer is essential for upholding high standards of data quality and availability, ensuring that VLA's advanced data infrastructure is fully leveraged to support informed decision-making.

*This role is based at our Melbourne CBD office on Wurundjeri Country.*

* Proven ability to translate complex business needs and operational contexts into effective data models within a data warehouse environment.

### **Description & Requirements**

Working with our customers at Australia Post isn't just about helping Australians post, shop, bank or pay bills. It's also about helping Aussie businesses service their own customers, keeping millions of people connected and building community resilience. That’s a big responsibility, but you're the go-to teams with the know-how, delivering essential and excellent service for people every day.

**About the opportunity**

As our Retail Postage Sorter, you’ll play an important part in keeping millions of Australians connected. As you’d expect, plenty of mail and parcels comes through our Post Offices and delivery facilities every day – and our mail sorting teams make sure every delivery gets where it needs to.

**Role Details**

* Extensive, supportive training is provided in the Post Office on commencement in the role
* Casual position, "On Call" after Training, your roster will include a mix of both scheduled and unscheduled shifts, Monday to Friday, between the hours of 6:30 am and 5:00 pm

**You’ll be**

* Manually sorting all mail and parcels arriving at the workplace

**About you**

* You’re a friendly, enthusiastic and reliable personality who loves working in a team environment.
You’re motivated by the opportunity to help make a difference to your community.

**You’ll also need to**

* Call upon your memory and hand-eye coordination while sorting
* Be fit to lift up to 16kgs of mail and parcels regularly and stand for your shift

**What else is in it for you?**

* Work with a diverse, supportive team where you have opportunity to connect and collaborate every day
* Be at the heart of the Australian and local community, helping to keep families and friends connected or businesses connected with their customers
* Opportunities for training, growth and development in customer experience or other areas of the business
* Discounts and offers on lots of your favourite brands via Post Perks for more cash in your pocket, plus access to other health and wellbeing resources

**All walks, one route**

It takes a lot of us to deliver for every Australian – and it’s important to us that our people behind the parcels reflect the people receiving them. We come from all walks. Different backgrounds, different ages, different genders, different sexualities and different abilities, but we all believe in the same purpose.

**Job Description**

### **About the role**

The Customer Service Attendant (CSA) is part of the frontline team ensuring passengers, terminal visitors and other stakeholders experience smooth, safe, and secure terminal operations every day.

As the face and voice of operations, the customer service team are vital in delivering a welcoming, efficient, and professional experience. This role involves a diverse range of responsibilities, with a primary focus on ticketing ferry customers, monitoring incoming calls and emails, sales and service, maintaining security of restricted terminal areas, monitoring parking, assisting customers and ensuring smooth vehicle flow.

The CSA is an essential link between shoreside and on-board operations liaising closely with vessel crew to ensure vehicle space is maximised on board, and on-time departures of all services.

### **Key responsibilities**

* Provide customer service to passengers, retail customers, general public, visitors and other stakeholders
* Process vehicle and foot passenger ticket sales — face-to-face, online and over the phone
* Handle incoming calls – responding to enquiries, making bookings, forwarding calls to appropriate staff
* Monitor general enquiries email – responding to enquiries, making bookings, forwarding emails to appropriate staff
* Process cash handling, EFTPOS reconciliation, and safe cash management during opening and closing procedures
* Perform traffic control within the terminal grounds, boarding lanes and vehicle entry lanes
* Check in ferry passengers and assist with boarding process
* Maintain retail merchandise displays, provide customer assistance, and process retail transactions
* Maintain cleanliness and tidiness of reception areas, customer service counter areas, passenger lounges and retail spaces
* Monitor and report security and operational issues

### **About you**

* Current National Police Check (if 18 or over) (or willingness to obtain and provide within 21 days of commencing employment)
* Prior experience in a customer service role
* Proficiency in handling cash and using EFTPOS
* Knowledge of the local area and other nearby tourism locations
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft suite products (e.g. Office, Teams, Excel, Word)
* Ability to foster positive relationships across all levels of the organisation and with customers
* Confidence and professionalism when engaging with members of the public
* Proven ability to work collaboratively
* Punctual, reliable, and adaptable to changing circumstances
* Willingness and commitment to work rotating shifts, including weekends and public holidays

### **About us**

The Searoad Ferries Group of Companies employs over 250 dedicated staff and proudly serves approximately one million customers each year. Since 1987, we have successfully operated the iconic Queenscliff-Sorrento car and passenger ferry service, becoming a vital link between the Bellarine Peninsula and the Mornington Peninsula. In addition to core ferry operations, the Explore Australia / Naturaliste Tours division offers memorable tourism and wildlife experiences across Victoria, showcasing the region's most spectacular natural attractions. The network also includes the Western Port Ferry service, connecting Crib Point to French Island and Phillip Island in Western Port Bay, as well as Wanderer Adventures—Wilson's Promontory Cruises—based in the stunning Wilsons Promontory National Park.

The Searoad Ferries Customer Service Team plays a crucial front-line role, dedicated to delivering outstanding customer experiences. Operating 365 days a year from the beautiful coastal locations of Queenscliff and Sorrento, team members are committed to ensuring every customer's journey is safe, enjoyable, and memorable.

**Join Banyule’s Transport and Engineering team as our Senior Development Engineer**

Banyule City Council is seeking an experienced and customer-focused Senior Development Engineer to join our Transport and Engineering Department. This is an opportunity to apply your civil, drainage and development engineering expertise in a role that supports quality development outcomes, effective stormwater management and positive outcomes for our community.

**About the role**

In this role, you will assess the engineering components of residential, commercial and industrial developments and subdivisions, with a strong focus on stormwater drainage, flood risk, water-sensitive urban design and compliance with relevant legislation, Council policies, standards and specifications.

You will work closely with internal teams, developers, consultants, government agencies and community members, providing clear technical advice and helping to resolve development and drainage-related matters in a professional and timely way.

**What you'll be doing**

Reporting to the Development Engineering Team Leader, the Senior Development Engineer will provide professional drainage and civil development engineering advice and support the effective management of development and drainage-related applications, tasks and customer enquiries. You’ll:

* **Support the Development Engineering Team Leader in the management, allocation, and timely completion of development and drainage-related applications, tasks, and customer enquiries.**
* **Investigate, assess and resolve drainage and drainage-related issues raised by the community, Council and external authorities, including consultation with relevant stakeholders and evaluation of options and solutions.**
* **Provide development, drainage and technical advice and expertise to the general community, Councillors, the development Engineering team and other Council Departments.**
* **Deliver high-quality customer service by providing timely, professional and accurate responses to enquiries, correspondence, complaints, consultations, and requests relating to drainage and development engineering matters.**

**About you**

**We are looking for a capable and collaborative engineering professional who can apply sound judgement, communicate complex technical matters clearly and manage competing priorities in a busy local government environment. You’ll bring:**

* **A degree in civil engineering or an equivalent engineering qualification recognised by the Institution of Engineers Australia.**
* **Demonstrated 5+ years of engineering experience in a relevant field, preferably local government, including development and land subdivision approvals (specifically drainage component), planning referrals, engineering design, on-site investigations, and project management.**
* **Proven ability to effectively communicate complex developments and drainage issues, recommendations, and decisions to leaders and internal/external stakeholders.**
* **Demonstrated experience in undertaking hydraulics and hydrology, conventional drainage design, and flood mapping/modelling development and computation.**
* **Sound knowledge of acts, regulations and policies relating to development/subdivision and drainage engineering.**

**Pre-employment requirements**

* **Drivers license**
* **A certificate of professional engineering registration/or eligible to obtain within three months of commencement of the role as required under the professional engineer's registration.**

jobs.title: Consulting Director
jobs.description:
**Job description**

**About InfoConsulting**

InfoConsulting is one of the fastest growing consulting companies operating internationally in the field of technology and management. We work with the latest ERP technologies, addressing the real needs of our clients, and improving the efficiency of their operations. We are systematically and dynamically expanding into new countries. Thanks to the work of our experts and their professional approach to business, we are an IFS Elite Partner, repeatedly awarded the title of *IFS Partner of the Year*.

At InfoConsulting, we combine diverse experience and skills, creating an environment based on collaboration, responsibility, and openness. We value professionalism, commitment, creativity, and trust — values that inspire the way we collaborate and support each other every day in all the countries we operate in.

Join a team of experts who strive together to achieve ambitious goals and transform the way companies operate around the world.

**About the role**

We are looking for a **Consulting Director** to take full ownership of our implementation team, which will consist of almost 20 consultants by the end of 2026.

This is a senior, high-autonomy role reporting directly to our Managing Director ANZ. You will own delivery outcomes end-to-end across every active engagement and build the team structure, methodology and career pathways. The role will take ownership of day-to-day delivery leadership, protect margin and client satisfaction across live engagements, and build the operating rhythm.

**Job requirements**

**What you will be responsible for:**

* **Strategic & P&L Leadership**

You will own the consulting P&L with accountability for revenue and cost drivers and be measured against project margin performance and team billable utilisation. You will set and monitor consulting-level targets in partnership with the Managing Director, shape the medium-term strategy, and make build-vs-buy and resourcing investment recommendations to protect margin and delivery capacity.

As a member of the executive team, you will also contribute directly to company vision, strategic direction and cross-functional decisions beyond the consulting practice.

* **Delivery leadership and Quality**

You will be accountable for delivery quality, risk and commercial performance across every active client engagement, and be the senior escalation point for at-risk engagements, intervening to protect client relationships and margin.

You will establish and maintain a consistent delivery methodology, governance model and quality assurance framework, balance capacity planning and skills fit, and ensure engagements are appropriately scoped and staffed, working closely with the sales team during the sell cycle.

* **People leadership and team development**

You will provide direct leadership to Team Leads and Project Managers, with overall leadership accountability for the full delivery team of approximately 20 consultants and growing.

You will own resourcing end-to-end – the sole decision-maker for who is staffed where, how competing project demands are prioritised, and when consultants are reassigned.

* **Client and Stakeholder Management**

You will act as the senior delivery relationship owner for our most strategic and complex client accounts, representing InfoConsulting in steering committees, executive briefings and escalation conversations with client sponsors – including CFOs, COOs, Heads of Asset Management and Field Service Directors.

You will be a partner with sales and account management on renewals, expansions and reference-ability of delivered engagements, and ensure consistent, transparent reporting to clients on programme health, risk and value delivered.

* **Business development contribution**

You will support scoping, solutioning and commercial input on new opportunities and renewals, ensuring proposals are deliverable at the quoted margin. You will contribute delivery credibility to the sales cycle for complex or strategic pursuits – client meetings, solution workshops and proposal defence – and identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts based on delivery relationships and engagement performance.

* **Governance, Risk and Continuous Improvement**

You will establish standards for project governance, documentation, risk logs and quality gates; monitor delivery risk across the portfolio and maintain an early-warning view for the Managing Director on any engagement in difficulty; and drive continuous improvement in delivery methodology, tooling and reusable assets – accelerators, templates and playbooks – specific to our engagements.

**What success looks like**

We want expectations to be clear from the beginning. Your performance will be measured against project margin and team billable utilisation, with qualitative and strategic measures agreed with the Managing Director.

**At 90 days**

* You have completed a full review of active engagements, margins and resourcing, and surfaced and stabilised any at-risk delivery.

* You have established visibility over utilisation, forecast accuracy and consultant workload across the team.
* You have built a trusted working relationship with the Managing Director, Project Managers, Team Leads and key clients.
* You have identified quick wins in delivery methodology, quality assurance or resourcing process.

**At 12 months**

* The consulting P&L is transparent, forecastable, and trending toward agreed margin targets.
* A consistent delivery methodology and quality framework is in place and adopted across engagements.
* A clear team structure exists with defined career paths, reducing key-person and attrition risk.
* You are recognised by clients as the senior escalation point and trusted delivery authority.
* A credible growth plan – capability, headcount, service lines – is agreed with the Managing Director.

**You are likely to do well in this role if**

* You have led a consulting delivery function of comparable or larger scale – people and P&L – ideally within ERP, EAM, FSM or adjacent enterprise software consulting,
* You are comfortable being the most senior delivery voice in the business, operating with significant autonomy while reporting into the Managing Director,
* You can balance commercial discipline – margin, utilisation, forecasting – with genuine people leadership at a ~20-person scale,
* You are credible in front of clients in asset-intensive industries, able to hold your own with CFOs, COOs, Heads of Asset Management or Field Service Directors,
* You have experience acting as a senior escalation point on complex, client-critical engagements, and resolving them,

* You have direct experience with one or more ERP/EAM/FSM platforms, such as IBM Maximo, SAP, IFS, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, ServiceMax or Salesforce Field Service, and have experience building or scaling a consulting practice through a significant growth phase.

* You are based in Brisbane or Melburne, although candidates from anywhere in Australia will be considered for this fully remote role.

Formal qualifications in engineering, IT, business or a related field are highly regarded but not required where experience demonstrates equivalent capability.

**Our practice is growing**

Potential headcount growth of 30–40% through 2027, and increasingly complex, enterprise-scale engagements. This role is built for someone who wants to build a consulting delivery team, not just staff one.

**What we offer**

* **Executive Standing**

Part of the executive team from day one, with a direct voice in company vision and strategic direction – not just practice-level decisions.

* **A practice built around you**

Sole decision-making authority over resourcing across the delivery team, and the mandate to build the operating rhythm – methodology, governance, quality assurance and career pathing – that a team of this size and growth trajectory needs.

* **Enterprise-calibre clients**

Work with clients across energy, utilities, resources, engineering, construction and infrastructure – sectors where delivery reliability matters as much as the solution itself, and enterprise customers expect quality outcomes on genuinely complex work.

* **Fully remote work**

You can work from anywhere in Australia.

Our Australian office is located on Edward Street in Brisbane, but you do not need to live nearby.

* **Transparent recruitment and assessment**

Every candidate completing the assessment works from the same brief and is evaluated against the same written criteria.

At InfoConsulting, we combine diverse experience and skills, creating an environment based on collaboration, responsibility, and openness. We value professionalism, commitment, creativity, and trust — values that inspire the way we collaborate and support each other every day in all the countries we operate in.

Join a team of experts who strive together to achieve ambitious goals and transform the way companies operate around the world.

**About the role**

We are looking for a **Consulting Director** to take full ownership of our implementation team, which will consist of almost 20 consultants by the end of 2026.

This is a senior, high-autonomy role reporting directly to our Managing Director ANZ. You will own delivery outcomes end-to-end across every active engagement and build the team structure, methodology and career pathways. The role will take ownership of day-to-day delivery leadership, protect margin and client satisfaction across live engagements, and build the operating rhythm.

**What you will be responsible for:**

* **Strategic & P&L Leadership**

You will own the consulting P&L with accountability for revenue and cost drivers and be measured against project margin performance and team billable utilisation. You will set and monitor consulting-level targets in partnership with the Managing Director, shape the medium-term strategy, and make build-vs-buy and resourcing investment recommendations to protect margin and delivery capacity.

As a member of the executive team, you will also contribute directly to company vision, strategic direction and cross-functional decisions beyond the consulting practice.

* **Delivery leadership and Quality**

You will be accountable for delivery quality, risk and commercial performance across every active client engagement, and be the senior escalation point for at-risk engagements, intervening to protect client relationships and margin.

You will establish and maintain a consistent delivery methodology, governance model and quality assurance framework, balance capacity planning and skills fit, and ensure engagements are appropriately scoped and staffed, working closely with the sales team during the sell cycle.

* **People leadership and team development**

You will provide direct leadership to Team Leads and Project Managers, with overall leadership accountability for the full delivery team of approximately 20 consultants and growing.

You will own resourcing end-to-end – the sole decision-maker for who is staffed where, how competing project demands are prioritised, and when consultants are reassigned.

* **Client and Stakeholder Management**

You will act as the senior delivery relationship owner for our most strategic and complex client accounts, representing InfoConsulting in steering committees, executive briefings and escalation conversations with client sponsors – including CFOs, COOs, Heads of Asset Management and Field Service Directors.

You will be a partner with sales and account management on renewals, expansions and reference-ability of delivered engagements, and ensure consistent, transparent reporting to clients on programme health, risk and value delivered.

* **Business development contribution**

You will support scoping, solutioning and commercial input on new opportunities and renewals, ensuring proposals are deliverable at the quoted margin. You will contribute delivery credibility to the sales cycle for complex or strategic pursuits – client meetings, solution workshops and proposal defence – and identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts based on delivery relationships and engagement performance.

* **Governance, Risk and Continuous Improvement**

You will establish standards for project governance, documentation, risk logs and quality gates; monitor delivery risk across the portfolio and maintain an early-warning view for the Managing Director on any engagement in difficulty; and drive continuous improvement in delivery methodology, tooling and reusable assets – accelerators, templates and playbooks – specific to our engagements.

**What success looks like**

We want expectations to be clear from the beginning. Your performance will be measured against project margin and team billable utilisation, with qualitative and strategic measures agreed with the Managing Director.

**At 90 days**

* You have completed a full review of active engagements, margins and resourcing, and surfaced and stabilised any at-risk delivery.

* You have established visibility over utilisation, forecast accuracy and consultant workload across the team.
* You have built a trusted working relationship with the Managing Director, Project Managers, Team Leads and key clients.
* You have identified quick wins in delivery methodology, quality assurance or resourcing process.

**At 12 months**

* The consulting P&L is transparent, forecastable, and trending toward agreed margin targets.
* A consistent delivery methodology and quality framework is in place and adopted across engagements.
* A clear team structure exists with defined career paths, reducing key-person and attrition risk.
* You are recognised by clients as the senior escalation point and trusted delivery authority.
* A credible growth plan – capability, headcount, service lines – is agreed with the Managing Director.

**You are likely to do well in this role if**

* You have led a consulting delivery function of comparable or larger scale – people and P&L – ideally within ERP, EAM, FSM or adjacent enterprise software consulting,
* You are comfortable being the most senior delivery voice in the business, operating with significant autonomy while reporting into the Managing Director,
* You can balance commercial discipline – margin, utilisation, forecasting – with genuine people leadership at a ~20-person scale,
* You are credible in front of clients in asset-intensive industries, able to hold your own with CFOs, COOs, Heads of Asset Management or Field Service Directors,
* You have experience acting as a senior escalation point on complex, client-critical engagements, and resolving them,
* You have direct experience with one or more ERP/EAM/FSM platforms, such as IBM Maximo, SAP, IFS, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, ServiceMax or Salesforce Field Service, and have experience building or scaling a consulting practice through a significant growth phase.
* You are based in Brisbane or Melburne, although candidates from anywhere in Australia will be considered for this fully remote role.

Formal qualifications in engineering, IT, business or a related field are highly regarded but not required where experience demonstrates equivalent capability.

**Our practice is growing**

Potential headcount growth of 30–40% through 2027, and increasingly complex, enterprise-scale engagements. This role is built for someone who wants to build a consulting delivery team, not just staff one.

**What we offer**

* **Executive Standing**

Part of the executive team from day one, with a direct voice in company vision and strategic direction – not just practice-level decisions.

* **A practice built around you**

Sole decision-making authority over resourcing across the delivery team, and the mandate to build the operating rhythm – methodology, governance, quality assurance and career pathing – that a team of this size and growth trajectory needs.

* **Enterprise-calibre clients**

Work with clients across energy, utilities, resources, engineering, construction and infrastructure – sectors where delivery reliability matters as much as the solution itself, and enterprise customers expect quality outcomes on genuinely complex work.

* **Fully remote work**

You can work from anywhere in Australia.

Our Australian office is located on Edward Street in Brisbane, but you do not need to live nearby.

* **Transparent recruitment and assessment**

Every candidate completing the assessment works from the same brief and is evaluated against the same written criteria.

**How to apply**

Please submit your CV and **a short note on a consulting delivery function you've built or scaled from the ground up — the structure, methodology or team you put in place, and the result**, through the application portal.

Half a page is enough.

*InfoConsulting is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, people with disability, people of all ages and backgrounds, and carers. Every applicant is assessed against the same written criteria.*

If you’re looking for a role where you can combine local experience with the opportunity to work in an international environment, join InfoConsulting!

Learn more about InfoConsulting and career growth at our company at: https://infoconsulting.com/.

jobs.title: Project Engineer - Signalling
jobs.description:
**.col-md-8 .container-fluid {padding:** 0;} .col-md-8 .container-fluid .col-sm-6 {text-align: left; padding: 5px 0} .col-md-8 .container-fluid .col-sm-6 .col-sm-6 {padding: 0}

Project Engineer – Signalling

* Deliver signalling solutions that keep Victoria’s rail network safe.
* Drive project success through engineering expertise and collaboration.
* Manage complex signalling projects from concept through to delivery.

V/Line’s purpose is to connect Victorians through safe, reliable, and accessible transport. We believe in giving all Victorians opportunities through travel and transport – connecting them to jobs, education, family and friends, services, tourism and trade.

V/Line is experiencing significant growth and we’re delivering more services, more trains, cheaper fares, and huge projects. With more than 3700 weekly train and coach services, an expansive freight network and unprecedented rail investment, millions of Victorians depend on us to deliver. You could be one of our 2700 committed team members who are up to the challenge.

About the role

The Projects Group is responsible for developing, delivering and assuring project-related changes and improvements across the regional rail network.

The Group coordinates, integrates and delivers major projects and network change in a safe, collaborative and innovative manner, enabling V/Line to shape the improvement and modernisation of V/Line’s regional transport service.

Your role as the Project Engineer - Signalling is to conduct and participate in the performance of signalling engineering and project activities, as directed at an appropriately authorised and qualified level. Responsibilities may include: project engineering and project management, technology development, design solution development and engineering investigation and analysis.

This role will require travel within Victoria, including overnight stays as required.

As well as performing duties specified in this position description an employee may be required to undertake other duties or functions consistent with their classification, capabilities, and skills.

**Position Accountabilities:**
Derive project scope and requirements to ultimately deliver project activities.

Contract and contractor management.

Develop specifications and work instructions.

Define the engineering requirements, design and implement appropriate engineering solutions accordingly.

Define interfaces between disciplines, as necessary, and systems.

Integrate systems, components and design solutions.

Provide technical and engineering expertise for the investigation and analysis of identified engineering system issues.

Participate in the development and maintenance of rail infrastructure maintenance and construction standards, technical maintenance plans, service schedules, inspection and test plans.

Participate in type approval submissions of rail related equipment / systems.

Review design submissions and identified anomalies in accordance with design principles and relative standards.

Review of applications looking to undertake works and obtain access to the network.

Review locations where works are proposed and provide advice and support on matters required for completion.

Assist in the development and maintenance of internal procedures to ensure reviews of third-party applications are handled expeditiously, to ensure V/Line’s safety and environmental, operational requirements are being adhered to by 3rd Party Project applicants.

Attend site visits for project related activities

Achieve financial, operational, performance and reliability targets

Manage project schedule

Mentoring and coaching of V/Line Graduates

If your skills or experience don’t exactly match our listed requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and believe in the potential for growth and development.

About you

Reporting to the Senior Project Manager - Signalling, the Project Engineer - Signalling plays a key role in assisting in ensuring that where works are to be undertaken on the V/Line network they are conducted safely and in accordance with those standards for the works that have been previously approved.

**Selection Criteria:**
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, EXPERIENCE and PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

* Degree in a relevant Engineering discipline appropriate for corporate membership of the Institution of Engineers, Australia. (Essential)
* Construction industry White card or ability to obtain one (Essential)
* Highly competent in the delivery of projects within the rail environment (Essential)
* Drivers Licence (Essential)
* Registered Professional Engineer Victoria (RPEV) in Electrical engineering or similar (desirable)
* Tertiary qualification in Project Management / Quality (desirable)
* Highly proficient in Quality Management and Process Improvement
* Highly proficient in railway technology support or maintenance within an accredited RTO
* Technical expertise in true Root-Cause Analysis (RCA) and the Plan-Do-Check-Act methodology.
* Proficient in Risk Management
* Ability to achieve defined tasks in terms of quality, function, timeframes and cost.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to effectively manage complex and sometimes highly sensitive communications with multiple stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to build effective relationships and to work productively with a diverse range of stakeholders to achieve a common business objective.
* Interpersonal skills to influence change, facilitate and enhance performance within a cross functional environment.

Why V/Line

**In addition to free myki travel, we offer:**

* Community impact – Make a genuine difference. Work in a role that connects Victorians, every day.
* Huge potential – We’re transforming, and you can too. Be a change maker, recognised for your contribution and creativity.
* Dynamic environment – V/Line operates in a constantly changing space. Join a fast-paced and exciting organisation.
* Collaborative team – You’ll be part of a broader supportive team. Surround yourself with talented, passionate peers.
* Flexible working – We support flexible working. Work in a way that supports you to thrive in your role.

We are committed to ensuring a comfortable and accessible recruitment experience. If you need any adjustments or have specific accessibility requirements at any stage of the process, please contact our Talent team at TalentSupport@vline.com.au or 1800 800 007 for confidential support.

As an equal opportunity employer, V/Line is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace and network that reflects the communities we serve. We accept and value the contributions of all our employees regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, age or disability. We were also named a Work 180 endorsed employer for the second year in a row – meaning, we are committed to creating a great workplace for women.

We proudly acknowledge First Peoples of Victoria. We acknowledge their ongoing strength in practicing the world’s oldest living culture. We acknowledge the Traditional Owners’ lands, waters, and skies on which we live and pay respects to their Elders past and present.

\*\*Enrolments & Fees Manager\*\* \*\*8 hours per week\*\* The Enrolments & Fees Manager is responsible for coordinating WSK's annual enrolment process, managing family enquiries and waitlists, administering kindergarten fees and maintaining accurate enrolment and funding records. The combined role provides responsibility for WSK's \*\*HR, staffing and payroll functions together with enrolments and fee administration\*\*. This would suit an experienced administrator or HR professional who enjoys variety, autonomy and working closely with people and would like to become an integral part of the operational management of a community kindergarten. \*\*About You\*\* We are looking for someone who is organised, dependable and confident managing a varied workload with a high level of autonomy. Experience within early childhood education or a community-based organisation would be highly regarded but is \*\*not essential\*\*. The successful applicant will be required to hold a current Working with Children Check and meet WSK's child safety and compliance requirements. \*\*Equal Opportunity\*\* Wilson Street Kindergarten is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds, people with disability and applicants from all backgrounds who share our commitment to children, families and our community. \*\*How to Apply\*\* Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience and clearly indicate whether you are applying for: \*\*1. HR Manager – 17.5 hours per week\*\* \*\*2. Enrolments & Fees Manager – 8 hours per week\*\* \*\*3. Combined HR, Enrolments & Fees Manager – 25.5 hours per week\*\* \*\*Commencement date: Friday, 18 September 2026.\*\* We welcome applicants from both within and outside the early childhood sector and are particularly interested in finding someone who is \*\*organised, personable, reliable and confident taking ownership of their role\*\*.

You will work across AI product design, backend engineering and data-intensive Tax systems. The focus is practical applied AI: building capabilities that are useful, explainable, monitored and secure for enterprise use.

Mapping Tax workflows and deciding where to use AI, deterministic rules and human review

Building LLM assistants, document intelligence and agentic automation for Tax

Orchestrating agents using LLM APIs, tool calling, structured outputs and state management

Building RAG pipelines across ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval and grounding

Building evaluations, reference datasets, monitoring and feedback loops for quality, latency and cost

Implementing grounding, guardrails, access controls, traceability and human review to reduce hallucination and support responsible AI

Building, deploying and supporting secure AI services across cloud, backend and enterprise systems

Working with tax and engineering teams to turn complex tax requirements into reliable AI-enabled product features.

About the team

Deloitte’s Tax Transformation & Technology team builds and operates the products, platforms and engineering capabilities that are changing how Tax work gets done.

We believe the future of Tax will be powered by data, automation and AI. Our multidisciplinary team brings together Tax specialists, software and data engineers, product thinkers and AI technologists to solve complex problems and turn ideas into dependable production solutions.

We are modernising our shared Tax platform and rules engine while developing AI-powered products that support complex compliance and advisory workflows. You will join a collaborative engineering environment where quality, traceability and responsible innovation matter as much as delivery speed.

Enough about us, let’s talk about you.

Experience building production software, data or applied-AI products

Highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack

Hands-on experience with LLM applications, including prompting, structured outputs, tool calling, RAG and model integration.

Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks and patterns such as ReAct, self-reflection, plan-execute or hierarchical delegation

Ability to combine probabilistic AI with deterministic logic, controls and auditability

Experience evaluating AI systems using reference datasets, automated tests, regression and monitoring.

Confidence working with APIs, structured data and data-processing workflows

Understanding of secure software deployment, including cloud hosting, identity, data protection, logging and governance.

Familiarity with CI/CD, source control, automated testing and modern software delivery practices.

Ability to translate complex domain requirements into working product features working with engineering, product teams and business stakeholders.

**The following experience would be advantageous:**
Exposure to AI research, postgraduate study or evidence of staying current with AI engineering methods

Data science experience using tools such as pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow

Experience with agentic developer tools, such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code.

Exposure to Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, vector databases, Docker, Kubernetes or MLflow.

Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript or another relevant language is valuable

Why Deloitte?

At Deloitte, we focus our energy on interesting and impactful work. We're always learning, innovating and setting the standard; making a positive difference to our clients and our society. We put coaching at the heart of what we do, helping our people grow their careers in any direction - whether it be up, moving into something new, or even moving across the world.

We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion. We have a diverse collection of people from different backgrounds, with different experiences, gender identities, abilities and thinking styles.
