jobs.title: Vendor Management Lead
jobs.description:
**We’re Heidi.**

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

If you don’t choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi.

**The role**

This is a newly created role in Heidi sitting under the Head of IT and working closely with Finance. As we've grown from startup to scale-up phase we need a single owner of our third-party software spend: what we buy, what we pay, and what we renew.

Our successes means we've grown and quickly! But we need to refine how things are done; we can report on what we spent last month but we cannot say with certainty why we should be spending, what we're about to be locked into, or which contracts are about to blow out.

The goal is to turn spend into a forecastable, auditable line item for Finance — proactive renewals, early overage detection, cleaner payment controls, and accurate P&L reporting — while freeing IT from commercial negotiation, giving them one accurate application/licence inventory tied to actual usage, and building security review directly into the purchase process.

**What you’ll do**

* **Renewals.** A live register of every material agreement with notice periods, and enough lead time to run a real process.
* **Negotiation.** Set the strategy and walk-away position, then negotiates directly with vendor deal desks.
* **Usage against commitment.** Monitors consumption and seat utilisation, and flags overage exposure before it lands.
* **Owns Implementation of Spend Controls.** Implement stop gaps across material vendors to limit over consumption risk and improve internal cost savings.
* **Rationalisation.** Find duplicate tools, unused licences and utilisation gaps, and recommends cuts.
* **Budget and forecast.** Build the software budget line by line, tracks actuals, reports variance and savings.
* **Payment set-up.** Provision and control the cards, invoice details and billing entities behind every contract.
* **Policy.** Alongside IT, owns the procurement policy: approval thresholds, delegation of authority, who can commit Heidi to what.

**What you'll need**

* **Proven experience in software procurement**, vendor management, or IT sourcing, ideally within a fast-growing SaaS or tech business.
* **A track record of negotiating enterprise software agreements** directly with vendor deal desks — you know how to set a walk-away position and hold it.
* **Strong commercial acumen** with genuine comfort reading contracts, usage-based pricing models, and consumption data to spot risk before it lands.
* **Experience building and maintaining a software/vendor register** — renewals, notice periods, licence counts, and utilisation — at a scale spanning dozens of active agreements.
* **Solid financial literacy:** you can build a budget line, track actuals against forecast, and report variance clearly to a finance audience.
* **Comfort working cross-functionally** between IT, Finance, and the wider business — you'll need to influence without formal authority over the teams actually using the tools.
* **Experience designing or improving procurement policy** — approval thresholds, delegation of authority, and payment/billing controls.
* **A bias for action:** this is a build-from-scratch role, so you should be comfortable creating process and structure where none currently exists, not just running an existing playbook.
* **Bonus:** exposure to vendor security/risk review processes, SaaS/cloud cost optimisation, or LLM/model vendor commercial arrangements.

**How we show up**

* **Build for the next decade, not next quarter**. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.
* **Lead, don't wait**. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.
* **Follow the evidence**. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.
* **Own the outcome**. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.
* **Ship, measure, go again**. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.
* **Live in clinicians' reality**. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

**Why Heidi?**

You’ll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who’ve felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here.

The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn’t *whether* AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you’re doing the defining work of your career.

**We take care of you.**

We offer a $1,000 annual learning and development budget, a $150/month health and wellness allowance, a $500 home office budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to $10,000, four weeks of work from anywhere per year, and serious equity.

**About the role**

As a Security Adviser, you will manage a portfolio of Electorate Offices across Victoria and provide professional security advice to Members of Parliament and electorate staff. You will conduct security risk assessments, coordinate security improvements, support incident management, and contribute to security operations within Parliament House. The role provides a unique opportunity to work across both strategic and operational security activities in a complex and dynamic environment.

* Managing a portfolio of Electorate Offices and providing tailored security advice and support.
* Undertaking security risk assessments and developing practical risk treatment recommendations.
* Supporting the implementation and maintenance of physical and electronic security controls.
* Responding to security incidents and coordinating appropriate security outcomes.
* Supporting security operations during parliamentary sittings and after-hours activities.
* Providing security advice for events, demonstrations, protests and official functions.
* Participating in a 24/7 on-call roster for incident and alarm response.
* Delivering security awareness activities and guidance to parliamentary stakeholders.
* Building strong relationships with Victoria Police, contractors, service providers and internal stakeholders.
* Maintaining security records, reports and compliance documentation.

**About you**

You are a security professional with strong risk management and stakeholder engagement skills. You are comfortable working autonomously, responding to operational issues, and providing practical advice in a sensitive and fast-paced environment. Experience in protective security operations, including security risk management, incident response and physical security.

* Demonstrated ability to conduct security risk assessments and provide practical security advice and recommendations.
* Experience supporting security operations and making sound decisions in dynamic or high-pressure environments.
* Knowledge of electronic security systems including CCTV, access control, duress alarms and related technologies.
* Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships across a broad range of groups.
* The ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise discretion and produce accurate records and reports.

**Qualifications**

* Certificate IV in Security and Risk Management or equivalent is highly desirable.
* Certificate IV in Government Investigations and/or Certificate IV in Training and Assessment are desirable.
* Working knowledge of ISO 31000, the Protective Security Policy Framework (PSPF), relevant security standards and legislation is desirable.
* Current Victorian Driver License.
* Ability to part icipate in rostered sitting duties and 24/7 on-call arrangements.

**The Recruitment Process**

* Application: Submit your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your suitability.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Business Analyst is responsible for analysing business processes, identifying requirements and improvement opportunities, and translating business needs into practical solutions. The role works closely with stakeholders, project teams, developers, and management to support effective decision-making and successful delivery of business and technology initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

* Gather, analyse, and document business requirements from stakeholders.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, meetings, and requirements-gathering sessions.
* Analyse existing business processes and identify inefficiencies, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop **business requirements documents (BRDs), functional requirements, process maps, user stories, and use cases**.
* Translate business requirements into clear and actionable specifications for technical teams.
* Collaborate with project managers, developers, testers, product teams, and business stakeholders.
* Analyse data and prepare reports to support business decisions.
* Develop process flows, workflow diagrams, and business models.
* Identify gaps between current and desired business processes.
* Evaluate proposed solutions and assess their impact on business operations.
* Support system implementation, testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and deployment.
* Develop and execute UAT scenarios and assist stakeholders during testing.
* Monitor project requirements and ensure delivered solutions meet business objectives.
* Identify and manage requirements-related risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Prepare presentations and reports for management and project stakeholders.
* Support change-management and continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Maintain accurate requirements, process, and project documentation.

Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in **Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance**, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar analytical role.
* Strong knowledge of **business process analysis and requirements management**.
* Experience gathering and documenting functional and non-functional requirements.
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience creating process maps, workflow diagrams, and business documentation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency with **Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint**, and business analysis tools.
* Experience with project management or collaboration tools such as **Jira, Confluence, or Microsoft Azure DevOps**.
* Ability to work independently and effectively within cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in **Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall** project environments.
* Knowledge of business analysis frameworks and methodologies.
* Familiarity with **SQL, data analysis, Power BI**, or other reporting tools.
* Experience with ERP, CRM, SaaS, or enterprise software implementations.
* Professional certification such as **IIBA CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA**, or equivalent.
* Experience working with Australian businesses, government, or regulated industries.
* Knowledge of Australian privacy, compliance, and data-protection requirements.
* Australian work rights or an appropriate Australian work visa.

Key Skills

**Business Analysis | Requirements Gathering | Requirements Management | Process Improvement | Stakeholder Management | Business Process Mapping | Data Analysis | UAT | User Stories | Functional Requirements | BRD | Agile/Scrum | Jira | Confluence | SQL | Power BI | Microsoft Excel | Gap Analysis | Change Management | Project Support**

Pay: $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Free food
* Parental leave
* Travel reimbursement

You'll collaborate with architects, engineering teams, cyber defence specialists and senior stakeholders to shape secure outcomes that support the business today while preparing for tomorrow's threats.

jobs.title: Engineering Operations Technician, Data Center Engineering Operations
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS Data Centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll interface with a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Infrastructure Operations (Data Center) team is the backbone of AWS, supporting the rapidly growing AWS business and customers 24/7. We are committed to maintain the physical infrastructure of AWS, ensuring the standards for operational performance in the areas of safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency, and cost.

Join our innovative team where you'll contribute to maintaining and optimizing critical infrastructure that powers digital experiences for millions of customers worldwide. In this collaborative role, you'll apply your technical expertise while working with diverse teams to ensure the reliability and efficiency of our data center operations.

We are a supportive and inclusive team passionate about maintaining world-class data center facilities. Our team values diverse perspectives and fosters an environment where everyone can contribute their unique insights to solve complex challenges.

Key job responsibilities

* Undertake and support management of both routine maintenance and emergency service of a variety of critical systems such as switch-gear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, fire systems, etc.
* Installation of new rack capacity and provisioning of power/cooling
* On-site management of contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed, is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
* Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses and prepare reports and documentation of all aspects of critical facility infrastructure operations and maintenance. Manage the facility’s assets
* Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for all facility related events (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) and assist in the resolution of infrastructure engineering and services issues
* Collaborate with data center IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate day to day operations, projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability, and efficiency
* Drive & implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability as well as assist in the design implementation, commissioning and build out of new data center facilities.

A day in the life
No two days are the same in AWS data centres but, typically, your day will include:

* Attending operational meetings to foster awareness of important activities across the Melbourne data centre region
* Mentoring and development of less experienced engineering operations technicians
* Planning and scheduling of maintenance activities for critical infrastructure
* Collaborating on solving complex engineering problems impacting critical infrastructure
* Collaboration with other AWS data centre regions globally

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* High school or equivalent diploma

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 2+ years of data center engineering experience

As our operations continue to expand, we are seeking a motivated and organised Project Administrator to support our recycling andwaste management operations. jobs.title: Storeperson
jobs.description:
Make your mark at BildGroup: At BildGroup, we believe in helping you thrive, in your career, your passions, and your purpose. Here, you'll find a workplace that inspires you to bring your best, supports your journey every step of the way, and genuinely cares about your success.

The role and what we are looking for: The consumables store sits inside our asset and maintenance workshop. It is where technicians and field service crews get the parts, fluids, tools and PPE that keep plant running, and where every part gets costed back to the right work order. You will run it as the sole key holder.

Two parts of this job do not exist yet: full inventory management in Gearbox, and a control system for high value tools. You will build both.

What you will be doing

Receipting, storing, labelling and issuing parts, consumables, fluids, tools and PPE
Raising purchase orders and allocating every part to a work order, plant item or cost centre
Setting and maintaining minimum and maximum stock levels and reorder points
Running stocktakes and cycle counts, investigating variances and correcting them
Picking and staging parts ahead of field service jobs so crews are not waiting
Storing and issuing fuels, oils, chemicals and gas bottles, and keeping safety data sheets and the chemical register current
What we are looking for

Three or more years in stores, parts, inventory, purchasing or warehousing
Proven stock control: receipting, issuing, min and max levels, stocktakes and variance reconciliation
Purchasing experience covering quotes, purchase orders and cost allocation
Confident on an inventory, CMMS or ERP system, and sound on Excel
Current forklift High Risk Work Licence (LF) and a current Australian driver licence
Certificate III in Warehousing or Supply Chain Operations, and Gearbox experience, are both an advantage
Hours are 38 a week, Monday to Friday, 7:30am to 4:00pm. Expect around five hours of overtime most weeks and one to two Saturdays a month.

You will be alongside the technicians and field crews every day. This suits someone who would rather be in an operating workshop than a warehouse.

* A career where you belong: When you join BildGroup, you're not just part of a workforce. You're part of a family dedicated to making a difference. No matter the mark you want to make on the world, we're here to support you.

You'll belong from day one. We invest in genuine connection, inclusion, and gender diversity so every person on the team feels at home.
Your safety and wellbeing matter to us. From income protection to an Employee Assistance Program, we make sure you and your family have real support behind you.
We back your growth. Through our learning platform, leadership programs, and referral rewards, there's always a next step available if you want it.
We do work that matters beyond the worksite. Volunteering, community partnerships, and our internal innovation initiative b.hive connect you to impact that goes further than the job.

**We are BildGroup and we're built differently: Proudly Australian-owned, we build the infrastructure and spaces that bring communities to life. From urban development and sports fields to road construction and maintenance, our diverse projects shape the world around us.

We started as a family business, and while we've grown into a major corporation, our values remain the same. Success, to us, isn't just about what we build. It's about how our people grow and flourish.

At BildGroup, we're here to empower you, fuel your ambitions, and create an environment where you feel valued, supported, and inspired.

At BildGroup, your voice matters, your growth is a priority, and your potential is limitless. Ready to make your mark? Let's do it together.

We believe diversity, equity, and inclusion are not just buzzwords, they are the foundation of a workplace where everyone feels they belong. We invite people from all walks of life to join us. Whether you're an Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander, a veteran or someone with a unique cultural or life experience, we encourage you to apply.**

jobs.title: Concierge
jobs.description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.

Shaping the future of real estate for a better world

At JLL, we see a Brighter Way forward for our clients, our people, our planet, and our communities. With over 200 years of real estate experience, we are, and always have been, in continual pursuit of brighter ways of working.

We bring to life a Brighter Way in all that we do by seeking better, smarter, more innovative ways of working. We approach our work in a warmer, more optimistic, and inclusive way.

JLL is a global leader in helping clients envision where people will live, work, play, shop, and eat.

**What this job involves:**
As the Concierge for a leading Financial Services client, you are the first point of contact for visitors on site. You are responsible for delivering a high-quality, professional lobby and visitor experience while coordinating day-to-day front-of-house operations. The role manages a broad range of workplace support activities (visitor management, meeting support coordination, service requests triage, communications, and vendor/interface coordination) and resolves non-routine enquiries using judgement within site and client procedures.

Flexibility working in shifts to cover hours are 8am to 6pm with this role commencing at 1pm on a regular basis. This role requires flexibility to change shifts as required.

What your day-to-day will look like

Front-of-house experience and service delivery

Deliver a professional front-of-house experience by welcoming clients, visitors, contractors, and employees

Always represent the client and JLL brand professionally within a high-profile multinational corporate (MNC) environment.

Manage visitor arrivals and registrations through the Visitor Management System (EMS).

Maintain presentation and operational control of reception and foyer areas in line with workplace policies and procedures.

Respond to enquiries and provide workplace assistance to staff and visitors.

Visitor management and hosting

Coordinate visitor pre-arrivals (where required), meeting host notifications, and on-arrival logistics.

Maintain accurate visitor logs and support compliance requirements aligned to site processes.

Workplace coordination and service requests

Act as a central point of contact for workplace support queries (facilities/service requests, wayfinding, meeting room support coordination, amenities queries).

Triage issues, coordinate with relevant teams/providers, and follow through to closure to protect service quality and timeliness.

Security Access and Badge Management

Manage security access processes including issuing, programming, auditing, and reconciling staff, visitor, and contractor access cards, while maintaining accurate records and supporting onboarding, offboarding, compliance, and reporting requirements.

Build effective relationships with client stakeholders and internal teams to deliver a professional workplace and front-of-house experience within a corporate financial services environment.

Coordinate visitor management through EMS, maintain reception and foyer standards, and respond to workplace enquiries and support requests professionally and efficiently.

Work Safety and Emergency Support

Support workplace health, safety, and security practices by maintaining awareness of site risks, escalating issues appropriately, and assisting with emergency response, incident management, and evacuation procedures.

Monitor and report building or security concerns to the Facilities Management team while delivering a professional front-of-house experience through visitor management, workplace assistance, and maintaining reception and foyer standards in line with site procedures.

Administrative and Operational Support

Deliver a professional front-of-house experience by welcoming clients, visitors, contractors, and employees.

Manage visitor arrivals and registrations through the Visitor Management System (EMS).

Maintain presentation and operational control of reception and foyer areas in line with workplace policies and procedures.

Respond to enquiries and provide workplace assistance to staff and visitors

Technology and Systems

Use workplace technologies and systems to manage visitor access, reporting, and service requests efficiently.

Support adoption of workplace tools and digital processes.

Maintain data accuracy across workplace management systems. Operational standards, reporting, and continuous improvement

Maintain front-of-house procedures, checklists, and daily/weekly logs (e.g., handovers, incidents, service follow-ups).

Identify recurring issues and recommend minor process/system improvements to improve team effectiveness and service consistency.

Quality, compliance, and confidentiality

Follow site policies for security, safety, privacy, and confidentiality; handle sensitive information appropriately.

Support incident response procedures as required (within training and site protocols).

Team guidance

Provide guidance and on-the-job support to new or entry-level team members; assist with training on procedures and service standards.

**Sound like you? To apply you need to be:**
Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish trust and communicate confidently in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

Professional and diplomatic approach when engaging with clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders.

Ability to represent and maintain a professional, polished, and courteous profile within a high-profile multinational corporate environment.

Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to remain calm and solutionsfocused under pressure.

Adaptable and eager to learn new systems, technologies, and ways of working within an evolving workplace environment.

Clear and effective verbal communication skills.

Ability to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail.

Demonstrates professionalism, discretion, and a strong commitment to ethics and integrity at all times

**Benefits:**
Great employee discounts off fitness, wellbeing & other renowned brands

18 weeks paid maternity leave

Private Health Insurance Discounts

Active Social Club

Employee assistant program

Novated Lease for EV cars

Paid time off for volunteer work

Career Opportunities with Australia's #1 Commercial Real Estate firm

Premium offices

**What you can expect from us:**
You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture. One where the best inspire the best. Where like-minded people work naturally together to achieve great things. Join us to develop your strengths and enjoy a fulfilling career full of varied experiences. Keep those ambitions in sight and imagine where JLL can take you.

As an organisation, we don’t just accept that we are a place of many different people, but we embrace it, we celebrate it, and we proactively support the needs that difference brings. JLL is committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, gender, age, sexual orientation or disability, and that is why, for more than a decade, we continue to rank among the World’s Most Ethical Companies. We are dedicated to offering veterans from all ranks and services a successful civilian career as they transition out of the military. We recognise and appreciate the skills acquired in their service careers as vital and transferable to our workforce.

Interested candidates, please apply following the link below quoting job reference number ABREQ530621

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.

About JLL –

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

The successful candidate will be comfortable preparing and presenting technical customer solutions, and will be an independent and self sufficient worker with the ability to think on their feet and solve problems and issues as they arise.

**Network Architecture, Technology and Design**

* Work within cross-organisational teams to develop AARNet’s overall network, security and technology strategies.
* Develop and implement detailed designs for evolutions to the AARNet network architecture.
* Develop and implement network automation and orchestration capabilities.
* Undertake and participate in security reviews and uplift.
* Undertake financial and cost analyses and reviews of proposed technologies and strategies to ensure the overall cost effectiveness of the proposed solutions.
* Develop test beds and proof of concept designs.
* Evaluate new technologies and advise AARNet of their relevance or benefit.
* Write and maintain operational documentation.

**Engagement/Communications**

* Engage with network and security vendors on product & technology updates and ongoing relationship building.
* Engage with AARNet customers to understand their requirements.
* Engage with the Australian and international Research and Education Community to ensure that AARNet maintains a position globally as technical leader.
* Develop and present AARNet’s network capabilities to a variety of audiences, and contribute to AARNet’s digital communications strategy.
* Be an active participant in the preparation of the technical sections of major bids and funding proposals.

**Project Delivery**

* Develop project plans and milestones around the deployment of network evolutions in conjunction with Project and Programme Managers.
* Provide procurement support for large network equipment acquisitions.
* Where required, act as the lead on field based deployments, particularly for new sites/networks and technologies.
* Produce technically and commercially accurate reports.

**Leadership and Mentoring**

* Provide co-ordination and technical leadership of other engineers, technicians and contractors.
* Ensure the team is kept abreast of current and new technologies.
* Produce training material to educate other AARNet technical staff.

**Expertise, experience & qualifications:**

* 10+ years’ experience in the IT&T industry.
* Previous telecommunications experience as a network engineer in carrier grade implementations of MPLS, IP, Ethernet, DWDM and DataCentre Networking.
* Previous experience in designing, securing and deploying large campus or national scale optical and routed networks is highly desirable.
* Experience with Unix/Linux based systems is highly desirable.
* Experience with scripting/coding in the context of software defined networking (SDN), network management, automation and orchestration is highly desirable.
* Experienced and willing to work as part of a network deployment team as required.
* Previous experience with Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto, Cumulus and Nvidia network design and support is highly desirable.
* Experience integrating and deploying cloud solutions is highly desirable.
* Experience integrating and deploying private connectivity to cloud providers is desirable.
* Familiarity with working in an Agile or Scrum framework is highly desirable.
* Experience in a similar role will be highly regarded.
* Strong computer skills are essential.
* Australian Resident.
* A degree in Engineering/Telecommunications or a related field or relevant industry experience.
* Valid Australian Driver’s License.
* Advantageous to hold an existing Security Clearance or have an ability to obtain a Security Clearance (as an Australian Citizen)

**Why Work at AARNet?**

At AARNet, we’re passionate about advancing global education and critical research. Our Australia-wide network, with global reach, supports some of the most demanding network-based applications. If you’re looking for a purpose-driven workplace where you can make a difference, consider joining our team.

Australia's largest public museum organisation is seeking Casual Technical Services Technicians at Museums Victoria.

ABOUT MUSEUMS VICTORIA:

Ever dreamed of working in a place where dinosaurs roam, stars explode, and the world's most intriguing stories come to life? Welcome to Museums Victoria (MV)—where every day is a new opportunity to create unforgettable experiences. As one of the southern hemisphere's largest and most iconic museum organisations, we're not just about exhibits; we're about engaging, immersive moments that spark curiosity, creativity, and connection.

This casual position provides practical technical support across Museums Victoria's sites, adapting to the operational needs of each venue to deliver safe, consistent and effective technical support for events, exhibitions, gallery spaces and public programs. You will be accountable for the safe, effective and skilful delivery of technical set up, operation and maintenance support, drawing on sound practical judgement, good mechanical aptitude and attention to detail across gallery, event, exhibition and back-of-house environments.

Some of the key duties include:

* Programming, operating and supporting lighting, audio and audio-visual systems to deliver safe, reliable and high-quality visitor experiences.
* Assisting with bump in, bump out and set up of technical and staging equipment for events and exhibitions, including staging, lighting, audio, projection, streaming, cameras and bespoke interactives.
* Setting up and operating technical equipment in galleries, outdoor spaces, theatres and conference venues across Museums Victoria's sites.
* Assisting with the preparation and set up of showcases, and assembling, installing and deinstalling exhibition furniture, structures and displays.
* Completing minor installation, deinstallation and changeover tasks, using practical experience to problem solve and escalate issues where required.

The successful applicant will have:

* Demonstrated knowledge, skills and experience in the technical operation of sound, theatre and event lighting, audio-visual equipment, hybrid delivery and streaming for events.
* Demonstrated experience, or a willingness to be trained, in installing and deinstalling interactives, showcases and associated exhibition materials in a museum, gallery or similar public environment.
* Demonstrated practical experience in minor repairs, including patching, painting and attaching fixtures or fittings in a public-facing environment.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively, communicate effectively and provide excellent customer service to a wide range of stakeholders.
* Proficiency, or a willingness to be trained and deemed competent, in the safe use of Elevated Work Platforms and a range of hand and power tools.

This is a casual position. The rate on offer is VPS 2.2 - $45.50 per hour, inclusive of 25% casual loading (less applicable tax).

Museums Victoria is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and celebrate all communities. Museums Victoria is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels they belong. We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds, people with disability, and people of all ages, gender identities and sexual orientations.

We are committed to an accessible and inclusive recruitment process. If you require adjustments or support to participate, please contact our careers team at [email protected].

To apply, please click “Apply for this Job” at the bottom of the job listing page.

For more information about this position, please contact Alex Abundis at [email protected].

* Demonstrated knowledge, skills and experience in the technical operation of sound, theatre and event lighting, audio-visual equipment, hybrid delivery and streaming for events.

jobs.title: Senior AI Consultant
jobs.description:
**About Codex**

Codex is an Australian technology consultancy delivering high-quality data, cloud, and AI solutions for organisations across sectors including healthcare, energy, and financial services.

We are a high-performing, fast-paced consultancy that values people who bring energy, accountability, and pride in their work. We care deeply about delivery — not just getting things done, but getting them done properly and in ways that genuinely help our clients succeed.

We are also officially **Great Place to Work® Certified**, reflecting the strong culture we’ve built — one grounded in trust, high standards, ownership, and genuine support for our people.

If you enjoy solving complex technical problems, building intelligent systems from the ground up, and working at the frontier of applied AI, you’ll fit in well here.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a **Senior AI Engineer** to design and deliver production-grade, agentic AI systems for enterprise clients.

You might come from:

* A strong **software engineering background** now working with AI systems, or
* **ML/AI engineering background** with strong experience in deploying models into production.

This role is about building reliable, secure, real-world AI systems — not just experimentation. You’ll design and implement autonomous and semi-autonomous AI systems that reason, orchestrate tools, interact with enterprise data platforms, and operate in secure cloud environments.

**What You’ll Do**

**Build Agentic AI Applications**

* Design and implement LLM-powered applications and AI agents
* Build multi-step reasoning workflows with tool use, memory and MCP (Model Context Protocol)
* Develop advanced RAG architectures integrating AI models with enterprise data
* Engineer robust backend systems that support AI-driven workflows

**Production-Grade Engineering**

* Deploy AI systems into production environments on AWS with evaluation, logging, monitoring, and guardrails
* Optimise for reliability, performance, and cost
* Apply strong software engineering discipline — testing of prompts/agents, integration tests, validation pipelines, and CI/CD
* Strong focus on compliance in production (e.g. content filters, PII redaction, Bedrock Guardrails or equivalent)

**Cloud & Architecture**

* Architect scalable solutions using AWS services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, ECS/EKS, Step Functions, and API Gateway
* Implement secure IAM, networking, and data access patterns
* Contribute to reusable AI and cloud patterns across engagements

**Client Delivery**

* Translate business problems into AI-native solution designs
* Act as a trusted technical partner
* Work closely with clients and cross-functional delivery teams
* Communicate clearly and deliver with accountability

**What We’re Looking For**

**Strong Engineering Foundations**

* 7–10+ years of experience in software engineering, AI engineering, or related fields
* Strong Python (or equivalent backend language) experience
* Experience building and deploying production systems
* Solid understanding of APIs, distributed systems, and modern backend architecture
* CI/CD: GitHub Actions or Bitbucket Pipelines; Infrastructure as Code at scale (AWS CDK and/or Terraform)
* Testing: unit and integration tests; experience testing non-deterministic AI behaviour (prompts, retrieval, agent flows)

**AI Exposure (Practical, Not Just Theoretical)**

* Experience building LLM-powered applications, RAG systems, or AI-driven features **or**
* Strong interest in applied AI with demonstrable hands-on projects
* Understanding of embeddings, vector databases, and model evaluation is highly regarded

**Cloud Experience**

* Experience delivering production workloads on AWS
* Familiarity with services such as Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, Bedrock, or SageMaker
* Infrastructure as Code experience (Terraform or similar) is beneficial

**GenAI & RAG**

* GenAI platforms: Amazon Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude — model selection and trade-offs
* Vector stores: OpenSearch, Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, pgvector, or Pinecone for RAG and semantic retrieval
* Advanced RAG: ingestion, chunking strategies (semantic, hierarchical, hybrid), embedding model selection, retrieval tuning, evaluation (recall, precision, latency)
* RAG/agent frameworks in production

**Agentic AI**

* Tool use, orchestration, planning/execution patterns, disciplined justification for when to use agents vs simpler flows
* MCP: production-grade tool integration and context management; clear boundaries (tool contracts, error handling, fallbacks)

**Observability, guardrails, compliance & security**

* GenAI observability: Langfuse and/or MLflow for tracing, evaluation runs, and lifecycle management
* Guardrails in production: content filters, PII redaction, policy checks (e.g. Bedrock Guardrails)
* Compliance in production: define and apply data residency, audit logging, retention, and alignment with regulatory or client policies (e.g. sector requirements); awareness of frameworks or obligations relevant to engagement context
* Secure patterns: IAM least privilege, Secrets Manager/Parameter Store, network isolation

**Ways of Working**

* High energy and strong ownership mindset
* Deep care for quality and delivery excellence
* Comfortable with ambiguity in emerging AI domains
* Confident in client-facing, fast-paced environments
* First-principles thinking when evaluating GenAI, agentic systems, and architectural trade-offs

**Why Codex**

**Great Place to Work® Certified** – A culture built on trust, ownership, and high standards

**High-Performance Environment** – Meaningful responsibility and real impact

**Frontier AI Work** – Build production-grade agentic systems, not just prototypes

**Strong Team Culture** – Smart, supportive people who care about doing great work

**Growth Opportunity** – Accelerate your AI capability within a consultancy environment

**Flexibility** – Hybrid working in Melbourne

Pay: $140,000.00 – $200,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Melbourne VIC

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Security Architect
jobs.description:
### **General information**

Name

Senior Manager, Enterprise Security Architect

Site / Location

Melbourne Support Centre

Ref #

12387404

Entity

Australia Post

Opening Date

21-Aug-2026

Suburb

Richmond

Work Type

Permanent Full Time

### **Description & Requirements**

Working in tech at Australia Post is where innovation and problem solving meets great people and agile working. You’ll work with bright people on building and maintaining products and services that you and every other Australian get to benefit from every day. Whether you’re working from our modern office or your one at home, you’ll be part of a culture of collaboration and connection, making long-lasting impact right across Australia.

**About the opportunity**

Shape the future of secure technology at one of Australia’s most trusted organisations. As **Senior Manager, Enterprise Security Architecture**, you will lead the evolution of Australia Post’s enterprise security architecture practice, setting the strategy, standards and architectural patterns that enable secure, scalable and AI-driven technology delivery across the business.

Working at the intersection of architecture, engineering and cyber security, you will build a modern, automation-first function that provides clear risk visibility, accelerates decision-making and embeds security by design into every stage of delivery. Reporting to the Head of Engineering & Technology Architecture, with a dotted line to the CISO, you will play a pivotal role in lifting enterprise-wide security capability, advancing architecture-as-code and AI-assisted assurance practices, and helping Australia Post set the benchmark for secure engineering in the AI era.

This is a great opportunity to redefine how security architecture is delivered at scale, lead a high-impact transformation agenda, and influence the future of secure technology across one of Australia’s largest and most complex enterprises.

**What you’ll deliver with us**

**Commercial & Strategic Priorities**

* Own the enterprise security architecture strategy and roadmap, aligning to Post 30 priorities, E&TA strategy, and the Cyber Security strategy. Establishing a modern, scalable, AI-first architecture practice that operates as a strategic enabler across the enterprise.
* Lead the architecture assurance function as the first line of defense for security architecture quality, reviewing solution designs across project demand, exposing risk transparently, and enabling informed enterprise decisions rather than acting as a delivery gate.
* Shape the security architecture function to operate as a flexible, demand-driven pool, deploying architects across initiatives based on risk profile and complexity, with measurable and clear engagement models.
* Establish AI-first ways of working across the practice, AI-assisted solution review as the default, automated threat modelling, AI-driven pattern generation, and standards of authoring.
* Drive automation across the architecture lifecycle, including automated security pattern application in delivery pipelines, automated control validation, and architecture-as-code.

**Financial**

* Reduce delivery cost and rework across Lines of Business through reuse of validated security patterns, automated assurance, and repeatable architecture approaches that eliminate duplicated effort.
* Support investment prioritisation by providing risk-informed architecture insights, clear trade-off analysis, and transparent articulation of security value versus risk to inform enterprise capital planning.
* Optimise security tooling and licensing spend by rationalising duplicate capabilities, consolidating platforms, and prioritising investments based on risk, value, and strategic alignment.

**About you**

You are an experienced security architecture leader with a proven ability to build, lead and evolve high-performing teams within large, complex organisations. You bring deep expertise across security architecture, cyber strategy and enterprise technology, coupled with a collaborative leadership style that develops capability, drives accountability and fosters a culture of continuous improvement.

You have strong knowledge of Zero Trust, cloud-first and secure-by-design principles, with practical experience across identity, cloud, application, network and data security. You are comfortable working with technologies such as Microsoft Entra ID, Auth0, CyberArk, SailPoint, AWS, Azure and GCP, and understand modern API and integration security approaches.

Most importantly, you are passionate about innovation and empowering teams to deliver at scale. You leverage AI, automation, architecture-as-code and policy-as-code to improve architecture assurance, accelerate decision-making and strengthen enterprise security outcomes, while coaching and enabling others to embrace modern ways of working.

**What else is in it for you?**

* Bring your whole self to work every day and be met by a welcoming bunch of people who respect and support you
* Flexible and hybrid working arrangements, like the opportunity to work from home two days per week
* Opportunities for growth and development through formal programs or mentorship
* Exclusive team member discounts and offers for more cash in your pocket, evolving policies for flexible working, leave types and access to health and wellbeing resources

**All walks, one route**

It takes a lot of us to deliver for every Australian – and it’s important to us that our people behind the parcels reflect the people receiving them. We come from all walks. Different backgrounds, different ages, different genders, different sexualities and different abilities, but we all believe in the same purpose.

We welcome people all ages, genders and backgrounds – including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disability, LGBTQIA+ communities, and refugees. We’re a Disability Confident Recruiter, committed to making our hiring process and workplace inclusive and barrier-free. We’re also working hard to remove bias and build a gender-equitable experience for everyone who joins us. If you’ve got questions about accessibility, reach out to our Diversity & Inclusion team at inclusivecareers@auspost.com.au or on 03 8737 9415.

jobs.title: Business Analyst (Data & Analytics) - Country Road Group (Fixed Term)
jobs.description:
* 1001895

* Melbourne - CBD & Inner, VIC

* Full-Time

* Closing on: 4 Sep 2026

*At Country Road Group, our Group Functions sit at the heart of our business, driving the success of our portfolio of distinctive brands and enabling them to do what they do best. Working across the business, you will play a vital role in shaping how we operate, grow, and innovate, bringing our strategy to life.*

As the Business Analyst for Data & Analytics, sitting within our IT function, you will play a key role in the development of a modern, trusted data platform across Country Road Group. Partnering with business and technical stakeholders, you will translate complex data and reporting needs into clear requirements, support the migration and transformation of data within our AWS environment, and help establish consistent data definitions, governance and quality standards. With data at the heart of your expertise, you will bring strong analytical thinking, cloud data literacy and stakeholder management skills to ensure our data solutions are accurate, trusted and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

Please note this is a 12-month fixed term opportunity.

**How You Will Contribute**

* Gather and translate data, analytics and reporting requirements into clear specifications for technical delivery teams
* Analyse and profile source data (e.g. Oracle Retek, Manhattan, Shopify etc) to identify quality issues, gaps and transformation requirements
* Support the development of our AWS data platform across ingestion, transformation and reporting layers
* Support data migration to Amazon Redshift, including source-to-target mapping, reconciliation and cutover readiness
* Partner with Data Engineering and Enterprise Architecture to define data pipelines, transformation logic and reporting requirements
* Define data quality, reconciliation and UAT criteria, validating outputs with business stakeholders before go-live
* Champion data governance, including ownership, access, standards, definitions and data lineage
* Facilitate workshops to establish consistent enterprise metrics, business definitions and calculation logic
* Drive resolution of conflicting data definitions and priorities across business functions
* Support the rollout and adoption of new data platform capabilities and reporting tools
* Build strong relationships across technical and business teams, advocating for trusted, usable and commercially relevant data.

**Capabilities We Value**

* Demonstrated Business Analyst or Data Analyst experience, with data and analytics as a primary professional focus
* Experience with AWS data services such as S3, Glue and Redshift, or comparable platforms including Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse or BigQuery
* Working SQL capability, with confidence profiling source data, investigating issues and validating outputs
* Strong understanding of data governance, including data quality, ownership, access, standards and definitions
* Experience supporting data platform development, migration or analytics transformation initiatives
* Strong requirements gathering, data mapping, documentation and business analysis capability
* Experience facilitating workshops and gaining agreement on business rules, metrics and data definitions
* Exposure to BI and reporting tools such as Qlik, Power BI, Tableau or QuickSight
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence influencing senior stakeholders and navigating competing priorities
* A proactive and curious mindset, with genuine enthusiasm for data, cloud technology and emerging AI capabilities
* Retail or fashion industry experience is highly regarded, along with relevant tertiary qualifications or AWS certification.

**What We Offer**

* Bi-annual product allowance, access to sample sales and 40% discount for you and your immediate family across all CRG brands
* Flex your leave your way, including birthday leave, volunteer leave, personal leave and more
* Access to health and wellbeing support, including Health Insurance, 24/7 EAP counselling, discounted gym memberships and financial advice services
* 18 weeks paid parental leave program for eligible employees with return-to-work clothing allowance
* Internal career opportunities across our House of Brands
* Annual learning calendar to support your ongoing development
* Support impactful community and charity partnerships across our House of Brands, including OCRF, Our Watch, First Nations Reconciliation, Movember, Red Cross and Landcare.

**Who We Are**

Country Road Group is one of Australia’s leading lifestyle brand houses, home to an iconic portfolio including Country Road, Trenery, Witchery, Mimco and Politix. United as ***One Team***, we work collaboratively across our House of Brands to create exceptional product and meaningful experiences for our customers. We are ***Courageously Curious***, exploring new ideas, perspectives and ways of working, and ***Driven by Purpose*** to make a positive impact - on our customers, our communities and each other. We’re proud to foster an inclusive culture where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and has the opportunity to grow.

Recognised as a sustainability leader in Australian fashion, Country Road Group drives positive change through ambitious climate action, ethical sourcing, and responsible product innovation.

We encourage you to explore our Current Opportunities and we look forward to connecting with you!

*Country Road Group acknowledges the Traditional Owners of Country throughout Australia and recognises their continuing connection to lands, waters and communities. We pay our respects to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander cultures and to Elders past and present.*

*We’re committed to inclusion and accessibility. If we can support you with any adjustments at any stage, please let us know.*

jobs.title: Lead Solution Architect - Home Health
jobs.description:
**About us**

Established in 1840, we are Australia’s first wellbeing company, delivering health, wealth and care services for our members and the community.

As a social enterprise, we’re motivated by our purpose to positively impact the wellbeing of millions. We reinvest profits to deliver products and services sustainably that matter most to our members, customers and the Australian community.

For us, Real Wellbeing encompasses the whole experience of life. It’s about feeling supported in your health, connected with your community and empowered to live life on your terms.

**About the Opportunity:**

**The Lead Solution Architect** is responsible for the delivery of solution architecture services to the business domains such as home care, hospital in the home, aged care, residential villages and virtual care. This role translates business requirements into scalable, secure, and efficient architecture solutions, along with the short-term design and oversight of business / technology solutions in alignment to broader domain roadmaps and enterprise blueprints. They will work closely with business sponsors, product owners and delivery team leaders to satisfy their architecture design requirements and deliver solution architecture as a service

**Key responsibilities include:**

**Strategic Alignment**

* Trusted advisor to advise the business, product, and technology owners in delivering solutions against their strategy, goals, and objectives.

* Collaborates with product (portfolio) owner, product manager and other product stakeholders to create a program / project technology roadmap (short-term view of < 2 years) that support immediate business goals and align to the minimum viable architecture (MVA).

* Align to the broader enterprise architecture vision and blueprints and deliver against business domain goals and objectives.

**Solution Architecture Design**

* Contributes to the evaluation, design, and analysis for the implementation of a solution architecture as a service to implement and uplift business applications or technologies based on business strategy, business capabilities, value-streams, business requirements and enterprise standards.

* Understand domain technology roadmap for solutions and recommend solution architecture services to support product delivery and execution.

* Document and socialise clear architecture decisions with options analysis to support the right business outcome with rationale around tactical vs strategic decisions and the related risks and costs implications.

**Delivery Design Governance**

* Support the architectural governance processes including the review and approval of new technology initiatives.

* Administer architectural runway within product team(s) implementation of enablers while applying flexible architecture governance framework and design change control.

* Participate in the domain governance forums for adherence to design and architecture.

* Supports product (portfolio) owner in end-of-life product decisions to maintain, refresh or retire services or systems, including applications, technologies, processes, and information.

* Support and guide solution architecture design services in response to business functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., capacity and server management).

**Leadership & Consulting**

* Act as an internal advisor and guide solution architectures translation by technology SMEs into workable low level or detailed design components.

* Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders.

* Provide guidance and mentorship to the technology team members and support other project leaders to ensure consistency and alignment across the organisation.

**About You:**

* Advanced degree in computing, computer science, business / information systems or other IT related field

* 6+ years in business and/or technology strategic and operational planning as a Domain or Solution Architect advisor.

* 10+ years in these areas: Business Architecture, Data / Information Architecture, Technology Architecture, Integration Architecture and Solution Architecture

* Comfortable at working with vague business requirements and assess / validate solution architecture requirements in a professional and diplomatic manner.

* Experience in the following areas is highly desirable

* healthcare / aged care sector.

* CRM systems especially Salesforce and BPM / process automation and tools such as Tungsten TotalAgility, Appian and UiPath.

* Proven experience in

* Cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure, microservices frameworks, and API-enablement platforms such as webMethods.

* Leveraging emerging technologies such as generative AI for business advantage and ability to deliver these as reusable enterprise capabilities whilst minimising the change impact on the business.

**Applications Close: 5th September, 2026**

**Why Join Us?**

You will enjoy a range of great employee benefits and rewards including:

* Competitive salary + bonus program

* Enjoy additional yearly Well-Being and Community leave days

* 14-week paid parental leave, with equal benefit for both parents

* Employee Referral Program

* Employee Assistance Program – support and assistance for you and your partner at those times in life when you need it most

* Flare/Maxxia Rewards - a great range of discounts and benefits at selected retail outlets, department stores, attractions, travel, cinemas, restaurants.

* Discounts across the Australian Unity business including Private Health Insurance, General Insurance + more!

* Available access to LinkedIn Learning courses through our great Learning platform

For further benefits visit: https://www.australianunity.com.au/careers/culture

Australian Unity is an Equal Opportunity employer and we encourage applications from all members of the community, including people of Aboriginal and Torres strait Islander descent, culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds and, mature aged people.

* Collaborative team player with strong written and verbal communication skills.

Apply Now to join our growing team and further your accounting career with a dynamic and supportive organisation.

Pay: $90,000.00 – $100,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Manager - Marketing and Communications
jobs.description:
Posted: 21/08/2026

Closing Date: 18/09/2026

Salary: $124,000.00 - $129,000.00

Job Type: Permanent - Full Time

Location: Melbourne, Victoria

Job Category: Marketing,Voluntary, Charity & Social Work

Safe Steps is the only 24/7, family violence response centre in Victoria, providing a “state-wide entry point” for victim-survivors of domestic and family violence. Services include information and referral, crisis response, specialist family violence risk assessment, safety planning, Webchat, and access to supported crisis accommodation.

Our vision is safety, support and respect for all victim-survivors of domestic and family violence.

Our practice is trauma-informed and guided by evidence. We provide services to all victim-survivors and recognise that most of our work is dedicated to the needs of women and children which reflects the gendered nature of domestic and family violence.

#### **Job Description**

**THE ROLE**

Safe Steps is seeking an experienced **Marketing & Communications Manager** to lead the organisation's marketing and communications function, strengthening our reputation, visibility and engagement across community, government, corporate, philanthropic and sector audiences.

Reporting to the Group Director, Business Growth, this role combines strategic planning with hands-on delivery, leading integrated marketing campaigns, digital communications, social media, events, publications and brand initiatives. You will play a key role in amplifying Safe Steps' advocacy efforts, supporting fundraising activities and increasing awareness of our services across Victoria.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Strategic Communications & Brand Leadership**

* Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of Safe Steps' marketing and communications strategy.
* Protect and strengthen the Safe Steps brand across all channels and audiences.
* Provide strategic communications advice to senior leaders and stakeholders.
* Manage media enquiries and support public-facing communications.

**Digital Marketing & Content**

* Lead digital marketing, social media and website strategy.
* Develop engaging content across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and emerging platforms.
* Create digital assets, campaigns, publications and marketing materials.
* Oversee website content, optimisation and user experience.

**Events & Community Engagement**

* Lead the planning and delivery of Safe Steps' flagship Candlelight Vigil event.
* Support organisational launches, partnership events and community engagement activities.
* Identify opportunities to grow awareness through partnerships and strategic initiatives.

**Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Monitor campaign performance, audience engagement and brand reach.
* Use insights and analytics to strengthen marketing outcomes and organisational impact.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of marketing systems, processes and resources.

#### **Desired Skills and Experience**

**KEY SELECTION CRITERIA**

**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism or a related discipline.
* Approximately 7+ years' experience in marketing and communications roles.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong digital marketing and social media expertise across multiple platforms.
* Experience developing and delivering integrated campaigns, content and communications strategies.
* Experience managing events, creative projects and external suppliers.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365, Canva, email marketing and digital publishing platforms.
* Experience using analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Meta Business Suite.

**Desirable**

* Postgraduate qualification in Marketing, Communications or a related field.
* Experience in the not-for-profit, community services or family violence sector.
* Experience supporting fundraising or philanthropy campaigns.
* Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, including InDesign and Photoshop.
* Knowledge of SEO paid digital advertising and audience development strategies.
* Understanding of trauma-informed and accessible communications

**WHY JOIN US?**

* Help amplify the voice and impact of Victoria's only 24/7 family violence response service.
* Lead meaningful campaigns that support victim-survivors and drive social change.
* Enjoy a high-autonomy role with organisation-wide influence.
* Join a values-driven organisation committed to integrity, diversity and empowerment.
* Work with a passionate team dedicated to improving outcomes for victim-survivors of family violence.
* SCHADS Award Level 7 remuneration with generous salary packaging to increase your take-home pay.

**INTERESTED? APPLY TODAY!**

If this sounds like the role for you then submit your application.

Applications will be assessed as they are received and may close early once a suitable candidate is found.

Your application will NOT be considered unless you provide a **Cover Letter** and a **Resume**.

*Safe Steps is an organisation committed to an inclusive and accessible workplace for all. We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders, people with disabilities, those from diverse cultural, linguistic, and religious backgrounds, all ages, LGBTQIA+ people, and those with a diversity of experiences.*

jobs.title: Executive Support Officer
jobs.description:
**Provide trusted executive support that helps drive effective decision-making, operational excellence and emergency management capability across Victoria.**

Are you an experienced administration and executive support professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys working with senior leaders and can confidently manage competing priorities?

The Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action (DEECA) is seeking an **Executive Support Officer** to provide high-quality administrative, coordination and secretariat support to senior executives within the Forest and Fire Assets and Resources Division.

This is an opportunity to join a purpose-driven team that supports Forest Fire Management Victoria (FFMVic) and broader emergency management operations across the state. You will play a key role in supporting executive priorities, coordinating communications, managing governance processes and contributing to the effective operation of a division responsible for critical assets, logistics and resources valued at more than $2 billion.

As an **Executive Support Officer**, you will provide trusted support to Directors by managing diaries, coordinating meetings, maintaining correspondence and records, supporting reporting and governance activities, and fostering strong relationships across government, industry and operational stakeholders.

**About the role**

You will bring:

* proven experience providing executive support in complex, fast-paced and sensitive environments
* strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines
* experience supporting business planning, governance and performance reporting activities
* excellent written communication skills, including preparing briefs, correspondence, reports and meeting documentation
* demonstrated stakeholder management skills and the ability to build effective relationships across all levels of an organisation
* exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to manage confidential and sensitive matters with discretion and professionalism
* advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint and OneNote
* a commitment to teamwork, continuous improvement, cultural safety and positive workplace culture.
* This role may involve emergency response support activities and requires flexibility to work additional hours, including weekends and public holidays during peak fire seasons when required.

**Why join us?**

You will be part of a collaborative and supportive team that values safety, integrity, service excellence and continuous improvement.

DEECA offers:

* meaningful work supporting Victoria's forest, fire and emergency management capability
* the opportunity to work directly with senior leaders and contribute to strategic and operational outcomes
* a flexible and inclusive workplace with hybrid working arrangements
* opportunities for professional growth and development within a large and diverse government organisation
* the chance to work with a broad range of stakeholders across government, emergency management and industry sectors.

**Specialist/Technical Expertise/Qualifications**

* Proven successful experience providing executive support to executives in complex, changing priority and, sensitive workplaces
* Proven successful experiences and capabilities using technology platforms associated with the management of the FFAR business
* Proven successful experience supporting business planning, performance reporting and governance.
* Proven stakeholder management experience including but not limited to executives, senior commercial partners and, interagency practitioners

**This is an ongoing position. The work location for this position is Kyle Road, Altona North with hybrid work arrangements available.**

To be considered for this position, applicants are encouraged to submit a resume and cover letter (no longer than 2 pages) summarising their skills and relevant experience.

Please refer to the Key Selection Criteria provided in the **Position Description**, including the mandatory requirements.

**How to Apply:**

**If you are a current DEECA employee, please apply via DEECA Careers.**

Applications close **11.59pm on Thursday, 03 September 2026.**

All applications must be submitted through the online portal. We are unable to consider email or manual applications at this time.

**Other relevant information:**

Preferred candidates will be required to undertake pre-employment screening, including a Declaration and Consent form and a Nationally Coordinated Criminal History Check.

To be eligible for appointment to this role, applicants will possess corresponding work rights for the advertised employment period. Appointment to an ongoing position is only available to an Australian/New Zealand citizen or an Australian Permanent Resident.

**An inclusive, culturally safe and flexible workplace**

*DEECA fosters an inclusive workplace culture and is committed to a fair, accessible, and equitable recruitment process.*

*We strongly encourage Aboriginal and or Torres Strait Islander people to apply. We recognise the strengths, knowledge and perspectives First Nations people bring and DEECA is committed to a culturally safe and respectful workplace. If you need support to participate, please contact* *aboriginal.employment@deeca.vic.gov.au**.*

*We support flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work, varied hours, part-time work and job sharing. For more information about our recruitment processes, visit****applying for a role with us****.*
