jobs.title: Software Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Be the hands-on builder who turns product vision into working software, fast.

**About Us**

Erin Living Technologies is a fast-growing tech company working to improve liveability for people everywhere. Our resident management platform is built for modern communities, bringing seamless solutions and next-level convenience to the table. Together, we're all about teamwork, big ideas, and giving everyone the very best experience of the place where they live.!

Headquartered in Melbourne but with a team across multiple parts of the globe, we're shaking up the property game with our snazzy enterprise-level PropTech solution! Our resident-first mobile app is designed to be a daily feature of life in a community, while the complementary Manager app is used by building operators to handle back-of-house. We integrate with a wide variety of management software platforms, hardware, and in-building tech to round out the ultimate experience.

So, let's team up, have some fun, and make magic happen!

**About the Role**

Ready to step into a role where you get to build the product, not just talk about it? We’re all-in on an AI-first approach where Product team members can build directly; not just prototype and mockup. Features are built from solid engineering components, and when ready, they move into engineering review, QA, and release.

As a **Software Product Engineer**, you're the hands-on technical force supporting that build.

If you're excited by the idea of turning fast-moving product ideas into solid, review-ready software, and you'd rather find the problem now than have QA find it later, this is your chance to shine.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Requirements & Specification**

* Clearly articulate value, outcomes, functionality and behaviour
* Prepare PRDs (Product Requirement Documents) — before, after, or in parallel with prototyping
* Carefully consider flows, edge cases and scenarios so build and QA have full context

**Hands-on Build**

* Prototype, develop and iterate on features within our product-led engineering approach, working to direction from the product and engineering leads
* Get features working end-to-end, handing them to the development team production-ready
* Investigate and resolve issues in prototyped features — in code, not in theory
* Provide technical support to the team's AI-assisted building, picking up the more technical pieces and flagging issues to the leads

**Supporting Processes for Scalable Product Engineering**

* Identify opportunities for structure, conventions and guardrails that let non-technical team members build with AI in a consistent, reviewable, scalable way
* Keep guardrails current as the product and tooling evolve, and flag where they're being outgrown

**Product Quality**

* Work closely with QA to proactively identify and resolve issues at the prototype stage, updating PRDs where needed
* Surface edge cases, error states and failure modes — the ones that don't appear in a quick demo
* Identify ways technology can boost manual QA coverage on every release

**About You**

You're the kind of person who loves getting stuck into a well-considered build — curious, hands-on, and always looking one step ahead for what could go wrong. You bring energy and focus to every feature, whether it's a clean build or a gnarly edge case. You love nutting through scenarios, you thrive on turning a rough prototype into something solid, and you get a buzz out of writing the test that catches the bug before production does.

Comfortable without a fixed process, you take direction well and adapt quickly as priorities shift week to week. Collaboration is your comfort zone — you're just as happy pairing with the product and engineering leads as you are picking up a feature and running with it solo.

**You'll Bring**

* Hands-on coding ability — comfortable building and modifying features in code, with working knowledge of a general-purpose language, version control, and how a web application fits together
* A sharp quality and edge-case instinct — you naturally look for the unhappy path and the failure modes that love to surface in production
* Comfort with shifting priorities — happy to take direction on what matters this week, and to change focus as the team's needs move
* The ability to work well with non-technical colleagues — picking up the technical pieces, and explaining what's going on without making anyone feel silly for asking
* Data literacy — comfortable enough with Python or SQL to answer a question with numbers rather than a hunch

**Bonus Points For**

* Familiarity with automated testing tools and approaches (such as Selenium or Postman)
* Experience in a SaaS or B2B product environment
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines or DevOps tooling
* A background spanning both development and QA
* Experience in fast-moving or prototype-first teams, where requirements arrive alongside the work rather than before it

**Your Success Will Be Measured By**

* Features shipped end-to-end, production-ready and review-ready
* Automated test coverage that keeps quality measurable as the product grows
* Edge cases and failure modes caught early — before QA or production find them
* Guardrails and conventions that keep AI-assisted building consistent and scalable
* Behavioural data and experiments that inform what gets built next

**Why Join Us?**

**Why join our company?**

Is there anything cooler than riding the wave of a tech company skyrocketing from start-up to scale-up? Nope, there isn't!

Here's why you'll love it here:

* **Be Part of Innovation:** Help shape the future of PropTech with cutting-edge solutions that are changing the game.
* **Flexibility:** Enjoy hybrid work arrangements and a super supportive work culture that's got your back.
* **Career Growth:** Level up with professional development opportunities in a fast-paced, exciting environment where your potential has no limits.

Ready to join the ride? Let's make some waves together!

**How to Apply**

Ready to build the future of PropTech and turn ideas into working software? We want to hear from you!

Apply now and join a team that's shaking up the world of product engineering! Let's do amazing things together!

Pay: $110,000.00 – $120,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Southbank VIC

You will work closely with internal stakeholders and technical teams to deliver secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure solutions that support a large and complex national business.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement and maintain Microsoft infrastructure environments
* Manage and support Azure and on-premises systems
* Lead the design and deployment of Azure Landing Zones
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) capabilities using Terraform
* Drive automation and standardisation across infrastructure services
* Manage and optimise Active Directory, Azure AD and Windows Server environments
* Support cloud migration, modernisation and transformation initiatives
* Collaborate with security, networking and application teams to deliver best-practice solutions
* Contribute to documentation, governance, operational excellence and continuous improvement

### **Essential**

* Microsoft Azure
* On-premise Microsoft environments
* Active Directory (AD)
* Azure Active Directory / Entra ID
* Azure Landing Zone design and deployment
* Windows Server administration and engineering
* Microsoft infrastructure design and support

jobs.title: Data Architect
jobs.description:
**Experience:** 6–10 Years

**Location:**Sydney; Melbourne; Brisbane

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced **Data Architect** with strong expertise in **Databricks, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Python, SQL, and Apache Spark**. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing scalable, secure, and high-performance data architecture and solutions across cloud data platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement scalable **enterprise data architecture** and data platforms.
* Define data models, architecture standards, integration patterns, and best practices.
* Design modern data solutions using **Databricks, Azure Data Factory, and Spark**.
* Provide technical leadership for data engineering and analytics initiatives.
* Design **ETL/ELT pipelines**, data lakes, data warehouses, and lakehouse architectures.
* Work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, analysts, and solution architects.
* Ensure data quality, security, governance, lineage, and compliance.
* Optimize data platforms for performance, scalability, and cost.
* Review technical designs and guide development teams on architecture decisions.
* Troubleshoot complex data architecture and integration challenges.

**Required Skills**

* 6–10 years of experience in **Data Architecture / Data Engineering**.
* Strong hands-on experience with **Databricks and Apache Spark**.
* Strong knowledge of **Azure Data Factory (ADF)**.
* Excellent **SQL and Python** skills.
* Experience designing **Azure-based data platforms**.
* Strong understanding of **Data Lake, Data Warehouse, and Lakehouse architecture**.
* Experience with data modelling, ETL/ELT, data integration, and performance optimization.
* Knowledge of data governance, security, metadata, and data quality frameworks.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with **Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS)** and **Delta Lake**.
* Knowledge of **Azure Synapse Analytics**.
* Experience with CI/CD, Git, and Azure DevOps.
* Understanding of **Medallion Architecture** and modern cloud data platforms.
* Relevant Azure/Databricks certifications.

Pay: $1,000.00 – $1,200.00 per day

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Melbourne VIC

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.description:
* Be part of one of the most innovative companies in Australia with industry leading technology
* A place to truly be yourself and thrive in your career from the beginning
* Recognised and endorsed as an employer for all women by Work180 – ranking within the top 101 workplaces for 2026

**About Us**

At Sportsbet, we’re united behind our purpose to Bring Excitement to Life for over **2.4 million** customers. We do this by delivering fun, challenging the status quo, and living our values. As part of the global Flutter Group, we’re a major player internationally, but in Melbourne, Sydney and Darwin, we’re a tightknit team of 1,300+ teammates (with over half in Tech & Data Science).

Our commitment to responsible gambling is genuine and demonstrated through the wide range of responsible gambling initiatives and tools. We’re proud to be the leaders in responsible gambling in our industry, not just locally, but globally.

We are one of the top workplaces for Women through **WORK180**. WORK180 is a leading platform that independently assesses employers on policies, benefits and practices that support women and underrepresented groups at work. We remain committed to making **Sportsbet the best place to work** and encourage you to explore our employer profile on the WORK180 website to learn more about what we offer.

**About The Role**

We’re scaling development here at Sportsbet and are looking for a Junior Software Engineer (Java) to join our Betting Product Technology team in Melbourne.

This is an exciting opportunity for a backend engineer who thrives on designing and building reliable, scalable systems and wants to make a meaningful impact in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.

You will bring solid technical capability, sound engineering judgement and a genuine sense of ownership. You’ll contribute not only through hands-on development, but also by uplifting engineering standards and helping drive a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities include**

* Design, build and evolve scalable backend services and platforms
* Deliver high-quality software with a focus on maintainability, reliability and performance
* Own and improve CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and DevOps practices
* Identify and proactively manage technical debt, system risks and opportunities for improvement

**About You**

While we are big on development and offer on the job training, we want to set you up for success.

You combine technical depth with professionalism and accountability. You enjoy solving meaningful problems, working collaboratively across teams and lifting the capability of those around you. You are adaptable, delivery-focused and motivated by building great systems and strong engineering practices.

* Experience in Java and Spring Boot.
* Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices and event-driven architecture.
* Experience with messaging and streaming technologies such as Kafka.
* Working knowledge of AWS, including services such as EC2, ECS, VPC, CloudFormation, CloudWatch and RDS.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing and engineering tooling such as Docker, Jenkins and Ansible.
* Understanding of observability, secure coding and modern software engineering practices.

**The Perks**

We work hard and play hard, so along with a competitive salary and generous performance-based bonus for permanent staff members, here’s some of our other perks:

* 25 days annual leave (that’s right, an additional week’s leave!)
* Hybrid working policy (Monday and Friday from home) and a $1,050 home office allowance for new starters.
* Industry leading Parental Leave support program with 26 weeks paid leave for Primary Carers and no wait time. We also have a progressive return to work benefit for your first 6 months back: come back for 3 days, get paid for 4; come back for 4 days, get paid for 5.
* Hack Days - where your creativity and collaborative ideas lead to exciting new ideas and projects for our customers.
* Access to outstanding career development programs, including expert-led internal training and external learning opportunities (staff allowance for personal development)
* Weekly concierge service including free massages and nail appointments – all onsite in our Melbourne office!
* Free breakfast, daily fresh fruit and weekly rotating socials, from Thursday office drinks to fun team events
* End of trip facilities with onsite table tennis and pool tables
* Discounted health insurance and free flu jabs yearly.

We review applications within the first two weeks, so apply now! Check out our **Instagram** and **TikTok** (@lifeatsportsbet), LinkedIn, and careers website for more information about our inclusive culture.

**Our Focus on Diversity, Equity & Inclusion**

We don’t just support diversity – we celebrate it! This is a workplace where you can thrive and feel safe to bring your whole authentic self to work.

**What’s the** **Green Tick Feeling****?**

Well, it’s different for everyone, yet unites us all. It’s the feeling you get when you succeed, no matter what success looks like to you. It's all the little and big things that make you feel like you’re thriving when working at Sportsbet.

We’re an inclusive employer who welcomes you for who you are, as you are – so, if you require adjustments to the recruitment process, please let us know in your application. We also know flex means different things to different people, so let us know how we can support you to be your best.

If you think you’d be a great fit but don’t necessarily meet everything in the job description, please still get in touch.

**Ready to bring excitement to life? Apply now**

jobs.title: Head of Transport Industry, ANZ Public Sector Industry Business Development Team
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**

Lead the transformation of how people and goods move across Australia and New Zealand. As AWS's Head of Transport Industry, you'll shape the future of connected mobility, intelligent infrastructure, and sustainable transport — partnering with the region's most ambitious transport leaders to solve challenges both at a national and global scale.

This is a rare opportunity to combine deep transport sector expertise with the world's most comprehensive cloud platform to drive generational change across road, rail, maritime, aviation, and urban mobility — at a time when ANZ transport investment is accelerating, from smart corridors to Brisbane 2032 and beyond.

Key job responsibilities
Thought Leadership: Serve as a super-influencer and evangelist for AWS within the Transport sector through keynote speeches, panel discussions, publications, and industry events focused on connected mobility, intelligent infrastructure, and sustainable transport.

GTM Strategy Ownership: Lead creation, inspection, and evolution of industry GTM strategy across ANZ for Transport with customer-obsessed continuous improvement across road, rail, maritime, aviation, and urban mobility

Executive Engagement: Build and nurture Ministerial, Secretary, and CXO-level relationships with state and federal transport agencies, infrastructure authorities, and industry bodies to inspire innovation and enable long-term transformation across the Transport industry

Force Multiplier: Provide differentiated support to account and partner teams through executive briefings, presentations, account planning, and proposal preparation.

Customer Advocacy: Act as feedback conduit between transport customers and AWS product/service teams to shape future strategies representing the diverse needs of the ANZ transport sector

Business Development: Drive cloud adoption across a sector undergoing generational investment in smart corridors, multimodal integration, and fleet electrification — addressing shared challenges including legacy systems, fragmented data silos, siloed modal operations, and aging asset management platforms

Partner Development: Grow and scale a community of culturally aligned Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) and Systems Integrators (SIs) through the Amazon Partner Network (APN) to deliver repeatable transport solutions

About the team
The AWS Industry Business Development team brings deep sector expertise to help public sector customers achieve their mission outcomes. Industry leaders operate through three core pillars: Inspire — establishing a credible voice that shapes policy settings and drives long-term industry transformation; Translate — converting complex customer challenges into repeatable, scalable go-to-market solutions delivered through AWS and its partners; and Enable — infusing industry knowledge across the AWS village and partner community through value maps, joint GTM plans, and enablement programs to ensure differentiated, business-aligned outcomes for customers.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years experience building, leading, and managing programs and business initiatives in the Transport or Infrastructure sector.
* • 5+ years developing programs in or for transport agencies, infrastructure bodies, or related government organisations.
* • 3+ years working in or providing services to public sector agencies.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years developing programs within a technology company serving the Transport vertical.
* • 10+ years of experience in Transport, Infrastructure, or Urban Mobility sectors.
* • Strong credibility with government transport executives, infrastructure leaders, and industry groups (e.g., ITS Australia, Australasian Railway Association, Roads Australia, Transport & Infrastructure Council).
* • Experience with public-private partnerships (PPPs), infrastructure concession models, and government procurement frameworks.

- • Knowledge of emerging transport technologies including autonomous vehicles, electric vehicle infrastructure, Mobility-as-a-Service (MaaS), IoT, and digital twins.

jobs.title: Project Support Officer
jobs.description:
**About us**

AHA is Australia's largest specialist health and human services consultancy. Now in our 35th year, we partner with federal, state and territory governments to improve health and social outcomes for Australians by delivering evaluations, reviews and program administration engagements of major national importance.

AHA’s story is all about its people. We pride ourselves on our supportive and inclusive culture, and on the vision, creativity, and drive of our staff. Our high-performing team of passionate and talented individuals works collaboratively to deliver great outcomes for our clients.

You will be joining an organisation that is very involved in ensuring that Victoria’s children and young people with disabilities and additional needs receive the inclusion support they need to participate in their education on the same basis as their peers.

**About the role**

The Kindergarten Inclusion Support (KIS) program provides additional support to government-funded Victorian kindergartens to promote the access and participation of children with disability, developmental delay with high support needs, or complex medical needs.

There are two streams that kindergartens can apply for additional support under:

* Kindergarten Inclusion Support Program – Disability
* Kindergarten Inclusion Support Program – Complex Medical Needs.

The KIS project support team is responsible for the efficient and accurate processing of over 4,500 applications for additional support per year.

As a Project Support Officer, you will:

* Provide help desk support to kindergarten services, KIS providers, and Department of Education staff in relation to application enquiries.
* Assist kindergarten staff to sign up to the KIS application portal, and support with ongoing use and resolving any technical difficulties they may experience.
* Check and validate applications against program requirements.
* Direct applications through each stage of the application process.
* Provide support to AHA's team of application assessors.

**On offer**

* Commencement: 12 October 2026
* An attractive salary of $76,874 + 12% superannuation FTE (pro-rata for fixed-term).
* Fixed-term contract: either 7 or 9 months to support with peak application period.
* Option to work full-time or 4 days/0.8 FTE.
* Hybrid working arrangements, with a mix of work from home (up to 4 days per week depending on your preference) and office-based (Melbourne CBD) work.
* Provision of technical equipment with access to leading customer support software.
* Ongoing training and support.
* A supportive and collegiate team environment.

**About you**

You pride yourself on delivering excellent customer service and having an eye for detail.

In addition, you have:

* 3+ years of experience in project/program support or similar administration role. Experience in the health, disability or education sectors will be highly regarded.
* A proactive and flexible approach to undertake varied tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong computer skills, including data entry, database management, and ability to provide technical support.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience liaising with external stakeholders by telephone and email.
* Good organisational skills and effective time management.
* An ability to quickly learn and apply new concepts and knowledge.

**To apply** please upload your **CV and a cover letter** outlining how your skills and experience align with the requirements of the role. Please include your preference to work full-time or 4 days/week on your application.

**Note:** applications that do not include a tailored cover letter will not be considered.

**Applications close 5pm Monday 7 September 2026.**

All questions can be directed to recruitment@aha.com.au

**Applicants must have full Australian working rights.**

**The successful candidate will be required to undergo a police check and working with children check prior to commencement.**

Further information about AHA is available at our website: www.aha.com.au

**Agency applications will not be considered.**

*AHA is an Equal Opportunity Employer who provides an inclusive work environment and embraces the diverse talent of its people. We support flexible and accessible working arrangements for all. This includes people with a disability, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders, culturally, religiously, and linguistically diverse people, young people, older people, and people who identify as gay, lesbian, bisexual, transgender, intersex, or queer. All are encouraged to apply.*

jobs.title: Recruitment Consultant
jobs.description:
**About Weploy**

We are a tech enabled recruitment agency with a mission to make Recruitment Not Suck.

We specialise in customer service and contact centre talent and partner with some of Australia's biggest brands such as Medibank, Australian Unity and Rebel Sport. We are known for one thing: getting quality bums on seats, fast.

No slow process. No fluff. Just great candidates placed quickly and a team that actually gives a damn. We are growing fast, and we need someone who can support the engine that keeps us moving.

**Weploy Benefits**

* Full time role working Mon Fri 9 - 5pm
* Flexible & fully remote working arrangement, no office commute!
* Bonus paid out quarterly based on what you put in, own your success
* The opportunity to join a collaborative and social team, that works hard and does not take itself too seriously
* A clear progression pathway with ongoing training and development
* Real diversity across your desk, you won't be boxed into one industry or role type
* No cap on what you can earn or achieve as you grow your desk
* Melbourne based candidates preferred for connection and collaboration

**About the Role**

We have been busy and we are now entering our next phase of growth. As a 360 Recruitment Consultant you will own the full recruitment cycle, from winning new business through to placing and supporting candidates in perm and niche roles. This is our search arm of the business, and a true 360 role where your business development skills are just as important as your delivery skills.

Unlike other agencies, you won't be boxed into a single industry or role type. You will have real diversity across your desk and there is no cap on what you can achieve. **You'll start with roles ready to fill,** and bring your own expertise, ideas and network to map it out and grow it further.

You will build and grow your own client base, identify new opportunities and bring on new business, while also speaking with candidates, assessing suitability and guiding them into the right roles. You will manage the full process end to end, giving you real ownership over your desk and your results.

You will also support community engagement activities that help create a sense of belonging for our Weployees and assist them throughout their assignments.

**Role Responsibilities**

* Own the full 360 recruitment cycle across perm and niche roles, from business development through to placement
* Identify, pitch and win new business, building a strong and sustainable client base
* Manage client relationships, understanding their hiring needs and positioning Weploy as their trusted partner
* Speak with candidates and assess suitability for perm and niche opportunities
* Add successful candidates to the Weployee Community and ensure a positive onboarding experience
* Manage candidate pipelines and keep delivery moving at speed
* Prepare resumes, candidate summaries and shortlists
* Collaborate with internal teams to execute on talent strategies and initiatives
* Maintain high quality candidate and client communication and follow ups
* Stay across compliance, awards, contracts and worker entitlements
* Review and track data to identify gaps and opportunities

**About You**

You are human centred, commercially minded and love speaking with people. You care about creating great experiences and you are excited by growth. You are someone who rolls up their sleeves, thinks in outcomes and enjoys being part of a fast moving team.

* Recruitment experience is essential, ideally in a 360 or business development focused role, with a track record of winning and growing client relationships
* Experience in perm or niche recruitment is highly valued
* Bonus points if you have GTM experience or have run a **sales or finance desk**
* You are commercially savvy, comfortable picking up the phone and confident having conversations that lead to new business
* You have a hunger for growth and want to join an established start up who is still going through advanced phases of growth, and don't mind communicating through Emoji's from time to time
* You have a voice and don't mind using it when it comes to making things better. If you see something that can be improved and you take action, rather than letting it go
* You know how to use Slack, G Suite and ideally Greenhouse, although any previous ATS experience is great

**What's next?**

Apply now and kick start your Weploy journey.

**Company Description**

**Fairness feels good**

Make a real impact at AFCA. Where fairness drives every decision. Help us deliver world-class, independent complaints resolution for Australians. As a not-for-profit and progressive financial ombudsman, we’re championing positive change. Achieving our purpose takes progressive thinking, accountability and resilience. At AFCA, our inclusive leadership values every voice. We offer our people flexible work options, thoughtful benefits and opportunities to deepen expertise. Flourish in a diverse, caring culture. Feel the difference of belonging to an organisation intentionally designed to put people first.

**Job Description**

At AFCA, fairness is at the heart of everything we do. Behind every successful customer interaction, investigation and outcome is technology that works seamlessly. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a customer-focused **IT Service & Systems Support Officer** to join our Information Services team. You'll be the go-to expert helping colleagues across the organisation stay connected, productive and supported, while contributing to the technology that enables AFCA to make a real difference for Australians.

You'll be the first point of contact for IT support while also working across infrastructure, end-user technology, telephony and enterprise systems. You'll troubleshoot, resolve, improve and optimise technology services, helping hundreds of colleagues do their best work every day.

**What you'll be doing**

* Deliver exceptional Level 1 and Level 2 IT support across end-user devices, telephony, infrastructure and systems.
* Manage and resolve incidents and service requests through our service desk.
* Support user accounts, system access and technology changes.
* Deploy, configure and maintain computers, telephony and network infrastructure.
* Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors to resolve issues and improve services.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and technology projects.
* Help drive a positive, customer-focused support experience across AFCA.

**Qualifications**

You'll thrive in this role if you're someone who enjoys solving problems, helping people and staying curious about technology.

**We're looking for:**

* Experience providing IT support that is customer focused.
* Knowledge of Active Directory, end-user computing and basic networking.
* Strong troubleshooting and incident management skills.
* Outstanding communication and customer service capabilities.
* Experience supporting cloud and on-premises environments.
* Exposure to technologies such as Microsoft Exchange, Windows Server, SQL Server and VMware.
* ITIL knowledge or certification will be highly regarded.
* Experience with IP telephony systems is advantageous.

**Additional Information**

**Additional Information**

* **Gold AWEI Accreditation 2025** – Recognised for LGBTQ+ workplace inclusion.
* **Accredited Family Friendly Workplace** – Supporting work-life balance and inclusivity.
* **Hybrid working** – Flexible arrangements with two days a week in our modern offices designed for collaboration and wellbeing.
* **Additional and inclusive leave options** – Flexible public holidays, gender affirmation leave, women’s health leave, and bonus paid time off over the end of year holiday period.

**To apply**

If you’re passionate about fairness and believe your skills align with this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every single criterion.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and gender identities. If you require any accessibility support during the recruitment process, please reach out to our team at [email protected].

We believe fairness starts with people. That’s why we don’t use AI or automated tools to screen candidates. As a result, our processes may take a little longer, and we thank you for your patience.

**About AFCA**

The Australian Financial Complaints Authority (AFCA) was established in 2018 as a private not-for-profit ombudsman service providing free, fair and independent help with financial disputes. The original team has grown to over 1600 dedicated professionals. Since 2018, AFCA has received more than 634,000 complaints, helping to secure $2.1 billion in compensation for consumers.

**AFCA is a 2026 Circle Back Initiative Employer - we are committed to responding to every applicant.**

jobs.title: Workshop & Operations All-Rounder
jobs.description:
**About Maker Store**

Maker Store is an engineering and technology company supplying CNC machines, 3D printers, robotics, linear motion components, electronics and other equipment to customers across Australia. We are looking for a practical, hands-on **All-Rounder** to join our team and help with the wide range of jobs involved in running a growing engineering business.

**The Role**

This is a **hands-on, varied position** where no two days are necessarily the same.

You might be building industrial workbenches and furniture one day, assembling a CNC machine the next, preparing products for customers, fixing something around the workshop, or helping with whatever needs to get done.

We are looking for someone who is **practical, mechanically minded, reliable and willing to have a go**.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Building industrial furniture, workbenches and workstations
* Assembling CNC machines, 3D printers and other equipment
* Cutting, drilling, fastening and assembling aluminium extrusion and other materials
* Using hand and power tools
* Picking, packing and preparing orders when required
* Moving and organising stock and equipment
* Working Closely with engineering team
* Helping with warehouse and workshop organisation
* Basic maintenance and repairs
* Assisting with product testing and preparation
* Loading and unloading deliveries
* Helping with installations and projects
* Keeping the workshop and work areas clean and organised
* Taking on general jobs and projects as they arise

**About You:**

We are seeking an ideal candidate who seamlessly aligns with our company culture and values, embodying three core qualities that define our team:

**Positive Energy:**

We are looking for someone who exudes positivity, creating an uplifting and collaborative atmosphere. The ability to approach challenges with optimism and enthusiasm is key.

**Problem-Solving:**

Our ideal candidate possesses a strong problem-solving intelligence. They should thrive in navigating complexities, approaching issues with a strategic mindset, and proactively seeking innovative solutions.

**Extra Mile Mindset:**

We value individuals who go above and beyond. The ideal candidate embraces an 'extra mile mindset,' demonstrating a commitment to excellence and a willingness to contribute beyond expectations. This proactive approach aligns with our vision for growth, and we welcome candidates eager to evolve and advance with the company.

You don't necessarily need formal qualifications. **We care more about your ability to work with your hands, solve problems and get things done. All training will be provided.**

The ideal person will:

* Be mechanically minded and practical
* Be comfortable using hand and power tools
* Have good basic DIY and fabrication skills
* Be able to read basic drawings or instructions
* Have good attention to detail
* Be physically capable of lifting and moving equipment
* Be reliable, punctual and hardworking
* Be comfortable working independently
* Be willing to learn new skills
* Have a **"I'll figure it out"** attitude
* Take pride in producing good-quality work

**Experience That Would Be an Advantage**

Experience with any of the following would be useful:

* Aluminium extrusion
* CNC machines
* 3D printers
* Welding or fabrication
* Mechanical assembly
* Electrical/electronic equipment
* Furniture or workstation construction
* Warehousing
* Manufacturing or engineering
* Forklift operation

**Why Work With Us?**

This is a great opportunity for someone who **doesn't want to sit behind a desk all day** and enjoys working on different projects.

You'll be working with interesting engineering products and equipment and will have the opportunity to learn about CNC, automation, robotics, 3D printing and manufacturing.

**If you're a practical person who enjoys building, fixing, making and solving problems, we'd like to hear from you.**

Apply with your resume and a short note telling us about your practical experience and the types of things you've built, repaired or worked on.

Pay: $52,880.00 – $65,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Employee mentoring program
* Free food

Licence/Certification:

* Full Driver Licence (Preferred)

Work Authorisation:

* Australia (Required)

Work Location: In person

The Affinda platform combines advanced language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and configurable workflows so organisations can extract data, orchestrate processes, and embed AI safely into their day-to-day operations.

Our revenues are scaling rapidly, with 2,000+ customers globally and a team of ~100 people in 10 countries. We are well capitalised and are currently investing in multiple growth engines to accelerate our ambition of becoming an Australian AI company of global significance.

Reporting to our General Counsel (GC) in Melbourne, this will be a part-time role working maximum 3 days a week with a potential for full time based on business growth. You will play a key role in working directly with the GC and other stakeholders across the full contract lifecycle including reviewing customer, vendor and partner agreements.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Ownership of the contract repository, templates and precedents, and our public legal pages
* Take corporate policies from drafting through rollout, implementation and review
* Be a point of contact for sales on customer legal and regulatory questions

* Act as the connective tissue between Legal and other functions — particularly around deal desk support and contract negotiation logistics

* Minimum 3 years qualified and post-qualification experience in either commercial contracts or a legal operations / legal practice management role

Melbourne, Australia. We operate in a hybrid working environment whilst valuing in-person collaboration

jobs.title: Aboriginal Health Worker Trainee
jobs.description:
**Aboriginal Healthcare Worker Traineeship**

### **Salary: $72,000 base salary plus superannuation**

### **Location: Various Sites across Victoria**

**About the Opportunity**

**Launch your career in Aboriginal Health with a fully paid traineeship that's designed to support your success.**

GEO Healthcare is offering a unique opportunity for Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people to begin a rewarding and meaningful career in healthcare while earning a full-time wage.

As an Aboriginal Healthcare Worker Trainee, you will be employed full-time by GEO Healthcare while we sponsor and support you to complete a nationally recognised qualification in Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Primary Health Care.

This is more than just a traineeship it's a pathway to a long-term healthcare career where you can make a genuine difference to the health and wellbeing of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities.

Throughout the program, you will gain practical, hands-on experience working alongside experienced Aboriginal Health Workers and Health Practitioners, while developing the knowledge and skills required to become a qualified Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander Health Practitioner.

### **What's on offer?**

* Full-time paid employment while you study
* Salary of $72,000 plus superannuation
* GEO Healthcare-sponsored qualification
* Paid study leave and dedicated learning support
* On-the-job mentoring from experienced Aboriginal Health professionals
* A nationally recognised healthcare qualification
* A clear pathway into a rewarding long-term career in Aboriginal Health
* Guaranteed practical experience in a healthcare setting from day one
* Ongoing employment opportunities upon successful completion of the traineeship

**Why Join GEO Healthcare?**

GEO Healthcare is committed to improving health outcomes for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people through culturally safe, holistic and person centred healthcare.

As a Trainee Aboriginal Health Worker, you will play an important role in supporting the health and wellbeing of Aboriginal patients within a correctional healthcare environment. You will work as part of a multidisciplinary healthcare team that is dedicated to delivering culturally responsive care and advocating for the unique cultural and healthcare needs of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people.

This is a rare opportunity to build a professional healthcare career while making a meaningful contribution to your community.

**About GEO Healthcare**

GEO Healthcare employs highly skilled multidisciplinary healthcare teams to ensure people in custody can access the healthcare services they need.

GEO Healthcare operates across all Victorian men's public prisons, delivering comprehensive primary healthcare services to people in prison.

GEO Healthcare is a subsidiary of The GEO Group Australia Pty Ltd, a company that has been providing correctional and healthcare services throughout Australia for more than 30 years.

**What You'll Be Doing**

During your traineeship, you will work under the supervision of experienced Aboriginal Health Workers and Aboriginal Health Practitioners, receiving ongoing support and mentoring throughout your learning journey.

Overall supervision of the traineeship program is provided by the Manager, Aboriginal Health within GEO Healthcare.

You will gain practical experience in:

* Delivering culturally safe healthcare services
* Supporting Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander patients to access healthcare
* Health promotion and education
* Assisting with primary healthcare programs
* Working collaboratively with healthcare professionals
* Advocating for the cultural and health needs of Aboriginal patients
* Developing clinical skills within a professional healthcare environment

**Who Can Apply?**

To be eligible, applicants must:

* Be 18 years of age or older.
* Identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander.
* Be of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander descent.

*(An applicant's race is a genuine occupational qualification and is authorised under Section 14 of the Equal Opportunity Act.)*

Applicants should also demonstrate:

* A genuine interest in pursuing a career in Aboriginal Health.
* A commitment to undertaking the Certificate IV in Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Primary Health Care Practice as part of the traineeship.
* An understanding of the health and social issues affecting Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples.
* The ability to engage and communicate respectfully and effectively with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and communities.

**Qualifications Supported Through the Traineeship**

GEO Healthcare will sponsor and support trainees to complete one of the following nationally recognised qualifications:

* **Certificate III in Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Primary Health Care**
* **Certificate IV in Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Primary Health Care Practice**

Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) Approved Programs of Study.

### **Course Duration**

**18 months to 2 years**

**Start Your Career in Aboriginal Health**

If you are passionate about supporting your community and want to develop a rewarding healthcare career, this traineeship offers a unique opportunity to earn a full-time salary, gain valuable workplace experience, and achieve a nationally recognised qualification with the support of GEO Healthcare.

**Apply today and take the first step towards becoming an Aboriginal Health Practitioner.**

**How to Apply:**

To apply, we ask that you complete the short questionnaire below and attach a cover letter and current resume. Geo Healthcare offers support to anyone interested in our opportunity.

**To obtain further information about the application and recruitment process, please contact Malcolm Timbery, Manager Aboriginal Health on 0499 314 388.**

**Make a real difference – Apply Now!**

People with diverse backgrounds and Aboriginal & Torres Strait Islander applicants are strongly encouraged to apply.

We are always looking for people to join or company who share the values that we stand for:

**UNDERSTANDING RESPECT ACCOUNTABLE TEAMWORK EXCELLENCE**

jobs.title: Security Program Manager, AWS DC Security
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**

Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance, with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. For more information visit www.agsva.gov.au.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) Infrastructure Physical Security is seeking a highly talented and motivated Security Program Manager to join our team. AWS is the leading cloud provider, providing virtualized infrastructure, storage, networking, messaging, and many other services to customers all over the world. The role is responsible for overseeing physical security design and the installation of security features and systems including Access Control, Intrusion Detection, Camera Surveillance, Passive and Active Barriers, and other security features and capabilities consistent with AWS security standards and public sector contract requirements. This role will perform security program management in support of new data centers, support facilities, data center expansions, and special security programs and projects.

You will be an individual contributor and will work directly with the Cluster Security Managers (CSMs), the Data Center Engineering Operations Team, and other customers, both internal and external, to integrate business and operations requirements into long-term physical security design and implementation. You will work with limited guidance to support the design and deployment of physical security packages and security program enhancements for AWS data centers and supporting facilities. Additionally, you will work across multiple teams and serve as the subject matter expert to author security design, Concept of Operations (CONOPS), security installation and sustainment contracts, and other security documents for submittals. You will lead projects and develop short-term solutions in the physical security program. You may influence and manage vendor contracts to ensure industry leading systems are deployed and sustained.

The ideal candidate for the role has a deep understanding of Security Construction and Equipment Committee (SCEC) physical security requirements and leverages that expertise to make the right decisions for physical security projects and site sustainment. The candidate will handle a difficult security problems and compliance program elements clearing blockers and escalating appropriately when unable to clear the blocker. The candidate will be comfortable identifying risks and asking the right question to the appropriate team to identify tradeoffs and suggesting recommendations and solutions. Additionally, the candidate will work across multiple teams within an Amazon Security organization to influence both internal and external customers, system owners, and business leaders. The candidate will effectively communicate with stakeholder audiences in a single domain and actively participate in meetings to drive business and technical discussions and decisions. This candidate will support their Manager in AWS engagements with internal and external stakeholders to coordinate physical security approvals.

Key job responsibilities

* Lead physical security design and system installation for new data centers, data center expansions and special projects.

* Provide physical security project lifecycle management including bid packages, specifications, drawings, code compliance, vendor management, budget, change orders, and close-out documentation.

* Manage vendor on-boarding, Request For Proposal / Request For Quote bidding, contracting, contract execution, QA/QC, and support processes.

* Effectively and accurately manage multi-million dollar security project budgets. Own and track the finance and budgeting process for security programs and projects.

* Representative for physical security team acceptance, sign-off, and operational readiness validation for high security facilities in conjunction with other AWS teams.

* Reporting performance metrics such as physical security system installation vendor service delivery performance, actual spend vs. budget variance, cost reduction goal attainment, post installation defect rates, physical security program analysis, etc.

* Collaborate across teams to drive global, regional, and local security initiatives.

* Support Cluster Security Managers by providing physical security analysis and recommend program enhancements to maximize security of assigned locations.

* Position requires occasional travel to AWS facilities in various cities in Australia to support physical security design and system installation for security program or project execution activities.

Hold or be able to attain an Australian Government Security Vetting Agency clearance (see https://www.agsva.gov.au/applicants/eligibility-and-suitability)

About the team
The team is comprised of security professionals with a cross section of national security, law enforcement, and private sector experience, providing a range of perspectives required for creative problem solving. We value diversity of thought, creativity, and a strong Bias for Action. We believe that there are no "perfect" security solutions and we develop and iterate using a continuous improvement process.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Benefits
Learning & development — AWS training and certification support, access to internal learning platforms.
Health, income protection and life cover — Amazon subsidises private health insurance premiums, and group salary continuance and life insurance are included at no cost to you.
Military differential pay launching in Australia — Australian employees taking defence reserve leave may receive up to 52 weeks of military differential pay to help cover the difference in pay while serving.
Employee Assistance Program — Free, confidential support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for you and your family — mental health, financial coaching, legal questions, and everyday life events.
Family-building benefit — Access to Maven for fertility treatment, adoption support, surrogacy, and parenting coaching.
Amazon Extras & employee discount — cashback and discounts across hundreds of retail, fitness, travel, and lifestyle partners.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* 7+ years of experience working with physical security design and/or implementation of electronic security systems such as Access Control System, Intrusion Detection System, and CCTV Surveillance systems. Familiarity with security in depth strategies.
* 5+ years of experience in program or project management, leading both technical and non-technical teams focusing on physical security standards and designs.
* 3+ years of people management and team leadership experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical individuals regarding physical security standards and system designs.
* Proficient understanding of construction plans, elevations, and other design and construction artifacts for architectural, mechanical, electrical, civil, and telecommunications plans.
* Familiar project management and design and construction software.

Acknowledgement of country:
In the spirit of reconciliation Amazon acknowledges the Traditional Custodians of country throughout Australia and their connections to land, sea and community. We pay our respect to their elders past and present and extend that respect to all Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples today.

IDE statement:
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. jobs.title: KMD Brands - ANZ Technical Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Join Our Team at KMD Brands —ANZ Technical Support Specialist

**Location:** South Melbourne or Torquay, Australia

**Brand:** KMD Brands

Are you a hands-on IT professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, supporting large-scale retail operations, and driving technology improvements that make a real impact?

We're looking for an ANZ Technical Support Specialist to join our Technology team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives on troubleshooting, project delivery, and providing exceptional support across a fast-paced retail environment. You'll be the escalation point for our Service Desk, play a key role in new store openings and technology projects, and help shape the development of our Tier 1 support team.

With exposure across Australia, New Zealand, and eventually our broader global network, this role offers plenty of variety, technical challenge, and the opportunity to make your mark across a growing family of iconic outdoor brands.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

At KMD Brands, we believe your job should enrich your life — not just fill your time. When you join our team, you get access to a range of genuinely valuable benefits:

* A brand with purpose
* We are B Corp certified — sustainability and people are at the heart of everything we do. Work for a business that prioritises protecting the planet and giving back.
* Gear you’ll love at prices you’ll love more
* Generous staff discounts across Kathmandu and Rip Curl. Access to additional perks across our wider brand family.
* Grow with us
* Meaningful career opportunities across stores, support offices, and distribution in Australia and New Zealand. Pathways into more departments.
* A culture built on teamwork and adventure
* Work alongside people who share your passion for the outdoors. Be part of a supportive, fun and inclusive team environment.

Reporting to the Global Service Delivery Manager, you'll provide advanced technical support across KMD Brands, managing Tier 1 escalations, complex service requests, and supporting store development projects and IT initiatives.

You'll split your time between day-to-day technical support and project delivery, working closely with internal teams, external partners, and retail stakeholders to ensure technology solutions are implemented smoothly and effectively.

As the primary IT contact for our South Melbourne and Torquay offices, you'll also take ownership of local site support and technology assets, while mentoring the Service Desk team and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

**You will:**

* Act as the escalation point for complex Tier 1 Service Desk issues
* Diagnose and resolve advanced hardware, software, networking, and retail systems problems
* Support store openings, refurbishments, and technology implementations across ANZ
* Partner with IT Project teams to deliver infrastructure and technology initiatives
* Conduct site visits for installations, troubleshooting, project rollouts, and support requirements
* Provide business-as-usual support for the South Melbourne and Torquay offices
* Manage local IT assets and act as the primary technology contact for both sites
* Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge articles
* Coach and support Tier 1 team members through knowledge sharing and technical guidance
* Collaborate with stakeholders across the business to improve service delivery and operational efficiency

What We’re Looking For…

You'll be a technically capable and customer-focused IT professional who enjoys balancing hands-on support with project-based work. You're a natural problem solver who can confidently tackle complex technical issues while building strong relationships across a diverse stakeholder group.

**You'll bring:**

* Experience in a Service Desk, Technical Support, Systems Support, or similar IT role
* Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, networking, and Microsoft environments
* Experience supporting retail technology environments and store-based systems
* A proactive approach to problem solving and continuous improvement
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
* Experience working on IT projects, implementations, and deployments
* Strong documentation and knowledge management skills
* The ability to prioritise competing demands in a fast-paced environment
* A collaborative mindset and passion for supporting and developing others

About KMD Brands…

KMD Brands is home to some of the world's most loved outdoor brands, including Kathmandu, Rip Curl and Oboz. Our purpose is to inspire and enable more people to enjoy the outdoors while creating positive outcomes for people and planet.

As a Certified B Corp, we're committed to using business as a force for good. From sustainability and innovation to creating great experiences for our customers and communities, we're focused on making a meaningful impact.

Whether we're opening new stores, improving existing ones or supporting our teams across the globe, we're united by a passion for adventure, collaboration and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Senior Program Advisor
jobs.description:
**Overview**

**Work Type:** Fixed-term - Full-time

**Salary:** $116,413 - $140,849

**Grade:** VPS 5

**Occupation:** Projects

**Location:** Melbourne - CBD and Inner Metro suburbs

**Reference:** VG/DE/VSBA/1942802

This is an exciting opportunity to help deliver infrastructure that enables better learning environments for Victorian students while contributing to one of the State's largest infrastructure programs.

**Fixed term full time role until 20-OCT-2029**

**About the Department**

The department provides a wide range of learning and development support and services.

The department provides policy leadership, plans for the future of education in Victoria and leads key cross-sector collaboration. The department plays an important system steward role by providing support, guidance, oversight and assurance across early childhood and school education systems, as well as directly providing school education and 50 new early learning centres.

**About the Victorian School Building Authority**

The Victorian School Building Authority (VSBA) is part of the Department of Education. Established in 2016, it oversees Victoria's largest school building program since the state introduced free public education in the 1870s.

The VSBA upgrades and expands existing schools and plans, designs and builds new schools to meet enrolment demand. We also support schools to maintain their buildings and grounds by offering expert advice and coordinating maintenance programs and grants.

With Victoria recently introducing two years of funded kindergarten, the VSBA is also working with the early childhood sector on a massive kindergarten construction program.

**About the Division**

The Project Delivery Division is responsible for delivering one of Victoria's largest school infrastructure programs, creating great learning environments that support better outcomes for students, teachers and communities.

Our teams deliver upgraded schools, early childhood infrastructure and a range of capital improvement programs across the State. Working in partnerships with schools, contractors, consultants and government stakeholders, we manage projects through every stage of the project life-cycle- from planning and design through to construction and completion.

We are committed to delivering projects safely, efficiently and transparently while continually improving the way we work. Our focus is on proactive project management, strong governance, great communication and collaborative relationships that built confidence with our stakeholders,

As part of our team you will contribute to a division that values accountability, continuous improvement, team work and delivering outcomes that make a lasting difference for Victorian communities.

**About the Role**

This is an exciting opportunity to help deliver infrastructure that enables better learning environments for Victorian students while contributing to one of the State's largest infrastructure programs.

Reporting to a Manager in the Project Delivery Division, the position will be accountable for delivering a portfolio of school infrastructure projects, proactively managing delivery performance, risk and stakeholder relationships to achieve successful outcomes for schools and by:

* Working with consultants, contractors, schools and internal stakeholders, you will ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget and to the quality expected by Victorian communities.
* Assisting in the coordination of all aspects of project execution across the project lifecycle from feasibility through to project close to ensure expectations are understood and agreed, the program is maintained, key milestones are met, and that delivery, performance and financial targets are achieved.
* Working with a Project Delivery Director/Manager, to collaborate with internal and external teams and resources on a range of matters, such as planning, design, legal and communications.
* Assisting in the establishment and maintenance of effective relationships with diverse stakeholders in order to manage risks and resolve issues impacting project delivery. This is likely to include managing sensitive negotiations with stakeholders with competing prioritie s.
* Assisting a Project Delivery Director/Manager by providing clear advice and reporting on project planning, project delivery status, benefits, and outcomes for a range of stakeholders, including Ministers, the Secretary, senior officers and project teams.
* Manage and monitor project budgets, forecasts and expenditure, ensuring alignment with approved funding, departmental policies and governance requirements.
* Provide high-quality advice on financial performance, budget risks and resourcing to support informed decision-making and effective project delivery.
* Apply Victorian Government value for money and probity principles in procurement, contract management and project implementation.
* Contribute to strong governance by maintaining accurate financial records, preparing reports and escalating budget issues and risks as required.
* Assisting in preparing project feasibility information and connecting insights from analysis

The ideal candidate will have sound judgement, commercial awareness and the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments while balancing competing priorities.

Working within a collaborative project delivery team, you will contribute to consistent delivery practices, continuous improvement and a culture of accountability. You will use project information and performance data to inform decisions, escalate emerging issues and help deliver reliable outcomes across the broader capital program.

Your proven project management skills, together with your qualifications in a relevant discipline will be highly regarded in securing this opportunity. Knowledge of public sector infrastructure funding and delivery systems will also be looked upon favourably.

All VSBA staff have a shared responsibility to meet the same service standards outlined in the *VSBA Customer Service Charter*. Our goal is to make every interaction with the VSBA a positive one for our customers, colleagues and key partners regardless of our individual role or team.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Essential: Qualification in Project Management, Construction, Architecture, Engineering or Quantity Surveying.
* Demonstrated experience delivering complex capital infrastructure projects, ideally within government or other large, multi stakeholder environments
* Experience administering construction contracts, management consultants and contractors, monitoring program, budget, risk, resolving project issues throughout the project lifecycle.
* Experience working with governance, procurement and assurance frameworks
* Experience using project controls, performance reporting and data to proactively manage project delivery outcomes,
* Demonstrated ability to identify emerging risks and issues early and implement practical solutions to maintain delivery outcomes

**Further Information**

For more details regarding this position please see attached position description for the capabilities to address in application.

**How to Apply**

To apply, please include a CV and a Cover letter addressing the Key selection criteria and summarising your skills and experience (no more than 2 pages).

For further information pertaining to the role, please contact **Susi Schroeder** via **[email protected]**

The department values diversity and inclusion in all forms - gender, religion, ethnicity, LGBTIQ+, disability and neurodiversity. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander candidates are strongly encouraged to apply. For more information about our work, working for the Department, diversity and inclusion, and our employment conditions visit the Department website and our Diversity and Inclusion page

Applicants requiring adjustments can contact the nominated contact person.

Information about the Department of Education's operations and employment conditions can be located at www.education.vic.gov.au.

Preferred applicants may be required to complete a police check and may be subject to other pre-employment checks. Information provided to the Department of Education will be treated in the strictest confidence.

Maintaining a valid employee-type Working with Children Check is a continuous condition of employment.

Please let us know via phone or email if you require any adjustments to ensure your full participation in the recruitment process or if you need the ad or any attachments in an accessible format (e.g large print) due to any viewing difficulties or other accessibility requirements.

**Applications close 11:59pm on 03 Sep 2026.**

Applications close Thursday 3 September 2026 at 11.59pm

jobs.title: Physical Infrastructure Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Job no:** 588379
**Work type:** Full-time
**Location:** Melbourne - Burwood
**Categories:** Building and Property Services

* Based at our Melbourne, Burwood Campus with some travel required from time to time to our other Victorian Campuses + hybrid work arrangements
* Full-time and fixed-term for 12 months
* HEW 10 $153,668 + 17% Superannuation
* Immediate start preferred

Make an impact in Deakin’s Infrastructure & Digital division which is focused on enhancing the customer experience through integrating physical and digital infrastructure, projects, and services to deliver seamless, impactful solutions tailored to customer needs.

Reporting to the Program Director, the Senior Project Manager is responsible for the definition, approach, facilitation and completion of Physical Infrastructure/Construction projects. Working closely with leaders, teams and key stakeholders inside and outside the university, the Senior Project Manager builds strong relationships to ensure services and projects are delivered efficiently, effectively and within agreed timelines.

**To be successful, you’ll have:**

* A minimum of 8 years relevant experience in the initiation, management and delivery of property projects.
* A background and qualification in project management, construction management, architecture or consulting engineering (PMP or PRINCE2 for example)

* Direct relevant experience working as a project manager in physical infrastructure environment (specifically capital infrastructure and built environment projects plus construction project procurement and delivery methodologies). Experience working as a client-side PM in Tertiary or Government environments preferred, but not essential.
* Proven experience in setting the direction and leading the delivery of multiple medium ($5m) sized refurbishment projects simultaneously, managing varied stakeholder groups with proven ability to recognise and critically analyse stakeholder requirements, ability to facilitate discussions with senior executives, strategic partnerships and manage vendors effectively.
* Working knowledge of commonly used consultant and construction contracts and accepted administration practises relevant to the construction industry including: Building Code (NCC), Australian Standards (AS), ISO Standards, Environmental and Sustainability Standards and Occupational Health and Safety Standards.

* Experience in the governance, finance and OHS process of large organisations similar to Deakin University
* Interest and experience in developing the enterprise project management capability by coaching and mentoring junior Project Managers, sharing expertise, and serving as a positive leadership role model.

**Here's how to apply:**

Please submit your updated resume and a short cover letter outlining your skills and experience.

For a confidential discussion regarding this role, please contact Edward Berry (Program Director) at e.berry@deakin.edu.au

**Applications for this position close on Monday 31st of August.**

**Who are we?**

Deakin is a cutting-edge public university in Victoria, revolutionising education with 61,000 students across seven campuses: Melbourne Burwood, Geelong Waurn Ponds, Geelong Waterfront, Warrnambool, Deakin University Lancaster University Indonesia (DLI), GIFT City, India and our dynamic online Campus. We're proud to be a progressive and open-minded university, delivering the highest student satisfaction in Victoria and consistently ranked in the top 1% of the world's universities.

**Make an Impact with Us**

Together we aim to take Deakin forward, strengthening our progressive University through the digital work we do. Whether it's empowering students, enabling teaching staff, or supporting researchers, the work you do here matters. Your achievements contribute to making a positive difference in the lives of the people and communities we serve.

So that you can focus on making a positive impact, Deakin Infrastructure and Digital Portfolio Delivery lays the foundations for you to be your best self, grow and evolve and join forces with exceptional people.

**Be Your Best Self**

As a unique individual we understand that showing up as the best version of yourself takes commitment to your personal wellbeing. That’s why we foster a supportive environment where you can manage your work to balance your productivity, engagement and wellbeing. Our approach to flexible working empowers you to achieve your best.

**Grow & Evolve**

Being in the higher education sector, ours is an environment of knowledge sharing and seeking. With us you can grow your capability through formal and informal learning and continuously improve, deepen and broaden your expertise. With many roles and teams under the one umbrella, there’s opportunity to expand your skillset, embrace new challenges and evolve your career. When YOU thrive, WE thrive.

**Join Forces**

As a member of our dynamic team, you’ll tackle challenges and deliver desired outcomes alongside supportive, inclusive and talented humans from within the team, and more broadly across the University. We are a powerful collective of diverse skillsets, strengths and experience and our practices promote an environment of collaboration where your unique contribution is welcomed and valued. When you join forces with our Infrastructure and Digital division you join forces with Deakin. Visit Why Work at Deakin to view the overarching benefits of working with Deakin.

**Are you ready to make an impact with us?**

We value diversity and aim to build an inclusive environment that champions, embraces and respects differences. We support and encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, and people of all abilities, cultures, sexual orientation, and genders.

**Pre-employment safety and suitability checks:** In accordance with the National Higher Education Code to Prevent and Respond to Gender-based Violence, appointment to this role is subject to successful completion of relevant pre-employment checks, including Working With Children Checks and candidate gender-based violence declarations.

Candidates may be asked to declare whether they have been investigated for an allegation of Gender‑based Violence, or determined to have engaged in conduct that constitutes Gender‑based Violence during the course of their previous employment, or otherwise in a legal process. A declaration is not required from individuals who have experienced gender‑based violence. A ‘Yes’ response does not automatically exclude a candidate from employment, and any information provided will be treated confidentially and considered only for relevance to the role and the University’s safety obligations.

**Advertised:** 20 Aug 2026 AUS Eastern Standard Time
